verses.sa:
सोमस्य मा तवसं वक्ष्यग्ने वह्निं चकर्थ विदथे यजध्यै ।
देवाँ अच्छा दीद्यद्युञ्जे अद्रिं शमाये अग्ने तन्वं जुषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
somasya ma tavasam vakshyagne vahnim chakartha vidathe yajadhyai |
devan achchha didyadyunje adrim shamaye agne tanvam jushasva ||
verses.en:
THOU, Agni, who wilt have the strong, hast made me the Soma's priest, to worship in assembly.
Thou shinest to the Gods, I set the press stones. I toil; be joyful in thyself, O Agni.

verses.sa:
प्राञ्चं यज्ञं चकृम वर्धतां गीः समिद्भिरग्निं नमसा दुवस्यन् ।
दिवः शशासुर्विदथा कवीनां गृत्साय चित्तवसे गातुमीषुः ॥
verses.rom:
prancham yajnam chakrima vardhatam gih samidbhiragnim namasa duvasyan |
divah shashasurvidatha kavinam gritsaya chittavase gatumishuh ||
verses.en:
East have we turned the rite; may the hymn aid it. With wood and worship shall they honour Agni.
From heaven the synods of the wise have learnt it: c'en for the quick and strong they seek advancement.

verses.sa:
मयो दधे मेधिरः पूतदक्षो दिवः सुबन्धुर्जनुषा पृथिव्याः ।
अविन्दन्नु दर्शतमप्स्वन्तर्देवासो अग्निमपसि स्वसॄणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
mayo dadhe medhirah putadaksho divah subandhurjanusha prithivyah |
avindannu darshatamapsvantardevaso agnimapasi svasrinam ||
verses.en:
The Prudent, he whose will is pure, brought welfare, allied by birth to Heaven and Earth in kinship.
The Gods discovered in the midst of waters beautiful Agni with the Sisters' labour.

verses.sa:
अवर्धयन्सुभगं सप्त यह्वीः श्वेतं जज्ञानमरुषं महित्वा ।
शिशुं न जातमभ्यारुरश्वा देवासो अग्निं जनिमन्वपुष्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
avardhayansubhagam sapta yahvih shvetam jajnanamarusham mahitva |
shishum na jatamabhyarurashva devaso agnim janimanvapushyan ||
verses.en:
Him, Blessed One, the Seven strong Floods augmented, him white at birth and red when waxen mighty.
As mother mares run to their new-born you ling, so at his birth the Gods wondered at Agni.

verses.sa:
शुक्रेभिरङ्गै रज आततन्वान्क्रतुं पुनानः कविभिः पवित्रैः ।
शोचिर्वसानः पर्यायुरपां श्रियो मिमीते बृहतीरनूनाः ॥
verses.rom:
shukrebhirangai raja atatanvankratum punanah kavibhih pavitraih |
shochirvasanah paryayurapam shriyo mimite brihatiranunah ||
verses.en:
Spreading with radiant limbs throughout the region, purging his power with wise purifications,
Robing himself in light, the life of waters, lie spreads abroad his high and perfect glories.

verses.sa:
वव्राजा सीमनदतीरदब्धा दिवो यह्वीरवसाना अनग्नाः ।
सना अत्र युवतयः सयोनीरेकं गर्भं दधिरे सप्त वाणीः ॥
verses.rom:
vavraja simanadatiradabdha divo yahviravasana anagnah |
sana atra yuvatayah sayonirekam garbham dadhire sapta vanih ||
verses.en:
He sought heaven's Mighty Ones, the unconsuming, the unimpaired, not clothed and yet not naked.
Then they, ancient and young, who dwell together, Seven sounding Rivers, as one germ received him.

verses.sa:
स्तीर्णा अस्य संहतो विश्वरूपा घृतस्य योनौ स्रवथे मधूनाम् ।
अस्थुरत्र धेनवः पिन्वमाना मही दस्मस्य मातरा समीची ॥
verses.rom:
stirna asya samhato vishvarupa ghritasya yonau sravathe madhunam |
asthuratra dhenavah pinvamana mahi dasmasya matara samichi ||
verses.en:
His piles, assuming every form, are scattered where flow sweet waters, at the spring of fatness;
There stood the milch-kine with full-laden udders, and both paired Mighty Mothers of the Wondrous.

verses.sa:
बभ्राणः सूनो सहसो व्यद्यौद्दधानः शुक्रा रभसा वपूंषि ।
श्चोतन्ति धारा मधुनो घृतस्य वृषा यत्र वावृधे काव्येन ॥
verses.rom:
babhranah suno sahaso vyadyauddadhanah shukra rabhasa vapumshi |
shchotanti dhara madhuno ghritasya vrisha yatra vavridhe kavyena ||
verses.en:
Carefully cherished, Son of Strength, thou showest assuming lasting and refulgent beauties.
Full streams of fatness and sweet juice descended, there where the Mighty One grew strong by wisdom.

verses.sa:
पितुश्चिदूधर्जनुषा विवेद व्यस्य धारा असृजद्वि धेनाः ।
गुहा चरन्तं सखिभिः शिवेभिर्दिवो यह्वीभिर्न गुहा बभूव ॥
verses.rom:
pitushchidudharjanusha viveda vyasya dhara asrijadvi dhenah |
guha charantam sakhibhih shivebhirdivo yahvibhirna guha babhuva ||
verses.en:
From birth he knew even his Father's bosom, he set his voices and his streams in motion;
Knew him who moved with blessed Friends in secret, with the young Dames of heaven. He stayed not hidden.

verses.sa:
पितुश्च गर्भं जनितुश्च बभ्रे पूर्वीरेको अधयत्पीप्यानाः ।
वृष्णे सपत्नी शुचये सबन्धू उभे अस्मै मनुष्ये नि पाहि ॥
verses.rom:
pitushcha garbham janitushcha babhre purvireko adhayatpipyanah |
vrishne sapatni shuchaye sabandhu ubhe asmai manushye ni pahi ||
verses.en:
He nursed the Infant of the Sire and Maker: alone the Babe sucked many a teeming bosom.
Guard, for the Bright and Strong, the fellow-spouses friendly to men and bound to him in kinship.

verses.sa:
उरौ महाँ अनिबाधे ववर्धापो अग्निं यशसः सं हि पूर्वीः ।
ऋतस्य योनावशयद्दमूना जामीनामग्निरपसि स्वसॄणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
urau mahan anibadhe vavardhapo agnim yashasah sam hi purvih |
ritasya yonavashayaddamuna jaminamagnirapasi svasrinam ||
verses.en:
The Mighty One increased in space unbounded; full many a glorious flood gave strength to Agni.
Friend of the house, within the lap of Order lay Agni, in the Sister Rivers' service.

verses.sa:
अक्रो न बभ्रिः समिथे महीनां दिदृक्षेयः सूनवे भाऋजीकः ।
उदुस्रिया जनिता यो जजानापां गर्भो नृतमो यह्वो अग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
akro na babhrih samithe mahinam didriksheyah sunave bharijikah |
udusriya janita yo jajanapam garbho nritamo yahvo agnih ||
verses.en:
As keen supporter where great waters gather, light-shedder whom the brood rejoice to look on;
He who begat, and will beget, the dawnlights, most manly, Child of Floods, is youthful Agni.

verses.sa:
अपां गर्भं दर्शतमोषधीनां वना जजान सुभगा विरूपम् ।
देवासश्चिन्मनसा सं हि जग्मुः पनिष्ठं जातं तवसं दुवस्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
apam garbham darshatamoshadhinam vana jajana subhaga virupam |
devasashchinmanasa sam hi jagmuh panishtham jatam tavasam duvasyan ||
verses.en:
Him, varied in his form, the lovely Infant of floods and plants the blessed wood hath gendered.
Gods even, moved in spirit, came around him, and served him at his birth, the Strong, the Wondrous.

verses.sa:
बृहन्त इद्भानवो भाऋजीकमग्निं सचन्त विद्युतो न शुक्राः ।
गुहेव वृद्धं सदसि स्वे अन्तरपार ऊर्वे अमृतं दुहानाः ॥
verses.rom:
brihanta idbhanavo bharijikamagnim sachanta vidyuto na shukrah |
guheva vriddham sadasi sve antarapara urve amritam duhanah ||
verses.en:
Like brilliant lightnings, mighty luminaries accompany the light-diffusing Agni,
Waxen, as 'twere in secret, in his dwelling, while in the boundless stall they milk out Amrta.

verses.sa:
ईळे च त्वा यजमानो हविर्भिरीळे सखित्वं सुमतिं निकामः ।
देवैरवो मिमीहि सं जरित्रे रक्षा च नो दम्येभिरनीकैः ॥
verses.rom:
ile cha tva yajamano havirbhirile sakhitvam sumatim nikamah |
devairavo mimihi sam jaritre raksha cha no damyebhiranikaih ||
verses.en:
I sacrificing serve thee with oblations and crave with longing thy good-will and friendship.
Grant, with the Gods, thy grace to him who lauds thee, protect us with thy rays that guard the homestead.

verses.sa:
उपक्षेतारस्तव सुप्रणीतेऽग्ने विश्वानि धन्या दधानाः ।
सुरेतसा श्रवसा तुञ्जमाना अभि ष्याम पृतनायूँरदेवान् ॥
verses.rom:
upakshetarastava supranite'gne vishvani dhanya dadhanah |
suretasa shravasa tunjamana abhi shyama pritanayunradevan ||
verses.en:
May we, O Agni, thou who leadest wisely, thy followers and masters of all treasures,
Strong in the glory of our noble offspring, subdue the godless when they seek the battle.

verses.sa:
आ देवानामभवः केतुरग्ने मन्द्रो विश्वानि काव्यानि विद्वान् ।
प्रति मर्ताँ अवासयो दमूना अनु देवान्रथिरो यासि साधन् ॥
verses.rom:
a devanamabhavah keturagne mandro vishvani kavyani vidvan |
prati martan avasayo damuna anu devanrathiro yasi sadhan ||
verses.en:
Ensign of Gods hast thou become, O Agni, joy-giver, knower of all secret wisdom.
Friend of the homestead, thou hast lightened mortals: car borne thou goest to the Gods, fulfilling.

verses.sa:
नि दुरोणे अमृतो मर्त्यानां राजा ससाद विदथानि साधन् ।
घृतप्रतीक उर्विया व्यद्यौदग्निर्विश्वानि काव्यानि विद्वान् ॥
verses.rom:
ni durone amrito martyanam raja sasada vidathani sadhan |
ghritapratika urviya vyadyaudagnirvishvani kavyani vidvan ||
verses.en:
Within the house hath sate the King immortal of mortals, filling full their sacred synods.
Bedewed with holy oil he shineth widely, Agni, the knower of all secret wisdom.

verses.sa:
आ नो गहि सख्येभिः शिवेभिर्महान्महीभिरूतिभिः सरण्यन् ।
अस्मे रयिं बहुलं संतरुत्रं सुवाचं भागं यशसं कृधी नः ॥
verses.rom:
a no gahi sakhyebhih shivebhirmahanmahibhirutibhih saranyan |
asme rayim bahulam samtarutram suvacham bhagam yashasam kridhi nah ||
verses.en:
Come unto us with thine auspicious friendship, come speeding, Mighty, with thy mighty succours.
Grant us abundant wealth that saves from danger, that brings a good repute, a glorious portion.

verses.sa:
एता ते अग्ने जनिमा सनानि प्र पूर्व्याय नूतनानि वोचम् ।
महान्ति वृष्णे सवना कृतेमा जन्मञ्जन्मन्निहितो जातवेदाः ॥
verses.rom:
eta te agne janima sanani pra purvyaya nutanani vocham |
mahanti vrishne savana kritema janmanjanmannihito jatavedah ||
verses.en:
To thee who art of old these songs, O Agni, have I declared, the ancient and the later.
These great libations to the Strong are offiered: in every birth is Jatavedas stablished.

verses.sa:
जन्मञ्जन्मन्निहितो जातवेदा विश्वामित्रेभिरिध्यते अजस्रः ।
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
janmanjanmannihito jataveda vishvamitrebhiridhyate ajasrah |
tasya vayam sumatau yajniyasyapi bhadre saumanase syama ||
verses.en:
Stablished in every birth is Jatavedas, kindled perpetual by the Visvamitras.
May we rest ever in the loving-kindness, in the auspicious grace of him the Holy.

verses.sa:
इमं यज्ञं सहसावन्त्वं नो देवत्रा धेहि सुक्रतो रराणः ।
प्र यंसि होतर्बृहतीरिषो नोऽग्ने महि द्रविणमा यजस्व ॥
verses.rom:
imam yajnam sahasavantvam no devatra dhehi sukrato raranah |
pra yamsi hotarbrihatirisho no'gne mahi dravinama yajasva ||
verses.en:
This sacrifice of ours do thou, O Mighty, O truly Wise, bear to the Gods rejoicing.
Grant us abundant food, thou priestly Herald, vouchsafe to give us ample wealth, O Agni.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
ilamagne purudamsam sanim goh shashvattamam havamanaya sadha |
syannah sunustanayo vijavagne sa te sumatirbhutvasme ||
verses.en:
As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.
To us he born a son, and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानराय धिषणामृतावृधे घृतं न पूतमग्नये जनामसि ।
द्विता होतारं मनुषश्च वाघतो धिया रथं न कुलिशः समृण्वति ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaraya dhishanamritavridhe ghritam na putamagnaye janamasi |
dvita hotaram manushashcha vaghato dhiya ratham na kulishah samrinvati ||
verses.en:
To him, Vaisvanara, who strengthens Holy Law, to Agni we present our praise like oil made pure.
With thoughtful insight human priests bring him anear, our Herald from of old, as an axe forms a car.

verses.sa:
स रोचयज्जनुषा रोदसी उभे स मात्रोरभवत्पुत्र ईड्यः ।
हव्यवाळग्निरजरश्चनोहितो दूळभो विशामतिथिर्विभावसुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa rochayajjanusha rodasi ubhe sa matrorabhavatputra idyah |
havyavalagnirajarashchanohito dulabho vishamatithirvibhavasuh ||
verses.en:
He made the heaven and earth resplendent by his birth: Child of two Mothers he was meet to be implored,
Agni, oblation-bearer, gracious, ever-young, infallible, rich in radiant light, the guest of men.

verses.sa:
क्रत्वा दक्षस्य तरुषो विधर्मणि देवासो अग्निं जनयन्त चित्तिभिः ।
रुरुचानं भानुना ज्योतिषा महामत्यं न वाजं सनिष्यन्नुप ब्रुवे ॥
verses.rom:
kratva dakshasya tarusho vidharmani devaso agnim janayanta chittibhih |
ruruchanam bhanuna jyotisha mahamatyam na vajam sanishyannupa bruve ||
verses.en:
Within the range of their surpassing power, by might, the Gods created Agni with inventive thought.
I, eager to win strength, address him, like a steed, resplendent with his brilliance, with his ample light.

verses.sa:
आ मन्द्रस्य सनिष्यन्तो वरेण्यं वृणीमहे अह्रयं वाजमृग्मियम् ।
रातिं भृगूणामुशिजं कविक्रतुमग्निं राजन्तं दिव्येन शोचिषा ॥
verses.rom:
a mandrasya sanishyanto varenyam vrinimahe ahrayam vajamrigmiyam |
ratim bhrigunamushijam kavikratumagnim rajantam divyena shochisha ||
verses.en:
Eager to gain, we crave from him the friendly God strength confident, choice worthy meet to be extolled:
The Bhrgus' bounty, willing, strong with sages' lore, even Agni shining forth with light that comes from heaven.

verses.sa:
अग्निं सुम्नाय दधिरे पुरो जना वाजश्रवसमिह वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
यतस्रुचः सुरुचं विश्वदेव्यं रुद्रं यज्ञानां साधदिष्टिमपसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim sumnaya dadhire puro jana vajashravasamiha vriktabarhishah |
yatasruchah surucham vishvadevyam rudram yajnanam sadhadishtimapasam ||
verses.en:
For happiness, men, having trimmed the sacred grass, set Agni glorious for his strength before them here;
Yea, with raised ladles, him bright, dear to all the Gods, perfecting aims of works, Rudra of solemn rites.

verses.sa:
पावकशोचे तव हि क्षयं परि होतर्यज्ञेषु वृक्तबर्हिषो नरः ।
अग्ने दुव इच्छमानास आप्यमुपासते द्रविणं धेहि तेभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
pavakashoche tava hi kshayam pari hotaryajneshu vriktabarhisho narah |
agne duva ichchhamanasa apyamupasate dravinam dhehi tebhyah ||
verses.en:
Around thy dwelling-place, O brightly-shining Priest, are men at sacrifice, whose sacred grass is trimmed.
Wishing to do thee service, Agni, they are there, desirous of thy friendship grant them store of wealth.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी अपृणदा स्वर्महज्जातं यदेनमपसो अधारयन् ।
सो अध्वराय परि णीयते कविरत्यो न वाजसातये चनोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
a rodasi aprinada svarmahajjatam yadenamapaso adharayan |
so adhvaraya pari niyate kaviratyo na vajasataye chanohitah ||
verses.en:
He hath filled heaven and earth and the great realm of light, when at his birth the skillful held him in their hold.
He like a horse is led forth to the sacrifice Sage, graciously inclined, that he may win us strength.

verses.sa:
नमस्यत हव्यदातिं स्वध्वरं दुवस्यत दम्यं जातवेदसम् ।
रथीरृतस्य बृहतो विचर्षणिरग्निर्देवानामभवत्पुरोहितः ॥
verses.rom:
namasyata havyadatim svadhvaram duvasyata damyam jatavedasam |
rathirritasya brihato vicharshaniragnirdevanamabhavatpurohitah ||
verses.en:
Honour the oblation-bearer, him who knows fair rites, serve ye the Household Friend who knows all things that be.
He drives the chariot of the lofty ordinance: Agni most active, is the great High Priest of Gods.

verses.sa:
तिस्रो यह्वस्य समिधः परिज्मनोऽग्नेरपुनन्नुशिजो अमृत्यवः ।
तासामेकामदधुर्मर्त्ये भुजमु लोकमु द्वे उप जामिमीयतुः ॥
verses.rom:
tisro yahvasya samidhah parijmano'gnerapunannushijo amrityavah |
tasamekamadadhurmartye bhujamu lokamu dve upa jamimiyatuh ||
verses.en:
They who are free from death, fain for him, purified three splendours of the mighty Agni, circling all.
To man, for his enjoyment, one of these they gave: the other two have passed into the sister sphere.

verses.sa:
विशां कविं विश्पतिं मानुषीरिषः सं सीमकृण्वन्स्वधितिं न तेजसे ।
स उद्वतो निवतो याति वेविषत्स गर्भमेषु भुवनेषु दीधरत् ॥
verses.rom:
visham kavim vishpatim manushirishah sam simakrinvansvadhitim na tejase |
sa udvato nivato yati vevishatsa garbhameshu bhuvaneshu didharat ||
verses.en:
Man's sacrificial food hath sharpened like an axe, for brightness, him the Sage of men, the people's Lord,
Busied with sacred rites he mounts and he descends. He hath laid down his vital germ within these worlds.

verses.sa:
स जिन्वते जठरेषु प्रजज्ञिवान्वृषा चित्रेषु नानदन्न सिंहः ।
वैश्वानरः पृथुपाजा अमर्त्यो वसु रत्ना दयमानो वि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
sa jinvate jathareshu prajajnivanvrisha chitreshu nanadanna simhah |
vaishvanarah prithupaja amartyo vasu ratna dayamano vi dashushe ||
verses.en:
He stirs with life in wombs dissimilar in kind, born as a Lion or a loudly-bellowing Bull:
Vaisvanara immortal with wide-reaching might, bestowing goods and wealth on him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरः प्रत्नथा नाकमारुहद्दिवस्पृष्ठं भन्दमानः सुमन्मभिः ।
स पूर्ववज्जनयञ्जन्तवे धनं समानमज्मं पर्येति जागृविः ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanarah pratnatha nakamaruhaddivasprishtham bhandamanah sumanmabhih |
sa purvavajjanayanjantave dhanam samanamajmam paryeti jagrivih ||
verses.en:
Vaisvanara, as of old, mounted the cope of heaven, heaven's ridge, well greeted, by those skilled in noble songs.
He, as of old, producing riches for the folk, still watchful, traverses the common way again.

verses.sa:
ऋतावानं यज्ञियं विप्रमुक्थ्यमा यं दधे मातरिश्वा दिवि क्षयम् ।
तं चित्रयामं हरिकेशमीमहे सुदीतिमग्निं सुविताय नव्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
ritavanam yajniyam vipramukthyama yam dadhe matarishva divi kshayam |
tam chitrayamam harikeshamimahe suditimagnim suvitaya navyase ||
verses.en:
For new prosperity we seek to Agni, him whose course is splendid, gold-haired, excellently bright,
Whom Matarisvan stablished, dweller in the heaven, meet for high praise and holy, sage and true to Law.

verses.sa:
शुचिं न यामन्निषिरं स्वर्दृशं केतुं दिवो रोचनस्थामुषर्बुधम् ।
अग्निं मूर्धानं दिवो अप्रतिष्कुतं तमीमहे नमसा वाजिनं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
shuchim na yamannishiram svardrisham ketum divo rochanasthamusharbudham |
agnim murdhanam divo apratishkutam tamimahe namasa vajinam brihat ||
verses.en:
As pure and swift of course, beholder of the light, who stands in heaven's bright sphere a sign, who wakes at dawn,
Agni, the head of heaven, whom none may turn aside-to him the Powerful with mighty prayer we seek.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रं होतारं शुचिमद्वयाविनं दमूनसमुक्थ्यं विश्वचर्षणिम् ।
रथं न चित्रं वपुषाय दर्शतं मनुर्हितं सदमिद्राय ईमहे ॥
verses.rom:
mandram hotaram shuchimadvayavinam damunasamukthyam vishvacharshanim |
ratham na chitram vapushaya darshatam manurhitam sadamidraya imahe ||
verses.en:
The cheerful Priest, the pure, in whom no guile is found, Friend of the House, praise-worthy, dear to all mankind,
Fair to behold for beauty like a splendid car,- Agni the Friend of men we ever seek for wealth.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानराय पृथुपाजसे विपो रत्ना विधन्त धरुणेषु गातवे ।
अग्निर्हि देवाँ अमृतो दुवस्यत्यथा धर्माणि सनता न दूदुषत् ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaraya prithupajase vipo ratna vidhanta dharuneshu gatave |
agnirhi devan amrito duvasyatyatha dharmani sanata na dudushat ||
verses.en:
To him who shines afar, Vaisvanara, shall bards give precious things that he may go on certain paths:
For Agni the Immortal serves the Deities, and therefore never breaks their everlasting laws.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्दूतो रोदसी दस्म ईयते होता निषत्तो मनुषः पुरोहितः ।
क्षयं बृहन्तं परि भूषति द्युभिर्देवेभिरग्निरिषितो धियावसुः ॥
verses.rom:
antarduto rodasi dasma iyate hota nishatto manushah purohitah |
kshayam brihantam pari bhushati dyubhirdevebhiragnirishito dhiyavasuh ||
verses.en:
He, wondrous envoy, goes between the earth and heaven, firm seated as the Herald, great High Priest of men.
He compasseth with rays the lofty dwelling-place, Agni, sent forward by the Gods, enriched with piayer.

verses.sa:
केतुं यज्ञानां विदथस्य साधनं विप्रासो अग्निं महयन्त चित्तिभिः ।
अपांसि यस्मिन्नधि संदधुर्गिरस्तस्मिन्सुम्नानि यजमान आ चके ॥
verses.rom:
ketum yajnanam vidathasya sadhanam vipraso agnim mahayanta chittibhih |
apamsi yasminnadhi samdadhurgirastasminsumnani yajamana a chake ||
verses.en:
Sages shall glorify Agni with earnest thoughts, ensign of sacrifice, who fills the synod full:
In whom the singers have stored up their holy acts to him the worshipper looks for joy and happiness.

verses.sa:
पिता यज्ञानामसुरो विपश्चितां विमानमग्निर्वयुनं च वाघताम् ।
आ विवेश रोदसी भूरिवर्पसा पुरुप्रियो भन्दते धामभिः कविः ॥
verses.rom:
pita yajnanamasuro vipashchitam vimanamagnirvayunam cha vaghatam |
a vivesha rodasi bhurivarpasa purupriyo bhandate dhamabhih kavih ||
verses.en:
The Sire of sacrifice, great God of holy bards, Agni, the measure and the symbol of the priests,
Hath entered heaven and earth that show in varied form: the Sage whom many love rejoiceth in his might.

verses.sa:
चन्द्रमग्निं चन्द्ररथं हरिव्रतं वैश्वानरमप्सुषदं स्वर्विदम् ।
विगाहं तूर्णिं तविषीभिरावृतं भूर्णिं देवास इह सुश्रियं दधुः ॥
verses.rom:
chandramagnim chandraratham harivratam vaishvanaramapsushadam svarvidam |
vigaham turnim tavishibhiravritam bhurnim devasa iha sushriyam dadhuh ||
verses.en:
Bright Agni with the bright car, Lord of green domains, Vaisvanara dweller in the floods, who finds the light,
Pervading, swift and wild, encompassed round with powers, him very glorious have the Gods established here.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्देवेभिर्मनुषश्च जन्तुभिस्तन्वानो यज्ञं पुरुपेशसं धिया ।
रथीरन्तरीयते साधदिष्टिभिर्जीरो दमूना अभिशस्तिचातनः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdevebhirmanushashcha jantubhistanvano yajnam purupeshasam dhiya |
rathirantariyate sadhadishtibhirjiro damuna abhishastichatanah ||
verses.en:
Agni, together with the Gods and Manu's folk by thought extending sacrifice in varied form,
Goes, car-borne, to and fro with those who crown each rite, the fleet, the Household Friend, who turns the curse aside.

verses.sa:
अग्ने जरस्व स्वपत्य आयुन्यूर्जा पिन्वस्व समिषो दिदीहि नः ।
वयांसि जिन्व बृहतश्च जागृव उशिग्देवानामसि सुक्रतुर्विपाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne jarasva svapatya ayunyurja pinvasva samisho didihi nah |
vayamsi jinva brihatashcha jagriva ushigdevanamasi sukraturvipam ||
verses.en:
Sing, Agni, for long life to us and noble sons: teem thou with plenty, shine upon us store of food.
Increase the great man's strength, thou ever-vigilant: thou, longing for the Gods, knowest their hymns full well.

verses.sa:
विश्पतिं यह्वमतिथिं नरः सदा यन्तारं धीनामुशिजं च वाघताम् ।
अध्वराणां चेतनं जातवेदसं प्र शंसन्ति नमसा जूतिभिर्वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
vishpatim yahvamatithim narah sada yantaram dhinamushijam cha vaghatam |
adhvaranam chetanam jatavedasam pra shamsanti namasa jutibhirvridhe ||
verses.en:
The Mighty One, Lord of the people and their guest, the leader of their thoughts, devoted Friend of priests,
Our solemn rites' announcer, Jatavedas, men with worship ever praise, with urgings for their weal.

verses.sa:
विभावा देवः सुरणः परि क्षितीरग्निर्बभूव शवसा सुमद्रथः ।
तस्य व्रतानि भूरिपोषिणो वयमुप भूषेम दम आ सुवृक्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vibhava devah suranah pari kshitiragnirbabhuva shavasa sumadrathah |
tasya vratani bhuriposhino vayamupa bhushema dama a suvriktibhih ||
verses.en:
Agni the God resplendent, giver of great joy, hath on his lovely car compassed the lands with, might.
Let us with pure laudations in his house approach the high laws of the nourisher of multitudes.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानर तव धामान्या चके येभिः स्वर्विदभवो विचक्षण ।
जात आपृणो भुवनानि रोदसी अग्ने ता विश्वा परिभूरसि त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanara tava dhamanya chake yebhih svarvidabhavo vichakshana |
jata aprino bhuvanani rodasi agne ta vishva paribhurasi tmana ||
verses.en:
I celebrate thy glories, O Vaisvanara, wherewith thou, O farsighted God, has found the light.
Thou filledst at thy birth both worlds, the earth and heaven: all this, O Agni, hast thou compassed of thyself.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरस्य दंसनाभ्यो बृहदरिणादेकः स्वपस्यया कविः ।
उभा पितरा महयन्नजायताग्निर्द्यावापृथिवी भूरिरेतसा ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanarasya damsanabhyo brihadarinadekah svapasyaya kavih |
ubha pitara mahayannajayatagnirdyavaprithivi bhuriretasa ||
verses.en:
By his great skill the Sage alone hath brought to pass a great deed, mightier than Vaisvanara's wondrous acts.
Agni sprang into being, magnifying both his Parents, Heaven and Earth, rich in prolific seed.

verses.sa:
समित्समित्सुमना बोध्यस्मे शुचाशुचा सुमतिं रासि वस्वः ।
आ देव देवान्यजथाय वक्षि सखा सखीन्सुमना यक्ष्यग्ने ॥
verses.rom:
samitsamitsumana bodhyasme shuchashucha sumatim rasi vasvah |
a deva devanyajathaya vakshi sakha sakhinsumana yakshyagne ||
verses.en:
BE friendly with each kindled log of fuel, with every flash bestow the boon of riches.
Bring thou the Gods, O God, unto our worship: serve, well-inclined, as Friend thy friends, O Agni.

verses.sa:
यं देवासस्त्रिरहन्नायजन्ते दिवेदिवे वरुणो मित्रो अग्निः ।
सेमं यज्ञं मधुमन्तं कृधी नस्तनूनपाद्घृतयोनिं विधन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam devasastrirahannayajante divedive varuno mitro agnih |
semam yajnam madhumantam kridhi nastanunapadghritayonim vidhantam ||
verses.en:
Agni whom daily Varuna and Mitra the Gods bring thrice a day to this our worship,
Tanunapat, enrich with meath our service that dwells with holy oil, that offers honour.

verses.sa:
प्र दीधितिर्विश्ववारा जिगाति होतारमिळः प्रथमं यजध्यै ।
अच्छा नमोभिर्वृषभं वन्दध्यै स देवान्यक्षदिषितो यजीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
pra didhitirvishvavara jigati hotaramilah prathamam yajadhyai |
achchha namobhirvrishabham vandadhyai sa devanyakshadishito yajiyan ||
verses.en:
The thought that bringeth every boon proceedeth to worship first the Priest of the libation,
That we may greet the Strong One with our homage. Urged, may he bring the Gods, best Sacrificer.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वो वां गातुरध्वरे अकार्यूर्ध्वा शोचींषि प्रस्थिता रजांसि ।
दिवो वा नाभा न्यसादि होता स्तृणीमहि देवव्यचा वि बर्हिः ॥
verses.rom:
urdhvo vam gaturadhvare akaryurdhva shochimshi prasthita rajamsi |
divo va nabha nyasadi hota strinimahi devavyacha vi barhih ||
verses.en:
On high your way to sacrifice was made ready; the radiant flames went upward to the regions.
Full in the midst of heaven the Priest is seated: strew we the sacred grass where Gods may rest them.

verses.sa:
सप्त होत्राणि मनसा वृणाना इन्वन्तो विश्वं प्रति यन्नृतेन ।
नृपेशसो विदथेषु प्र जाता अभीमं यज्ञं वि चरन्त पूर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
sapta hotrani manasa vrinana invanto vishvam prati yannritena |
nripeshaso vidatheshu pra jata abhimam yajnam vi charanta purvih ||
verses.en:
Claiming in mind the seven priests' burnt oblations, inciting all, they came in settled order.
To this our sacrifice approach the many who show in hero beauty at assemblies.

verses.sa:
आ भन्दमाने उषसा उपाके उत स्मयेते तन्वा विरूपे ।
यथा नो मित्रो वरुणो जुजोषदिन्द्रो मरुत्वाँ उत वा महोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a bhandamane ushasa upake uta smayete tanva virupe |
yatha no mitro varuno jujoshadindro marutvan uta va mahobhih ||
verses.en:
Night and Dawn, lauded, hither come together, both smiling, different are their forms in colour,
That Varuna and Mitra may accept us, and Indra, girt by Maruts, with his glories.

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा न्यृञ्जे सप्त पृक्षासः स्वधया मदन्ति ।
ऋतं शंसन्त ऋतमित्त आहुरनु व्रतं व्रतपा दीध्यानाः ॥
verses.rom:
daivya hotara prathama nyrinje sapta prikshasah svadhaya madanti |
ritam shamsanta ritamitta ahuranu vratam vratapa didhyanah ||
verses.en:
I crave the grace of heaven's two chief Invokers: the seven swift steeds joy in their wonted manner.
These speak of truth, praising the truth eternal, thinking on Order as the guards of Order.

verses.sa:
आ भारती भारतीभिः सजोषा इळा देवैर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः ।
सरस्वती सारस्वतेभिरर्वाक्तिस्रो देवीर्बर्हिरेदं सदन्तु ॥
verses.rom:
a bharati bharatibhih sajosha ila devairmanushyebhiragnih |
sarasvati sarasvatebhirarvaktisro devirbarhiredam sadantu ||
verses.en:
May Bharati with all her Sisters, Ila accordant with the Gods, with immortal Agni,
Sarasvati with all her kindred Rivers, come to this grass, Three Goddesses, and seat them.

verses.sa:
तन्नस्तुरीपमध पोषयित्नु देव त्वष्टर्वि रराणः स्यस्व ।
यतो वीरः कर्मण्यः सुदक्षो युक्तग्रावा जायते देवकामः ॥
verses.rom:
tannasturipamadha poshayitnu deva tvashtarvi raranah syasva |
yato virah karmanyah sudaksho yuktagrava jayate devakamah ||
verses.en:
Well pleased with us do thou O God, O Tvastar, give ready issue to our procreant vigour,
Whence springs the hero, powerful, skilled in action, lover of Gods, adjuster of the press-stones.

verses.sa:
वनस्पतेऽव सृजोप देवानग्निर्हविः शमिता सूदयाति ।
सेदु होता सत्यतरो यजाति यथा देवानां जनिमानि वेद ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspate'va srijopa devanagnirhavih shamita sudayati |
sedu hota satyataro yajati yatha devanam janimani veda ||
verses.en:
Send to the Gods the oblation, Lord of Forests; and let the Immolator, Agni, dress it.
He as the truer Priest shall offer worship, for the Gods' generations well he knoweth.

verses.sa:
आ याह्यग्ने समिधानो अर्वाङिन्द्रेण देवैः सरथं तुरेभिः ।
बर्हिर्न आस्तामदितिः सुपुत्रा स्वाहा देवा अमृता मादयन्ताम् ॥
verses.rom:
a yahyagne samidhano arvanindrena devaih saratham turebhih |
barhirna astamaditih suputra svaha deva amrita madayantam ||
verses.en:
Come thou to us, O Agni, duly kindled, together with the potent Gods and Indra.
On this our grass sit Aditi, happy Mother, and let our Hail delight the Gods Immortal.

verses.sa:
प्रत्यग्निरुषसश्चेकितानोऽबोधि विप्रः पदवीः कवीनाम्।
पृथुपाजा देवयद्भिः समिद्धोऽप द्वारा तमसो वह्निरावः ॥
verses.rom:
pratyagnirushasashchekitano'bodhi viprah padavih kavinam|
prithupaja devayadbhih samiddho'pa dvara tamaso vahniravah ||
verses.en:
AGNI who shines against the Dawns is wakened. The holy Singer who precedes the sages.
With far-spread lustre, kindled by the pious, the Priest hath thrown both gates of darkness open.

verses.sa:
प्रेद्वग्निर्वावृधे स्तोमेभिर्गीर्भिः स्तोतॄणां नमस्य उक्थैः।
पूर्वीर्ऋतस्य संदृशश्चकानः सं दूतो अद्यौदुषसो विरोके ॥
verses.rom:
predvagnirvavridhe stomebhirgirbhih stotrinam namasya ukthaih|
purvirritasya samdrishashchakanah sam duto adyaudushaso viroke ||
verses.en:
Agni hath waxen mighty by laudations, to be adored with hymns of those who praise him.
Loving the varied shows of holy Order at the first flush of dawn he shines as envoy.

verses.sa:
अधाय्यग्निर्मानुषीषु विक्ष्वपां गर्भो मित्र ऋतेन साधन्।
आ हर्यतो यजतः सान्वस्थादभूदु विप्रो हव्यो मतीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
adhayyagnirmanushishu vikshvapam garbho mitra ritena sadhan|
a haryato yajatah sanvasthadabhudu vipro havyo matinam ||
verses.en:
Amid men's homes hath Agni been established, fulfilling with the Law, Friend, germ of waters.
Loved and adored, the height he hath ascended, the Singer, object of our invocations.

verses.sa:
मित्रो अग्निर्भवति यत्समिद्धो मित्रो होता वरुणो जातवेदाः।
मित्रो अध्वर्युरिषिरो दमूना मित्रः सिन्धूनामुत पर्वतानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
mitro agnirbhavati yatsamiddho mitro hota varuno jatavedah|
mitro adhvaryurishiro damuna mitrah sindhunamuta parvatanam ||
verses.en:
Agni is Mitra when enkindled duly, Mitra as Priest, Varuna, Jatavedas;
Mitra as active minister, and House-Friend, Mitra of flowing rivers and of mountains.

verses.sa:
पाति प्रियं रिपो अग्रं पदं वेः पाति यह्वश्चरणं सूर्यस्य।
पाति नाभा सप्तशीर्षाणमग्निः पाति देवानामुपमादमृष्वः ॥
verses.rom:
pati priyam ripo agram padam veh pati yahvashcharanam suryasya|
pati nabha saptashirshanamagnih pati devanamupamadamrishvah ||
verses.en:
The Earth's, the Bird's dear lofty place he guardeth, he guardeth in his might the course of Surya,
Guardeth the Seven-headed in the centre, guardeth sublime the Deities enjoyment.

verses.sa:
ऋभुश्चक्र ईड्यं चारु नाम विश्वानि देवो वयुनानि विद्वान्।
ससस्य चर्म घृतवत्पदं वेस्तदिदग्नी रक्षत्यप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.rom:
ribhushchakra idyam charu nama vishvani devo vayunani vidvan|
sasasya charma ghritavatpadam vestadidagni rakshatyaprayuchchhan ||
verses.en:
The skillful God who knows all forms of knowledge made for himself a fair form, meet for worship.
This Agni guards with care that never ceases the Sonia's skin, the Bird's place rich in fatness.

verses.sa:
आ योनिमग्निर्घृतवन्तमस्थात्पृथुप्रगाणमुशन्तमुशानः।
दीद्यानः शुचिर्ऋष्वः पावकः पुनःपुनर्मातरा नव्यसी कः ॥
verses.rom:
a yonimagnirghritavantamasthatprithupraganamushantamushanah|
didyanah shuchirrishvah pavakah punahpunarmatara navyasi kah ||
verses.en:
Agni hath entered longingly the longing shrine rich with fatness, giving easy access.
Resplendent, pure, sublime and purifying, again, again he renovates his Mothers.

verses.sa:
सद्यो जात ओषधीभिर्ववक्षे यदी वर्धन्ति प्रस्वो घृतेन।
आप इव प्रवता शुम्भमाना उरुष्यदग्निः पित्रोरुपस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
sadyo jata oshadhibhirvavakshe yadi vardhanti prasvo ghritena|
apa iva pravata shumbhamana urushyadagnih pitrorupasthe ||
verses.en:
Born suddenly, by plants he grew to greatness, when tender shoots with holy oil increased him,
Like waters lovely when they hasten downward may Agni in his Parents' lap protect us.

verses.sa:
उदु ष्टुतः समिधा यह्वो अद्यौद्वर्ष्मन्दिवो अधि नाभा पृथिव्याः।
मित्रो अग्निरीड्यो मातरिश्वा दूतो वक्षद्यजथाय देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
udu shtutah samidha yahvo adyaudvarshmandivo adhi nabha prithivyah|
mitro agniridyo matarishva duto vakshadyajathaya devan ||
verses.en:
Extolled, the Strong shone forth with kindled fuel to the earth's centre, to the height of heaven.
May Agni, Friend, adorable Matarisvan, as envoy bring the Gods unto our worship.

verses.sa:
उदस्तम्भीत्समिधा नाकमृष्वोऽग्निर्भवन्नुत्तमो रोचनानाम्।
यदी भृगुभ्यः परि मातरिश्वा गुहा सन्तं हव्यवाहं समीधे ॥
verses.rom:
udastambhitsamidha nakamrishvo'gnirbhavannuttamo rochananam|
yadi bhrigubhyah pari matarishva guha santam havyavaham samidhe ||
verses.en:
Best of all luminaries lofty Agni supported with his flame the height of heaven,
When, far from Bhrgus, Matarisvan kindled the oblation-bearer where he lay in secret.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
ilamagne purudamsam sanim goh shashvattamam havamanaya sadha|
syannah sunustanayo vijavagne sa te sumatirbhutvasme ||
verses.en:
As holy food, Agni to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.
To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-word.

verses.sa:
प्र कारवो मनना वच्यमाना देवद्रीचीं नयत देवयन्तः ।
दक्षिणावाड्वाजिनी प्राच्येति हविर्भरन्त्यग्नये घृताची ॥
verses.rom:
pra karavo manana vachyamana devadrichim nayata devayantah |
dakshinavadvajini prachyeti havirbharantyagnaye ghritachi ||
verses.en:
URGED on by deep devotion, O ye singers, bring, pious ones, the God-approaching ladle.
Borne onward to the right it travels eastward, and, filled with oil, to Agni bears oblation.

verses.sa:
आ रोदसी अपृणा जायमान उत प्र रिक्था अध नु प्रयज्यो ।
दिवश्चिदग्ने महिना पृथिव्या वच्यन्तां ते वह्नयः सप्तजिह्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
a rodasi aprina jayamana uta pra riktha adha nu prayajyo |
divashchidagne mahina prithivya vachyantam te vahnayah saptajihvah ||
verses.en:
Thou at thy birth didst fill both earth and heaven, yea, Most Adorable, thou didst exceed them.
Even through the heaven's and through the earth's expanses let thy swift seven tongued flames roll on, O Agni.

verses.sa:
द्यौश्च त्वा पृथिवी यज्ञियासो नि होतारं सादयन्ते दमाय ।
यदी विशो मानुषीर्देवयन्तीः प्रयस्वतीरीळते शुक्रमर्चिः ॥
verses.rom:
dyaushcha tva prithivi yajniyaso ni hotaram sadayante damaya |
yadi visho manushirdevayantih prayasvatirilate shukramarchih ||
verses.en:
Both Heaven and Earth and Gods who should be worshipped establish thee as Priest for every dwelling,
Whenever human families, God-devoted, bringing oblations; laud thy splendid lustre.

verses.sa:
महान्सधस्थे ध्रुव आ निषत्तोऽन्तर्द्यावा माहिने हर्यमाणः ।
आस्क्रे सपत्नी अजरे अमृक्ते सबर्दुघे उरुगायस्य धेनू ॥
verses.rom:
mahansadhasthe dhruva a nishatto'ntardyava mahine haryamanah |
askre sapatni ajare amrikte sabardughe urugayasya dhenu ||
verses.en:
Firm in the Gods' home is the Mighty seated, between vast Heaven and Earth the well-beloved-
Those Cows who yield, unharmed, their nectar, Spouses of the Far-Strider, ever young, united.

verses.sa:
व्रता ते अग्ने महतो महानि तव क्रत्वा रोदसी आ ततन्थ ।
त्वं दूतो अभवो जायमानस्त्वं नेता वृषभ चर्षणीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrata te agne mahato mahani tava kratva rodasi a tatantha |
tvam duto abhavo jayamanastvam neta vrishabha charshaninam ||
verses.en:
Great are the deeds of thee, the Great, O Agni: thou by thy power hast spread out earth and heaven.
As soon as thou wast born thou wast an envoy, thou, Mighty One, was Leader of the people.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य वा केशिना योग्याभिर्घृतस्नुवा रोहिता धुरि धिष्व ।
अथा वह देवान्देव विश्वान्स्वध्वरा कृणुहि जातवेदः ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya va keshina yogyabhirghritasnuva rohita dhuri dhishva |
atha vaha devandeva vishvansvadhvara krinuhi jatavedah ||
verses.en:
Bind to the pole with cords of holy Order the long-maned ruddy steeds who sprinkle fatness.
Bring hither, O thou God, all Gods together: provide them noble worship, Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चिदा ते रुचयन्त रोका उषो विभातीरनु भासि पूर्वीः ।
अपो यदग्न उशधग्वनेषु होतुर्मन्द्रस्य पनयन्त देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
divashchida te ruchayanta roka usho vibhatiranu bhasi purvih |
apo yadagna ushadhagvaneshu hoturmandrasya panayanta devah ||
verses.en:
Even from the sky thy brilliant lights shone hither: still hast thou beamed through many a radiant morning,
That the Gods praised their joyous Herald's labour eagerly burning, Agni, in the forests.

verses.sa:
उरौ वा ये अन्तरिक्षे मदन्ति दिवो वा ये रोचने सन्ति देवाः ।
ऊमा वा ये सुहवासो यजत्रा आयेमिरे रथ्यो अग्ने अश्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
urau va ye antarikshe madanti divo va ye rochane santi devah |
uma va ye suhavaso yajatra ayemire rathyo agne ashvah ||
verses.en:
The Gods who take delight in air's wide region, or those the dwellers in heaven's realm of brightness,
Or those, the Holy, prompt to hear, our helpers, who, car borne, turn their horses hither, Agni---

verses.sa:
ऐभिरग्ने सरथं याह्यर्वाङ्नानारथं वा विभवो ह्यश्वाः ।
पत्नीवतस्त्रिंशतं त्रीँश्च देवाननुष्वधमा वह मादयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
aibhiragne saratham yahyarvannanaratham va vibhavo hyashvah |
patnivatastrimshatam trinshcha devananushvadhama vaha madayasva ||
verses.en:
With these, borne on one ear, Agni, approach us, or borne on many, for thy steeds are able.
Bring, with their Dames, the Gods, the Three and-Thirty, after thy Godlike nature, and be joyful.

verses.sa:
स होता यस्य रोदसी चिदुर्वी यज्ञंयज्ञमभि वृधे गृणीतः ।
प्राची अध्वरेव तस्थतुः सुमेके ऋतावरी ऋतजातस्य सत्ये ॥
verses.rom:
sa hota yasya rodasi chidurvi yajnamyajnamabhi vridhe grinitah |
prachi adhvareva tasthatuh sumeke ritavari ritajatasya satye ||
verses.en:
He is the Priest at whose repeated worship even wide Heaven and Earth sing out for increase.
They fair and true and holy coming forward stand at his sacrifice who springs from Order.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
ilamagne purudamsam sanim goh shashvattamam havamanaya sadha |
syannah sunustanayo vijavagne sa te sumatirbhutvasme ||
verses.en:
As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.
To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to usward.

verses.sa:
प्र य आरुः शितिपृष्ठस्य धासेरा मातरा विविशुः सप्त वाणीः ।
परिक्षिता पितरा सं चरेते प्र सर्स्राते दीर्घमायुः प्रयक्षे ॥
verses.rom:
pra ya aruh shitiprishthasya dhasera matara vivishuh sapta vanih |
parikshita pitara sam charete pra sarsrate dirghamayuh prayakshe ||
verses.en:
THE seven tones risen from the whitebacked viand have made their way between the pair of Mothers.
Both circumjacent Parents come together to yield us length of days they hasten forward.

verses.sa:
दिवक्षसो धेनवो वृष्णो अश्वा देवीरा तस्थौ मधुमद्वहन्तीः ।
ऋतस्य त्वा सदसि क्षेमयन्तं पर्येका चरति वर्तनिं गौः ॥
verses.rom:
divakshaso dhenavo vrishno ashva devira tasthau madhumadvahantih |
ritasya tva sadasi kshemayantam paryeka charati vartanim gauh ||
verses.en:
The Male who dwells in heaven hath Mares and Milch kine: he came to Goddesses who bring sweet treasure.
To thee safe resting in the seat of Order the Cow alone upon her way proceedeth.

verses.sa:
आ सीमरोहत्सुयमा भवन्तीः पतिश्चिकित्वान्रयिविद्रयीणाम् ।
प्र नीलपृष्ठो अतसस्य धासेस्ता अवासयत्पुरुधप्रतीकः ॥
verses.rom:
a simarohatsuyama bhavantih patishchikitvanrayividrayinam |
pra nilaprishtho atasasya dhasesta avasayatpurudhapratikah ||
verses.en:
Wise Master, wealthy finder-out of riches, he mounted those who may with case be guided.
He, dark-backed, manifold with varied aspect, hath made them burst forth from their food the brush-wood.

verses.sa:
महि त्वाष्ट्रमूर्जयन्तीरजुर्यं स्तभूयमानं वहतो वहन्ति ।
व्यङ्गेभिर्दिद्युतानः सधस्थ एकामिव रोदसी आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
mahi tvashtramurjayantirajuryam stabhuyamanam vahato vahanti |
vyangebhirdidyutanah sadhastha ekamiva rodasi a vivesha ||
verses.en:
Strength-giving streams bear hither him eternal, fain to support the mighty work. of Tvastar.
He, flashing in his home with all his members, hath entered both the worlds as they were single.

verses.sa:
जानन्ति वृष्णो अरुषस्य शेवमुत ब्रध्नस्य शासने रणन्ति ।
दिवोरुचः सुरुचो रोचमाना इळा येषां गण्या माहिना गीः ॥
verses.rom:
jananti vrishno arushasya shevamuta bradhnasya shasane rananti |
divoruchah surucho rochamana ila yesham ganya mahina gih ||
verses.en:
They know the red Bull's blessing, and are joyful under the flaming-coloured Lord's dominion:
They who give shine from heaven with fair effulgence, whose lofty song like Ila must be honoured.

verses.sa:
उतो पितृभ्यां प्रविदानु घोषं महो महद्भ्यामनयन्त शूषम् ।
उक्षा ह यत्र परि धानमक्तोरनु स्वं धाम जरितुर्ववक्ष ॥
verses.rom:
uto pitribhyam pravidanu ghosham maho mahadbhyamanayanta shusham |
uksha ha yatra pari dhanamaktoranu svam dhama jariturvavaksha ||
verses.en:
Yea, by tradition from the ancient sages they brought great strength from the two mighty Parents,
To where the singer's Bull, the night's dispeller, after his proper law hath waxen stronger.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्युभिः पञ्चभिः सप्त विप्राः प्रियं रक्षन्ते निहितं पदं वेः ।
प्राञ्चो मदन्त्युक्षणो अजुर्या देवा देवानामनु हि व्रता गुः ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryubhih panchabhih sapta viprah priyam rakshante nihitam padam veh |
prancho madantyukshano ajurya deva devanamanu hi vrata guh ||
verses.en:
Seven holy singers guard with five Adhvaryus the Bird's beloved firmly-settled station.
The willing Bulls, untouched by old, rejoice them: as Gods themselves the ways of Gods they follow.

verses.sa:
दैव्या होतारा प्रथमा न्यृञ्जे सप्त पृक्षासः स्वधया मदन्ति ।
ऋतं शंसन्त ऋतमित्त आहुरनु व्रतं व्रतपा दीध्यानाः ॥
verses.rom:
daivya hotara prathama nyrinje sapta prikshasah svadhaya madanti |
ritam shamsanta ritamitta ahuranu vratam vratapa didhyanah ||
verses.en:
I crave the grace of heaven's two chief Invokers: the seven swift steeds joy in their wonted manner.
These speak of truth, praising the Truth Eternal, thinking on Order as the guards of Order.

verses.sa:
वृषायन्ते महे अत्याय पूर्वीर्वृष्णे चित्राय रश्मयः सुयामाः ।
देव होतर्मन्द्रतरश्चिकित्वान्महो देवान्रोदसी एह वक्षि ॥
verses.rom:
vrishayante mahe atyaya purvirvrishne chitraya rashmayah suyamah |
deva hotarmandratarashchikitvanmaho devanrodasi eha vakshi ||
verses.en:
The many seek the great Steed as a stallion: the reins obey the Lord of varied colour.
O heavenly Priest, most pleasant, full of wisdom, bring the great Gods to us, and Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
पृक्षप्रयजो द्रविणः सुवाचः सुकेतव उषसो रेवदूषुः ।
उतो चिदग्ने महिना पृथिव्याः कृतं चिदेनः सं महे दशस्य ॥
verses.rom:
prikshaprayajo dravinah suvachah suketava ushaso revadushuh |
uto chidagne mahina prithivyah kritam chidenah sam mahe dashasya ||
verses.en:
Rich Lord, the Mornings have gleamed forth in splendour, fair-rayed, fair-speaking, worshipped with all viands,
Yea, with the glory of the earth, O Agni. Forgive us, for our weal, e'en sin committed.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
ilamagne purudamsam sanim goh shashvattamam havamanaya sadha |
syannah sunustanayo vijavagne sa te sumatirbhutvasme ||
verses.en:
As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker, give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.
To us be born a son, and spreading offspring Agni, be this thy gracious will to usward.

verses.sa:
अञ्जन्ति त्वामध्वरे देवयन्तो वनस्पते मधुना दैव्येन ।
यदूर्ध्वस्तिष्ठा द्रविणेह धत्ताद्यद्वा क्षयो मातुरस्या उपस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
anjanti tvamadhvare devayanto vanaspate madhuna daivyena |
yadurdhvastishtha dravineha dhattadyadva kshayo maturasya upasthe ||
verses.en:
GOD-SERVING men, O Sovran of the Forest, with heavenly meath at sacrifice anoint thee.
Grant wealth to us when thou art standing upright as when reposing on this Mother's bosom.

verses.sa:
समिद्धस्य श्रयमाणः पुरस्ताद्ब्रह्म वन्वानो अजरं सुवीरम् ।
आरे अस्मदमतिं बाधमान उच्छ्रयस्व महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.rom:
samiddhasya shrayamanah purastadbrahma vanvano ajaram suviram |
are asmadamatim badhamana uchchhrayasva mahate saubhagaya ||
verses.en:
Set up to eastward of the fire enkindled, accepting prayer that wastes not, rich in hero.
Driving far from us poverty and famine, lift thyself up to bring us great good fortune.

verses.sa:
उच्छ्रयस्व वनस्पते वर्ष्मन्पृथिव्या अधि ।
सुमिती मीयमानो वर्चो धा यज्ञवाहसे ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhrayasva vanaspate varshmanprithivya adhi |
sumiti miyamano varcho dha yajnavahase ||
verses.en:
Lord of the Forest, raise. thyself up on the loftiest spot of earth.
Give splendour, fixt and measured well, to him who brings the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
युवा सुवासाः परिवीत आगात्स उ श्रेयान्भवति जायमानः ।
तं धीरासः कवय उन्नयन्ति स्वाध्यो मनसा देवयन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
yuva suvasah parivita agatsa u shreyanbhavati jayamanah |
tam dhirasah kavaya unnayanti svadhyo manasa devayantah ||
verses.en:
Well-robed, enveloped he is come, the youthful: springing to life his glory waxeth greater.
Contemplative in mind and God-adoring, sages of high intelligence upraise him.

verses.sa:
जातो जायते सुदिनत्वे अह्नां समर्य आ विदथे वर्धमानः ।
पुनन्ति धीरा अपसो मनीषा देवया विप्र उदियर्ति वाचम् ॥
verses.rom:
jato jayate sudinatve ahnam samarya a vidathe vardhamanah |
punanti dhira apaso manisha devaya vipra udiyarti vacham ||
verses.en:
Sprung up he rises in the days' fair weather, increasing in the men-frequented synod.
With song the wise and skillful consecrate him: his voice the God-adoring singer utters.

verses.sa:
यान्वो नरो देवयन्तो निमिम्युर्वनस्पते स्वधितिर्वा ततक्ष ।
ते देवासः स्वरवस्तस्थिवांसः प्रजावदस्मे दिधिषन्तु रत्नम् ॥
verses.rom:
yanvo naro devayanto nimimyurvanaspate svadhitirva tataksha |
te devasah svaravastasthivamsah prajavadasme didhishantu ratnam ||
verses.en:
Ye whom religious men have firmly planted; thou Forest Sovran whom the axe hath fashioned,-
Let those the Stakes divine which here are standing be fain to grant us wealth with store of children.

verses.sa:
ये वृक्णासो अधि क्षमि निमितासो यतस्रुचः ।
ते नो व्यन्तु वार्यं देवत्रा क्षेत्रसाधसः ॥
verses.rom:
ye vriknaso adhi kshami nimitaso yatasruchah |
te no vyantu varyam devatra kshetrasadhasah ||
verses.en:
O men who lift the ladles up, these hewn and planted in the ground,
Bringing a blessing to the field, shall bear our precious gift to Gods.

verses.sa:
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवः सुनीथा द्यावाक्षामा पृथिवी अन्तरिक्षम् ।
सजोषसो यज्ञमवन्तु देवा ऊर्ध्वं कृण्वन्त्वध्वरस्य केतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
aditya rudra vasavah sunitha dyavakshama prithivi antariksham |
sajoshaso yajnamavantu deva urdhvam krinvantvadhvarasya ketum ||
verses.en:
Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, careful leaders, Earth, Heaven, and Prthivi and Air's mid-region,
Accordant Deities shall bless our worship and make our sacrifice's ensign lofty.

verses.sa:
हंसा इव श्रेणिशो यतानाः शुक्रा वसानाः स्वरवो न आगुः ।
उन्नीयमानाः कविभिः पुरस्ताद्देवा देवानामपि यन्ति पाथः ॥
verses.rom:
hamsa iva shrenisho yatanah shukra vasanah svaravo na aguh |
unniyamanah kavibhih purastaddeva devanamapi yanti pathah ||
verses.en:
Like swan's that flee in lengthened line, the Pillars have come to us arrayed in brilliant colour.
They, lifted up on high, by sages, eastward, go forth as Gods to the God's dwelling-places.

verses.sa:
शृङ्गाणीवेच्छृङ्गिणां सं ददृश्रे चषालवन्तः स्वरवः पृथिव्याम् ।
वाघद्भिर्वा विहवे श्रोषमाणा अस्माँ अवन्तु पृतनाज्येषु ॥
verses.rom:
shringanivechchhringinam sam dadrishre chashalavantah svaravah prithivyam |
vaghadbhirva vihave shroshamana asman avantu pritanajyeshu ||
verses.en:
Those Stakes upon the earth with rings that deck them seem to the eye like horns of horned creatures;
Or, as upraised by priests in invocation, let them assist us in the rush to battle.

verses.sa:
वनस्पते शतवल्शो वि रोह सहस्रवल्शा वि वयं रुहेम ।
यं त्वामयं स्वधितिस्तेजमानः प्रणिनाय महते सौभगाय ॥
verses.rom:
vanaspate shatavalsho vi roha sahasravalsha vi vayam ruhema |
yam tvamayam svadhitistejamanah praninaya mahate saubhagaya ||
verses.en:
Lord of the Wood, rise with a hundred branches. with thousand branches may we rise to greatness,
Thou whom this hatchet, with an edge well whetted for great felicity, hath brought before us.

verses.sa:
सखायस्त्वा ववृमहे देवं मर्तास ऊतये ।
अपां नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिं सुप्रतूर्तिमनेहसम् ॥
verses.rom:
sakhayastva vavrimahe devam martasa utaye |
apam napatam subhagam sudiditim supraturtimanehasam ||
verses.en:
WE as thy friends have chosen thee, mortals a God, to be our help,
The Waters' Child, the blessed, the resplendent One, victorious and beyond compare.

verses.sa:
कायमानो वना त्वं यन्मातॄरजगन्नपः ।
न तत्ते अग्ने प्रमृषे निवर्तनं यद्दूरे सन्निहाभवः ॥
verses.rom:
kayamano vana tvam yanmatrirajagannapah |
na tatte agne pramrishe nivartanam yaddure sannihabhavah ||
verses.en:
Since thou delighting in the woods hast gone unto thy mother streams,
Not to be scorned, Agni, is that return of thine when from afar thou now art here.

verses.sa:
अति तृष्टं ववक्षिथाथैव सुमना असि ।
प्रप्रान्ये यन्ति पर्यन्य आसते येषां सख्ये असि श्रितः ॥
verses.rom:
ati trishtam vavakshithathaiva sumana asi |
prapranye yanti paryanya asate yesham sakhye asi shritah ||
verses.en:
O'er pungent smoke host thou prevailed, and thus art thou benevolent.
Some go before, and others round about thee sit, they in whose friendship thou hast place.

verses.sa:
ईयिवांसमति स्रिधः शश्वतीरति सश्चतः ।
अन्वीमविन्दन्निचिरासो अद्रुहोऽप्सु सिंहमिव श्रितम् ॥
verses.rom:
iyivamsamati sridhah shashvatirati sashchatah |
anvimavindannichiraso adruho'psu simhamiva shritam ||
verses.en:
Him who had passed beyond his foes, beyond continual pursuits,
Him the unerring Ones, observant, found in floods, couched like a lion in his lair.

verses.sa:
ससृवांसमिव त्मनाग्निमित्था तिरोहितम् ।
ऐनं नयन्मातरिश्वा परावतो देवेभ्यो मथितं परि ॥
verses.rom:
sasrivamsamiva tmanagnimittha tirohitam |
ainam nayanmatarishva paravato devebhyo mathitam pari ||
verses.en:
Him wandering at his own free will, Agni here hidden from our view,
Him Matarisvan brought to us from far away produced by friction, from the Gods.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा मर्ता अगृभ्णत देवेभ्यो हव्यवाहन ।
विश्वान्यद्यज्ञाँ अभिपासि मानुष तव क्रत्वा यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva marta agribhnata devebhyo havyavahana |
vishvanyadyajnan abhipasi manusha tava kratva yavishthya ||
verses.en:
O Bearer of Oblations, thus mortals received thee from the Gods,
Whilst thou, the Friend of man, guardest each sacrifice with thine own power, Most Youthful One.

verses.sa:
तद्भद्रं तव दंसना पाकाय चिच्छदयति ।
त्वां यदग्ने पशवः समासते समिद्धमपिशर्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
tadbhadram tava damsana pakaya chichchhadayati |
tvam yadagne pashavah samasate samiddhamapisharvare ||
verses.en:
Amid thy wonders this is good, yea, to the simple is it clear,
When gathered round about thee, Agni, lie the herds where thou art kindled in the morn.

verses.sa:
आ जुहोता स्वध्वरं शीरं पावकशोचिषम् ।
आशुं दूतमजिरं प्रत्नमीड्यं श्रुष्टी देवं सपर्यत ॥
verses.rom:
a juhota svadhvaram shiram pavakashochisham |
ashum dutamajiram pratnamidyam shrushti devam saparyata ||
verses.en:
Offer to him who knows fair rites, who burns with purifying glow,
Swift envoy, active, ancient, and adorable: serve ye the God attentively.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि शता त्री सहस्राण्यग्निं त्रिंशच्च देवा नव चासपर्यन् ।
औक्षन्घृतैरस्तृणन्बर्हिरस्मा आदिद्धोतारं न्यसादयन्त ॥
verses.rom:
trini shata tri sahasranyagnim trimshachcha deva nava chasaparyan |
aukshanghritairastrinanbarhirasma adiddhotaram nyasadayanta ||
verses.en:
Three times a hundred Gods and thrice a thousand, and three times ten and nine have worshipped Agni,
For him spread sacred grass, with oil bedewed him, and stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने मनीषिणः सम्राजं चर्षणीनाम् ।
देवं मर्तास इन्धते समध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne manishinah samrajam charshaninam |
devam martasa indhate samadhvare ||
verses.en:
THEE Agni, God, Imperial Lord of all mankind, do mortal men
With understanding kindle at the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
त्वां यज्ञेष्वृत्विजमग्ने होतारमीळते ।
गोपा ऋतस्य दीदिहि स्वे दमे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam yajneshvritvijamagne hotaramilate |
gopa ritasya didihi sve dame ||
verses.en:
They laud thee in their solemn rites, Agni, as Minister and Priest,
Shine forth in thine own home as guardian of the Law.

verses.sa:
स घा यस्ते ददाशति समिधा जातवेदसे ।
सो अग्ने धत्ते सुवीर्यं स पुष्यति ॥
verses.rom:
sa gha yaste dadashati samidha jatavedase |
so agne dhatte suviryam sa pushyati ||
verses.en:
He, verily, who honours thee with fuel, Knower of all life,
He, Agni! wins heroic might, he prospers well.

verses.sa:
स केतुरध्वराणामग्निर्देवेभिरा गमत् ।
अञ्जानः सप्त होतृभिर्हविष्मते ॥
verses.rom:
sa keturadhvaranamagnirdevebhira gamat |
anjanah sapta hotribhirhavishmate ||
verses.en:
Ensign of sacrifices, he, Agni, with Gods is come to us,
Decked by the seven priests, to him who bringeth gifts.

verses.sa:
प्र होत्रे पूर्व्यं वचोऽग्नये भरता बृहत् ।
विपां ज्योतींषि बिभ्रते न वेधसे ॥
verses.rom:
pra hotre purvyam vacho'gnaye bharata brihat |
vipam jyotimshi bibhrate na vedhase ||
verses.en:
To Agni, the Invoking Priest, offer your best, your lofty speech,
To him Ordainer-like who brings the light of songs.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वर्धन्तु नो गिरो यतो जायत उक्थ्यः ।
महे वाजाय द्रविणाय दर्शतः ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vardhantu no giro yato jayata ukthyah |
mahe vajaya dravinaya darshatah ||
verses.en:
Let these our hymns make Agni grow, whence, meet for laud, he springs to life,
To mighty strength and great possession, fair to see.

verses.sa:
अग्ने यजिष्ठो अध्वरे देवान्देवयते यज ।
होता मन्द्रो वि राजस्यति स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
agne yajishtho adhvare devandevayate yaja |
hota mandro vi rajasyati sridhah ||
verses.en:
Best Sacrificer, bring the Gods, O Agni, to the pious man:
A joyful Priest, thy splendour drive our foes afar

verses.sa:
स नः पावक दीदिहि द्युमदस्मे सुवीर्यम् ।
भवा स्तोतृभ्यो अन्तमः स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah pavaka didihi dyumadasme suviryam |
bhava stotribhyo antamah svastaye ||
verses.en:
As such, O Purifier, shine on us heroic glorious might:
Be nearest Friend to those who laud thee, for their weal.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा विप्रा विपन्यवो जागृवांसः समिन्धते ।
हव्यवाहममर्त्यं सहोवृधम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva vipra vipanyavo jagrivamsah samindhate |
havyavahamamartyam sahovridham ||
verses.en:
So, wakeful, versed in sacred hymns, the holy singers kindly thee.
Oblation-bearer, deathless, cherisher of strength.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्होता पुरोहितोऽध्वरस्य विचर्षणिः ।
स वेद यज्ञमानुषक् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhota purohito'dhvarasya vicharshanih |
sa veda yajnamanushak ||
verses.en:
AGNI is Priest, the great High Priest of sacrifice, most swift in act:
He knows the rite in constant course.

verses.sa:
स हव्यवाळमर्त्य उशिग्दूतश्चनोहितः ।
अग्निर्धिया समृण्वति ॥
verses.rom:
sa havyavalamartya ushigdutashchanohitah |
agnirdhiya samrinvati ||
verses.en:
Oblation-bearer, deathless, well inclined, an eager messenger,
Agni comes nigh us with the thought.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्धिया स चेतति केतुर्यज्ञस्य पूर्व्यः ।
अर्थं ह्यस्य तरणि ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdhiya sa chetati keturyajnasya purvyah |
artham hyasya tarani ||
verses.en:
Ensign of sacrifice from of old, Agni well knoweth with his thought
To prosper this man's aim and hope.

verses.sa:
अग्निं सूनुं सनश्रुतं सहसो जातवेदसम् ।
वह्निं देवा अकृण्वत ॥
verses.rom:
agnim sunum sanashrutam sahaso jatavedasam |
vahnim deva akrinvata ||
verses.en:
Agni, illustrious from old time, the Son of Strength who knows all life,
The Gods have made to their Priest.

verses.sa:
अदाभ्यः पुरएता विशामग्निर्मानुषीणाम् ।
तूर्णी रथः सदा नवः ॥
verses.rom:
adabhyah puraeta vishamagnirmanushinam |
turni rathah sada navah ||
verses.en:
Infallible is Agni, he who goes before the tribes of men,
A chariot swift and ever new.

verses.sa:
साह्वान्विश्वा अभियुजः क्रतुर्देवानाममृक्तः ।
अग्निस्तुविश्रवस्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
sahvanvishva abhiyujah kraturdevanamamriktah |
agnistuvishravastamah ||
verses.en:
Strength of the Gods which none may harm, subduing all his enemies,
Agni is mightiest in fame.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रयांसि वाहसा दाश्वाँ अश्नोति मर्त्यः ।
क्षयं पावकशोचिषः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi prayamsi vahasa dashvan ashnoti martyah |
kshayam pavakashochishah ||
verses.en:
By offering sacred food to him the mortal worshipper obtains.
A home from him whose light makes pure.

verses.sa:
परि विश्वानि सुधिताग्नेरश्याम मन्मभिः ।
विप्रासो जातवेदसः ॥
verses.rom:
pari vishvani sudhitagnerashyama manmabhih |
vipraso jatavedasah ||
verses.en:
From Agni, by our hymns, may we gain all things that bring happiness,
Singers of him who knows all life.

verses.sa:
अग्ने विश्वानि वार्या वाजेषु सनिषामहे ।
त्वे देवास एरिरे ॥
verses.rom:
agne vishvani varya vajeshu sanishamahe |
tve devasa erire ||
verses.en:
O Agni, in our deeds of might may we obtain all precious things:
The Gods are centred all in thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं सुतं गीर्भिर्नभो वरेण्यम् ।
अस्य पातं धियेषिता ॥
verses.rom:
indragni a gatam sutam girbhirnabho varenyam |
asya patam dhiyeshita ||
verses.en:
MOVED, Indra-Agni, by our hymn, come to the juice, the precious dew:
Drink ye thereof, impelled by song.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी जरितुः सचा यज्ञो जिगाति चेतनः ।
अया पातमिमं सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
indragni jarituh sacha yajno jigati chetanah |
aya patamimam sutam ||
verses.en:
O Indra-Agni, with the man who lauds you comes the wakening rite:
So drink ye both this juice assured.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमग्निं कविच्छदा यज्ञस्य जूत्या वृणे ।
ता सोमस्येह तृम्पताम् ॥
verses.rom:
indramagnim kavichchhada yajnasya jutya vrine |
ta somasyeha trimpatam ||
verses.en:
Through force of sacrifice I choose Indra-Agni who love the wise:
With Sorna let these sate them here.

verses.sa:
तोशा वृत्रहणा हुवे सजित्वानापराजिता ।
इन्द्राग्नी वाजसातमा ॥
verses.rom:
tosha vritrahana huve sajitvanaparajita |
indragni vajasatama ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni I invoke, joint-victors, bounteous, unsubdued,
Foe-slayers, best to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
प्र वामर्चन्त्युक्थिनो नीथाविदो जरितारः ।
इन्द्राग्नी इष आ वृणे ॥
verses.rom:
pra vamarchantyukthino nithavido jaritarah |
indragni isha a vrine ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni, singers skilled in melody hymn you, bringing lauds:
I choose you for the sacred food.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी नवतिं पुरो दासपत्नीरधूनुतम् ।
साकमेकेन कर्मणा ॥
verses.rom:
indragni navatim puro dasapatniradhunutam |
sakamekena karmana ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni, ye cast down the ninety forts which DAsas held,
Together, with one mighty deed.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी अपसस्पर्युप प्र यन्ति धीतयः ।
ऋतस्य पथ्या अनु ॥
verses.rom:
indragni apasasparyupa pra yanti dhitayah |
ritasya pathya anu ||
verses.en:
To Indra-Agni reverent thoughts go forward from the holy task
Along the path of sacred Law.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी तविषाणि वां सधस्थानि प्रयांसि च ।
युवोरप्तूर्यं हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
indragni tavishani vam sadhasthani prayamsi cha |
yuvorapturyam hitam ||
verses.en:
O Indra-Agni, powers are yours, and dwellings and delightful food
Good is your readiness to act.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी रोचना दिवः परि वाजेषु भूषथः ।
तद्वां चेति प्र वीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
indragni rochana divah pari vajeshu bhushathah |
tadvam cheti pra viryam ||
verses.en:
Indra and Agni, in your deeds of might ye deck heaven's lucid realms:
Famed is that hero strength of yours.

verses.sa:
प्र वो देवायाग्नये बर्हिष्ठमर्चास्मै ।
गमद्देवेभिरा स नो यजिष्ठो बर्हिरा सदत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo devayagnaye barhishthamarchasmai |
gamaddevebhira sa no yajishtho barhira sadat ||
verses.en:
To Agni, to this God of yours I sing aloud with utmost power.
May he come to us with the Gods, and sit, best Offerer, on the grass.

verses.sa:
ऋतावा यस्य रोदसी दक्षं सचन्त ऊतयः ।
हविष्मन्तस्तमीळते तं सनिष्यन्तोऽवसे ॥
verses.rom:
ritava yasya rodasi daksham sachanta utayah |
havishmantastamilate tam sanishyanto'vase ||
verses.en:
The Holy, whose are earth and heaven, and succour waits upon his strength;
Him men who bring oblations laud, and they who wish to gain, for grace.

verses.sa:
स यन्ता विप्र एषां स यज्ञानामथा हि षः ।
अग्निं तं वो दुवस्यत दाता यो वनिता मघम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa yanta vipra esham sa yajnanamatha hi shah |
agnim tam vo duvasyata data yo vanita magham ||
verses.en:
He is the Sage who guides these men, Leader of sacred rites is he.
Him your own Agni, serve ye well, who winneth and bestoweth wealth.

verses.sa:
स नः शर्माणि वीतयेऽग्निर्यच्छतु शंतमा ।
यतो नः प्रुष्णवद्वसु दिवि क्षितिभ्यो अप्स्वा ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah sharmani vitaye'gniryachchhatu shamtama |
yato nah prushnavadvasu divi kshitibhyo apsva ||
verses.en:
So may the gracious Agni grant most goodly shelter for our use;
Whence in the heavens or in the floods he shall pour wealth upon our lands.

verses.sa:
दीदिवांसमपूर्व्यं वस्वीभिरस्य धीतिभिः ।
ऋक्वाणो अग्निमिन्धते होतारं विश्पतिं विशाम् ॥
verses.rom:
didivamsamapurvyam vasvibhirasya dhitibhih |
rikvano agnimindhate hotaram vishpatim visham ||
verses.en:
The singers kindle him, the Priest, Agni the Lord of tribes of men,
Resplendent and without a peer through his own excellent designs.

verses.sa:
उत नो ब्रह्मन्नविष उक्थेषु देवहूतमः ।
शं नः शोचा मरुद्वृधोऽग्ने सहस्रसातमः ॥
verses.rom:
uta no brahmannavisha uktheshu devahutamah |
sham nah shocha marudvridho'gne sahasrasatamah ||
verses.en:
Help us, thou Brahman, best of all invokers of the Gods in song.
Beam, Friend of Maruts, bliss on us, O Agni, a most liberal God.

verses.sa:
नू नो रास्व सहस्रवत्तोकवत्पुष्टिमद्वसु ।
द्युमदग्ने सुवीर्यं वर्षिष्ठमनुपक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
nu no rasva sahasravattokavatpushtimadvasu |
dyumadagne suviryam varshishthamanupakshitam ||
verses.en:
Yea, grant us treasure thousandfold with children and with nourishment,
And, Agni, splendid hero strength, exalted, wasting not away.

verses.sa:
आ होता मन्द्रो विदथान्यस्थात्सत्यो यज्वा कवितमः स वेधाः ।
विद्युद्रथः सहसस्पुत्रो अग्निः शोचिष्केशः पृथिव्यां पाजो अश्रेत् ॥
verses.rom:
a hota mandro vidathanyasthatsatyo yajva kavitamah sa vedhah |
vidyudrathah sahasasputro agnih shochishkeshah prithivyam pajo ashret ||
verses.en:
THE pleasant Priest is come into the synod, true, skilled in sacrifice, most wise, Ordainer.
Agni, the Son of Strength, whose car is lightning, whose hair is flame, hath shown on earth his lustre.

verses.sa:
अयामि ते नमउक्तिं जुषस्व ऋतावस्तुभ्यं चेतते सहस्वः ।
विद्वाँ आ वक्षि विदुषो नि षत्सि मध्य आ बर्हिरूतये यजत्र ॥
verses.rom:
ayami te namauktim jushasva ritavastubhyam chetate sahasvah |
vidvan a vakshi vidusho ni shatsi madhya a barhirutaye yajatra ||
verses.en:
To thee I offer reverent speech: accept it: to thee who markest it, victorious, faithful!
Bring, thou who knowest, those who know, and seat thee amid the sacred grass, for help, O Holy.

verses.sa:
द्रवतां त उषसा वाजयन्ती अग्ने वातस्य पथ्याभिरच्छ ।
यत्सीमञ्जन्ति पूर्व्यं हविर्भिरा वन्धुरेव तस्थतुर्दुरोणे ॥
verses.rom:
dravatam ta ushasa vajayanti agne vatasya pathyabhirachchha |
yatsimanjanti purvyam havirbhira vandhureva tasthaturdurone ||
verses.en:
The Two who show their vigour, Night and Morning, by the wind's paths shall haste to thee O Agni.
When men adorn the Ancient with oblations, these seek, as on two chariot-seats, the dwelling.

verses.sa:
मित्रश्च तुभ्यं वरुणः सहस्वोऽग्ने विश्वे मरुतः सुम्नमर्चन् ।
यच्छोचिषा सहसस्पुत्र तिष्ठा अभि क्षितीः प्रथयन्सूर्यो नॄन् ॥
verses.rom:
mitrashcha tubhyam varunah sahasvo'gne vishve marutah sumnamarchan |
yachchhochisha sahasasputra tishtha abhi kshitih prathayansuryo nrin ||
verses.en:
To thee, strong Agni! Varuna and Mitra and all the Maruts sang a song of triumph,
What time unto the people's lands thou camest, spreading them as the Sun of men, with lustre.

verses.sa:
वयं ते अद्य ररिमा हि काममुत्तानहस्ता नमसोपसद्य ।
यजिष्ठेन मनसा यक्षि देवानस्रेधता मन्मना विप्रो अग्ने ॥
verses.rom:
vayam te adya rarima hi kamamuttanahasta namasopasadya |
yajishthena manasa yakshi devanasredhata manmana vipro agne ||
verses.en:
Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing.
Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit, a Priest with no unfriendly thought, O Agni.

verses.sa:
त्वद्धि पुत्र सहसो वि पूर्वीर्देवस्य यन्त्यूतयो वि वाजाः ।
त्वं देहि सहस्रिणं रयिं नोऽद्रोघेण वचसा सत्यमग्ने ॥
verses.rom:
tvaddhi putra sahaso vi purvirdevasya yantyutayo vi vajah |
tvam dehi sahasrinam rayim no'droghena vachasa satyamagne ||
verses.en:
For, Son of Strength, from thee come many succours, and powers abundant that a God possesses.
Agni, to us with speech that hath no falsehood grant riches, real, to be told in thousands.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं दक्ष कविक्रतो यानीमा देव मर्तासो अध्वरे अकर्म ।
त्वं विश्वस्य सुरथस्य बोधि सर्वं तदग्ने अमृत स्वदेह ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam daksha kavikrato yanima deva martaso adhvare akarma |
tvam vishvasya surathasya bodhi sarvam tadagne amrita svadeha ||
verses.en:
Whatever, God, in sacrifice we mortals have wrought is all for thee, strong, wise of purpose!
Be thou the Friend of each good chariot's master. All this enjoy thou here, immortal Agni.

verses.sa:
वि पाजसा पृथुना शोशुचानो बाधस्व द्विषो रक्षसो अमीवाः ।
सुशर्मणो बृहतः शर्मणि स्यामग्नेरहं सुहवस्य प्रणीतौ ॥
verses.rom:
vi pajasa prithuna shoshuchano badhasva dvisho rakshaso amivah |
susharmano brihatah sharmani syamagneraham suhavasya pranitau ||
verses.en:
RESPLENDENT with thy wide-extending lustre, dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us
May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, the easily-invoked, the good Protector.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अस्या उषसो व्युष्टौ त्वं सूर उदिते बोधि गोपाः ।
जन्मेव नित्यं तनयं जुषस्व स्तोमं मे अग्ने तन्वा सुजात ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no asya ushaso vyushtau tvam sura udite bodhi gopah |
janmeva nityam tanayam jushasva stomam me agne tanva sujata ||
verses.en:
Be thou To us, while now the morn is breaking, be thou a guardian when the Sun hath mounted..
Accept, as men accept a true-born infant, my laud, O Agni nobly born in body.

verses.sa:
त्वं नृचक्षा वृषभानु पूर्वीः कृष्णास्वग्ने अरुषो वि भाहि ।
वसो नेषि च पर्षि चात्यंहः कृधी नो राय उशिजो यविष्ठ ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nrichaksha vrishabhanu purvih krishnasvagne arusho vi bhahi |
vaso neshi cha parshi chatyamhah kridhi no raya ushijo yavishtha ||
verses.en:
Bull, who beholdest men, through many mornings, among the dark ones shine forth red, O Agni.
Lead us, good Lord, and bear us over trouble: Help us who long, Most Youthful God, to riches.

verses.sa:
अषाळ्हो अग्ने वृषभो दिदीहि पुरो विश्वाः सौभगा संजिगीवान् ।
यज्ञस्य नेता प्रथमस्य पायोर्जातवेदो बृहतः सुप्रणीते ॥
verses.rom:
ashalho agne vrishabho didihi puro vishvah saubhaga samjigivan |
yajnasya neta prathamasya payorjatavedo brihatah supranite ||
verses.en:
Shine forth, a Bull invincible, O Agni, winning by conquest all the forts and treasures,
Thou Jatavedas who art skilled in guiding, the chief high saving sacrifice's Leader.

verses.sa:
अच्छिद्रा शर्म जरितः पुरूणि देवाँ अच्छा दीद्यानः सुमेधाः ।
रथो न सस्निरभि वक्षि वाजमग्ने त्वं रोदसी नः सुमेके ॥
verses.rom:
achchhidra sharma jaritah puruni devan achchha didyanah sumedhah |
ratho na sasnirabhi vakshi vajamagne tvam rodasi nah sumeke ||
verses.en:
Lighting Gods hither, Agni, wisest Singer, bring thou to us many and flawless shelters.
Bring vigour, like a car that gathers booty: bring us, O Agni, beauteous Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
प्र पीपय वृषभ जिन्व वाजानग्ने त्वं रोदसी नः सुदोघे ।
देवेभिर्देव सुरुचा रुचानो मा नो मर्तस्य दुर्मतिः परि ष्ठात् ॥
verses.rom:
pra pipaya vrishabha jinva vajanagne tvam rodasi nah sudoghe |
devebhirdeva surucha ruchano ma no martasya durmatih pari shthat ||
verses.en:
Swell, O thou Bull and give those powers an impulse, e'en Earth and Heaven who yield their milk in plenty,
Shining, O God, with Gods in clear effulgence. Let not a mortal's evil will obstruct us.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
ilamagne purudamsam sanim goh shashvattamam havamanaya sadha |
syannah sunustanayo vijavagne sa te sumatirbhutvasme ||
verses.en:
Agni, as holy food to thine invoker, give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.
To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निः सुवीर्यस्येशे महः सौभगस्य ।
राय ईशे स्वपत्यस्य गोमत ईशे वृत्रहथानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagnih suviryasyeshe mahah saubhagasya |
raya ishe svapatyasya gomata ishe vritrahathanam ||
verses.en:
THIS Agni is the Lord of great felicity and hero Strength;
Lord of wealth in herds of kine; Lord of the battles with the foe.

verses.sa:
इमं नरो मरुतः सश्चता वृधं यस्मिन्रायः शेवृधासः ।
अभि ये सन्ति पृतनासु दूढ्यो विश्वाहा शत्रुमादभुः ॥
verses.rom:
imam naro marutah sashchata vridham yasminrayah shevridhasah |
abhi ye santi pritanasu dudhyo vishvaha shatrumadabhuh ||
verses.en:
Wait, Maruts, Heroes, upon him the Prosperer in whom is bliss-increasing wealth;
Who in fights ever conquer evil-hearted men, who overcome the enemy.

verses.sa:
स त्वं नो रायः शिशीहि मीढ्वो अग्ने सुवीर्यस्य ।
तुविद्युम्न वर्षिष्ठस्य प्रजावतोऽनमीवस्य शुष्मिणः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam no rayah shishihi midhvo agne suviryasya |
tuvidyumna varshishthasya prajavato'namivasya shushminah ||
verses.en:
As such, O Agni, deal us wealth and hero might, O Bounteous One!
Most lofty, very glorious, rich in progeny, free from disease and full of power.

verses.sa:
चक्रिर्यो विश्वा भुवनाभि सासहिश्चक्रिर्देवेष्वा दुवः ।
आ देवेषु यतत आ सुवीर्य आ शंस उत नृणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
chakriryo vishva bhuvanabhi sasahishchakrirdeveshva duvah |
a deveshu yatata a suvirya a shamsa uta nrinam ||
verses.en:
He who made all that lives, who passes all in might, who orders service to the Gods,
He works among the Gods, he works in hero strength, yea, also in the praise of men.

verses.sa:
मा नो अग्नेऽमतये मावीरतायै रीरधः ।
मागोतायै सहसस्पुत्र मा निदेऽप द्वेषांस्या कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
ma no agne'mataye maviratayai riradhah |
magotayai sahasasputra ma nide'pa dveshamsya kridhi ||
verses.en:
Give us not up to indigence, Agni, nor want of hero sons,
Nor, Son of Strength, to lack of cattle, nor to blame. Drive. thou our enemies away.

verses.sa:
शग्धि वाजस्य सुभग प्रजावतोऽग्ने बृहतो अध्वरे ।
सं राया भूयसा सृज मयोभुना तुविद्युम्न यशस्वता ॥
verses.rom:
shagdhi vajasya subhaga prajavato'gne brihato adhvare |
sam raya bhuyasa srija mayobhuna tuvidyumna yashasvata ||
verses.en:
Help us to strength, blest Agni! rich in progeny, abundant, in our sacrifice.
Flood us with riches yet more plenteous, bringing weal, with high renown, most Glorious One!

verses.sa:
समिध्यमानः प्रथमानु धर्मा समक्तुभिरज्यते विश्ववारः ।
शोचिष्केशो घृतनिर्णिक्पावकः सुयज्ञो अग्निर्यजथाय देवान् ॥
verses.rom:
samidhyamanah prathamanu dharma samaktubhirajyate vishvavarah |
shochishkesho ghritanirnikpavakah suyajno agniryajathaya devan ||
verses.en:
DULY enkindled after ancient customs, bringing all treasures, he is balmed with unguents,-
Flame-haired, oil-clad, the purifying Agni, skilled in fair rites, to bring the Gods for worship.

verses.sa:
यथायजो होत्रमग्ने पृथिव्या यथा दिवो जातवेदश्चिकित्वान् ।
एवानेन हविषा यक्षि देवान्मनुष्वद्यज्ञं प्र तिरेममद्य ॥
verses.rom:
yathayajo hotramagne prithivya yatha divo jatavedashchikitvan |
evanena havisha yakshi devanmanushvadyajnam pra tiremamadya ||
verses.en:
As thou, O Agni, skillful Jatavedas, hast sacrificed as Priest of Earth, of Heaven,
So with this offering bring the Gods, and prosper this sacrifice today as erst for Manu.

verses.sa:
त्रीण्यायूंषि तव जातवेदस्तिस्र आजानीरुषसस्ते अग्ने ।
ताभिर्देवानामवो यक्षि विद्वानथा भव यजमानाय शं योः ॥
verses.rom:
trinyayumshi tava jatavedastisra ajanirushasaste agne |
tabhirdevanamavo yakshi vidvanatha bhava yajamanaya sham yoh ||
verses.en:
Three are thy times of life, O Jatavedas, and the three mornings are thy births, O Agni.
With these, well-knowing, grant the Gods' kind favour, and help in stir aid stress the man who worships.

verses.sa:
अग्निं सुदीतिं सुदृशं गृणन्तो नमस्यामस्त्वेड्यं जातवेदः ।
त्वां दूतमरतिं हव्यवाहं देवा अकृण्वन्नमृतस्य नाभिम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim suditim sudrisham grinanto namasyamastvedyam jatavedah |
tvam dutamaratim havyavaham deva akrinvannamritasya nabhim ||
verses.en:
Agni most bright and fair with song we honour, yea, the adorable, O Jatavedas.
Thee, envoy, messenger, oblation-bearer, the Gods have made centre of life eternal.

verses.sa:
यस्त्वद्धोता पूर्वो अग्ने यजीयान्द्विता च सत्ता स्वधया च शम्भुः ।
तस्यानु धर्म प्र यजा चिकित्वोऽथ नो धा अध्वरं देववीतौ ॥
verses.rom:
yastvaddhota purvo agne yajiyandvita cha satta svadhaya cha shambhuh |
tasyanu dharma pra yaja chikitvo'tha no dha adhvaram devavitau ||
verses.en:
That Priest before thee, yet more skilled in worship, stablished of old, healthgiver by his nature,-
After his custom offer, thou who knowest, and lay our sacrifice where Gods may taste it.

verses.sa:
भवा नो अग्ने सुमना उपेतौ सखेव सख्ये पितरेव साधुः ।
पुरुद्रुहो हि क्षितयो जनानां प्रति प्रतीचीर्दहतादरातीः ॥
verses.rom:
bhava no agne sumana upetau sakheva sakhye pitareva sadhuh |
purudruho hi kshitayo jananam prati pratichirdahatadaratih ||
verses.en:
AGNI, be kind to us when we approach thee good as a friend to friend, as sire and mother.
The races of mankind are great oppressors burn up malignity that strives against us.

verses.sa:
तपो ष्वग्ने अन्तराँ अमित्रान्तपा शंसमररुषः परस्य ।
तपो वसो चिकितानो अचित्तान्वि ते तिष्ठन्तामजरा अयासः ॥
verses.rom:
tapo shvagne antaran amitrantapa shamsamararushah parasya |
tapo vaso chikitano achittanvi te tishthantamajara ayasah ||
verses.en:
Agni, burn up the unfriendly who are near us, burn thou the foeman's curse who pays no worship.
Burn, Vasu, thou who markest well, the foolish: let thine eternal nimble beams surround thee.

verses.sa:
इध्मेनाग्न इच्छमानो घृतेन जुहोमि हव्यं तरसे बलाय ।
यावदीशे ब्रह्मणा वन्दमान इमां धियं शतसेयाय देवीम् ॥
verses.rom:
idhmenagna ichchhamano ghritena juhomi havyam tarase balaya |
yavadishe brahmana vandamana imam dhiyam shataseyaya devim ||
verses.en:
With fuel, Agni, and with oil, desirous, mine offering I present for strength and conquest,
With prayer, so far as I have power, adoring-this hymn divine to gain a hundred treasures.

verses.sa:
उच्छोचिषा सहसस्पुत्र स्तुतो बृहद्वयः शशमानेषु धेहि ।
रेवदग्ने विश्वामित्रेषु शं योर्मर्मृज्मा ते तन्वं भूरि कृत्वः ॥
verses.rom:
uchchhochisha sahasasputra stuto brihadvayah shashamaneshu dhehi |
revadagne vishvamitreshu sham yormarmrijma te tanvam bhuri kritvah ||
verses.en:
Give with thy glow, thou Son of Strength, when lauded, great vital power to those who toil to serve thee.
Give richly, Agni, to the Visvamitras in rest and stir. Oft have we decked thy body.

verses.sa:
कृधि रत्नं सुसनितर्धनानां स घेदग्ने भवसि यत्समिद्धः ।
स्तोतुर्दुरोणे सुभगस्य रेवत्सृप्रा करस्ना दधिषे वपूंषि ॥
verses.rom:
kridhi ratnam susanitardhananam sa ghedagne bhavasi yatsamiddhah |
stoturdurone subhagasya revatsripra karasna dadhishe vapumshi ||
verses.en:
Give us, O liberal Lord, great store of riches, for, Agni, such art thou when duly kindled.
Thou in the happy singer's home bestowest, amply with arms extended, things of beauty.

verses.sa:
अग्निं होतारं प्र वृणे मियेधे गृत्सं कविं विश्वविदममूरम् ।
स नो यक्षद्देवताता यजीयान्राये वाजाय वनते मघानि ॥
verses.rom:
agnim hotaram pra vrine miyedhe gritsam kavim vishvavidamamuram |
sa no yakshaddevatata yajiyanraye vajaya vanate maghani ||
verses.en:
How, quick, sage, infallible, all-knowing, I choose to be our Priest at this oblation.
In our Gods' service he, best skilled, shall worship: may he obtain us boons for strength and riches.

verses.sa:
प्र ते अग्ने हविष्मतीमियर्म्यच्छा सुद्युम्नां रातिनीं घृताचीम् ।
प्रदक्षिणिद्देवतातिमुराणः सं रातिभिर्वसुभिर्यज्ञमश्रेत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra te agne havishmatimiyarmyachchha sudyumnam ratinim ghritachim |
pradakshiniddevatatimuranah sam ratibhirvasubhiryajnamashret ||
verses.en:
Agni, to thee I lift the oil-fed ladle, bright, with an offering, bearing our oblation.
From the right hand, choosing the Gods' attendance, he with rich presents hath arranged the worship.

verses.sa:
स तेजीयसा मनसा त्वोत उत शिक्ष स्वपत्यस्य शिक्षोः ।
अग्ने रायो नृतमस्य प्रभूतौ भूयाम ते सुष्टुतयश्च वस्वः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tejiyasa manasa tvota uta shiksha svapatyasya shikshoh |
agne rayo nritamasya prabhutau bhuyama te sushtutayashcha vasvah ||
verses.en:
Of keenest spirit is the man thou aidest give us good offspring, thou who givest freely.
In power of wealth most rich in men. O Agni, of thee, the Good, may we sing forth fair praises.

verses.sa:
भूरीणि हि त्वे दधिरे अनीकाग्ने देवस्य यज्यवो जनासः ।
स आ वह देवतातिं यविष्ठ शर्धो यदद्य दिव्यं यजासि ॥
verses.rom:
bhurini hi tve dadhire anikagne devasya yajyavo janasah |
sa a vaha devatatim yavishtha shardho yadadya divyam yajasi ||
verses.en:
Men as they worship thee the God, O Agni, have set on thee full many a brilliant, aspect.
So bring Most Youthful One, the Gods' asserrigly, the Heavenly Host which thou to-day shalt honour.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा होतारमनजन्मियेधे निषादयन्तो यजथाय देवाः ।
स त्वं नो अग्नेऽवितेह बोध्यधि श्रवांसि धेहि नस्तनूषु ॥
verses.rom:
yattva hotaramanajanmiyedhe nishadayanto yajathaya devah |
sa tvam no agne'viteha bodhyadhi shravamsi dhehi nastanushu ||
verses.en:
When Gods anoint thee Priest at their oblation, and seat thee for thy task as Sacrificer,
O Agni, be thou here our kind defender, and to ourselves vouchsafe the gift of glory.

verses.sa:
अग्निमुषसमश्विना दधिक्रां व्युष्टिषु हवते वह्निरुक्थैः ।
सुज्योतिषो नः शृण्वन्तु देवाः सजोषसो अध्वरं वावशानाः ॥
verses.rom:
agnimushasamashvina dadhikram vyushtishu havate vahnirukthaih |
sujyotisho nah shrinvantu devah sajoshaso adhvaram vavashanah ||
verses.en:
WITH lauds at break of morn the priest invoketh Agni, Dawn, Dadhikras, and both the Asvins.
With one consent the Gods whose light is splendid, longing to taste our sacrifice, shall hear us.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्री ते वाजिना त्री षधस्था तिस्रस्ते जिह्वा ऋतजात पूर्वीः ।
तिस्र उ ते तन्वो देववातास्ताभिर्नः पाहि गिरो अप्रयुच्छन् ॥
verses.rom:
agne tri te vajina tri shadhastha tisraste jihva ritajata purvih |
tisra u te tanvo devavatastabhirnah pahi giro aprayuchchhan ||
verses.en:
Three are thy powers, O Agni, three thy stations, three are thy tongues, yea, many, Child of Order!
Three bodies hast thou which the Gods delight in: with these protect our hymns with care unceasing.

verses.sa:
अग्ने भूरीणि तव जातवेदो देव स्वधावोऽमृतस्य नाम ।
याश्च माया मायिनां विश्वमिन्व त्वे पूर्वीः संदधुः पृष्टबन्धो ॥
verses.rom:
agne bhurini tava jatavedo deva svadhavo'mritasya nama |
yashcha maya mayinam vishvaminva tve purvih samdadhuh prishtabandho ||
verses.en:
O Agni, many are the names thou bearest, immortal, God, Divine, and Jatavedas.
And many charms of charmers, All-Inspirer! have they laid in thee, Lord of true attendants!

verses.sa:
अग्निर्नेता भग इव क्षितीनां दैवीनां देव ऋतुपा ऋतावा ।
स वृत्रहा सनयो विश्ववेदाः पर्षद्विश्वाति दुरिता गृणन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirneta bhaga iva kshitinam daivinam deva ritupa ritava |
sa vritraha sanayo vishvavedah parshadvishvati durita grinantam ||
verses.en:
Agni, like Bhaga, leads the godly people, he who is true to Law and guards the seasons.
Ancient, all-knowing, he the Vrtra-slayer shall bear the singer safe through every trouble.

verses.sa:
दधिक्रामग्निमुषसं च देवीं बृहस्पतिं सवितारं च देवम् ।
अश्विना मित्रावरुणा भगं च वसून्रुद्राँ आदित्याँ इह हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
dadhikramagnimushasam cha devim brihaspatim savitaram cha devam |
ashvina mitravaruna bhagam cha vasunrudran adityan iha huve ||
verses.en:
I call on Savitar the God, on Morning, Brhaspati, and Dadhikras, and Agni,
On Varuna and Mitra, on the Asvins, Bhaga, the Vasus, Rudras and Adityas.

verses.sa:
इमं नो यज्ञममृतेषु धेहीमा हव्या जातवेदो जुषस्व ।
स्तोकानामग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य होतः प्राशान प्रथमो निषद्य ॥
verses.rom:
imam no yajnamamriteshu dhehima havya jatavedo jushasva |
stokanamagne medaso ghritasya hotah prashana prathamo nishadya ||
verses.en:
SET this our sacrifice among the Immortals: be pleased with these our presents, Jatavedas.
O Priest, O Agni, sit thee down before us, and first enjoy the drops of oil and fatness.

verses.sa:
घृतवन्तः पावक ते स्तोका श्चोतन्ति मेदसः ।
स्वधर्मन्देववीतये श्रेष्ठं नो धेहि वार्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ghritavantah pavaka te stoka shchotanti medasah |
