svadharmandevavitaye shreshtham no dhehi varyam ||
verses.en:
For thee, O Purifier, flow the drops of fatness rich in oil.
After thy wont vouchsafe to us the choicest boon that Gods may feast.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं स्तोका घृतश्चुतोऽग्ने विप्राय सन्त्य ।
ऋषिः श्रेष्ठः समिध्यसे यज्ञस्य प्राविता भव ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam stoka ghritashchuto'gne vipraya santya |
rishih shreshthah samidhyase yajnasya pravita bhava ||
verses.en:
Agni, Most Excellent! for thee the Sage are drops that drip with oil.
Thou art enkindled as the best of Seers. Help thou the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं श्चोतन्त्यध्रिगो शचीव स्तोकासो अग्ने मेदसो घृतस्य ।
कविशस्तो बृहता भानुनागा हव्या जुषस्व मेधिर ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam shchotantyadhrigo shachiva stokaso agne medaso ghritasya |
kavishasto brihata bhanunaga havya jushasva medhira ||
verses.en:
To thee, O Agni, mighty and resistless, to thee stream forth the drops of oil and fatness.
With great light art thou come, O praised by poets! Accept our offering, O thou Sage.

verses.sa:
ओजिष्ठं ते मध्यतो मेद उद्भृतं प्र ते वयं ददामहे ।
श्चोतन्ति ते वसो स्तोका अधि त्वचि प्रति तान्देवशो विहि ॥
verses.rom:
ojishtham te madhyato meda udbhritam pra te vayam dadamahe |
shchotanti te vaso stoka adhi tvachi prati tandevasho vihi ||
verses.en:
Fatness exceeding rich, extracted from the midst,-this as our gift we offer thee.
Excellent God, the drops run down upon thy skin. Deal them to each among the Gods.

verses.sa:
अयं सो अग्निर्यस्मिन्सोममिन्द्रः सुतं दधे जठरे वावशानः ।
सहस्रिणं वाजमत्यं न सप्तिं ससवान्सन्स्तूयसे जातवेदः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam so agniryasminsomamindrah sutam dadhe jathare vavashanah |
sahasrinam vajamatyam na saptim sasavansanstuyase jatavedah ||
verses.en:
THIS is that Agni whence the longing Indra took the pressed Soma deep within his body.
Winner of spoils in thousands, like a courser, with praise art thou exalted, Jatavedas.

verses.sa:
अग्ने यत्ते दिवि वर्चः पृथिव्यां यदोषधीष्वप्स्वा यजत्र ।
येनान्तरिक्षमुर्वाततन्थ त्वेषः स भानुरर्णवो नृचक्षाः ॥
verses.rom:
agne yatte divi varchah prithivyam yadoshadhishvapsva yajatra |
yenantarikshamurvatatantha tveshah sa bhanurarnavo nrichakshah ||
verses.en:
That light of thine in heaven and earth, O Agni, in plants, O Holy One, and in the waters,
Wherewith thou hast spread wide the air's mid-region-bright is that splendour, wavy, man-beholding.

verses.sa:
अग्ने दिवो अर्णमच्छा जिगास्यच्छा देवाँ ऊचिषे धिष्ण्या ये ।
या रोचने परस्तात्सूर्यस्य याश्चावस्तादुपतिष्ठन्त आपः ॥
verses.rom:
agne divo arnamachchha jigasyachchha devan uchishe dhishnya ye |
ya rochane parastatsuryasya yashchavastadupatishthanta apah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, to the sea of heaven thou goest: thou hast called hither Gods beheld in spirit.
The waters, too, come hither, those up yonder in the Sun's realm of light, and those beneath it.

verses.sa:
पुरीष्यासो अग्नयः प्रावणेभिः सजोषसः ।
जुषन्तां यज्ञमद्रुहोऽनमीवा इषो महीः ॥
verses.rom:
purishyaso agnayah pravanebhih sajoshasah |
jushantam yajnamadruho'namiva isho mahih ||
verses.en:
Let fires that dwell in mist, combined with those that have their home in floods,
Guileless accept our sacrifice, great viands free from all disease.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
ilamagne purudamsam sanim goh shashvattamam havamanaya sadha |
syannah sunustanayo vijavagne sa te sumatirbhutvasme ||
verses.en:
Agni, as holy food to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.
To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sa:
निर्मथितः सुधित आ सधस्थे युवा कविरध्वरस्य प्रणेता ।
जूर्यत्स्वग्निरजरो वनेष्वत्रा दधे अमृतं जातवेदाः ॥
verses.rom:
nirmathitah sudhita a sadhasthe yuva kaviradhvarasya praneta |
juryatsvagnirajaro vaneshvatra dadhe amritam jatavedah ||
verses.en:
RUBBED into life, well stablished in the dwelling, Leader of sacrifice, the Sage, the youthful,
Here in the wasting fuel Jatavedas, eternal, hath assumed immortal being.

verses.sa:
अमन्थिष्टां भारता रेवदग्निं देवश्रवा देववातः सुदक्षम् ।
अग्ने वि पश्य बृहताभि रायेषां नो नेता भवतादनु द्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
amanthishtam bharata revadagnim devashrava devavatah sudaksham |
agne vi pashya brihatabhi rayesham no neta bhavatadanu dyun ||
verses.en:
Both Bharatas, Devasravas, Devavata, have strongly rubbed to life effectual Agni.
O Agni, look thou forth with ample riches: be, every day, bearer of food to feed us.

verses.sa:
दश क्षिपः पूर्व्यं सीमजीजनन्सुजातं मातृषु प्रियम् ।
अग्निं स्तुहि दैववातं देवश्रवो यो जनानामसद्वशी ॥
verses.rom:
dasha kshipah purvyam simajijanansujatam matrishu priyam |
agnim stuhi daivavatam devashravo yo jananamasadvashi ||
verses.en:
Him nobly born of old the fingers ten produced, him whom his Mothers counted dear.
Praise Devavata's Agni, thou Devasravas, him who shall be the people's Lord.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा दधे वर आ पृथिव्या इळायास्पदे सुदिनत्वे अह्नाम् ।
दृषद्वत्यां मानुष आपयायां सरस्वत्यां रेवदग्ने दिदीहि ॥
verses.rom:
ni tva dadhe vara a prithivya ilayaspade sudinatve ahnam |
drishadvatyam manusha apayayam sarasvatyam revadagne didihi ||
verses.en:
He set thee in the earth's most lovely station, in Ila's place, in days of fair bright weather.
On man, on Apaya, Agni! on the rivers Drsadvati, Sarasvati, shine richly.

verses.sa:
इळामग्ने पुरुदंसं सनिं गोः शश्वत्तमं हवमानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः सूनुस्तनयो विजावाग्ने सा ते सुमतिर्भूत्वस्मे ॥
verses.rom:
ilamagne purudamsam sanim goh shashvattamam havamanaya sadha |
syannah sunustanayo vijavagne sa te sumatirbhutvasme ||
verses.en:
Agni, as holy food to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels.
To us be born a son and spreading offspring Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward

verses.sa:
अग्ने सहस्व पृतना अभिमातीरपास्य ।
दुष्टरस्तरन्नरातीर्वर्चो धा यज्ञवाहसे ॥
verses.rom:
agne sahasva pritana abhimatirapasya |
dushtarastarannaratirvarcho dha yajnavahase ||
verses.en:
AGNI, subdue opposing bands, and drive our enemies away.
Invincible, slay godless foes: give splendour to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
अग्न इळा समिध्यसे वीतिहोत्रो अमर्त्यः ।
जुषस्व सू नो अध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
agna ila samidhyase vitihotro amartyah |
jushasva su no adhvaram ||
verses.en:
Lit with libation, Agni, thou, deathless, who callest Gods to feast,
Accept our sacrifice with joy.

verses.sa:
अग्ने द्युम्नेन जागृवे सहसः सूनवाहुत ।
एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
verses.rom:
agne dyumnena jagrive sahasah sunavahuta |
edam barhih sado mama ||
verses.en:
With splendour, Agni, Son of Strength, thou who art worshipped, wakeful One.
Seat thee on this my sacred grass.

verses.sa:
अग्ने विश्वेभिरग्निभिर्देवेभिर्महया गिरः ।
यज्ञेषु य उ चायवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vishvebhiragnibhirdevebhirmahaya girah |
yajneshu ya u chayavah ||
verses.en:
With all thy fires, with all the Gods, Agni, exalt the songs we sing.
And living men in holy rites.

verses.sa:
अग्ने दा दाशुषे रयिं वीरवन्तं परीणसम् ।
शिशीहि नः सूनुमतः ॥
verses.rom:
agne da dashushe rayim viravantam parinasam |
shishihi nah sunumatah ||
verses.en:
Grant, Agni, to the worshipper wealth rich in heroes, plenteous store,
Make thou us rich with many sons.

verses.sa:
अग्ने दिवः सूनुरसि प्रचेतास्तना पृथिव्या उत विश्ववेदाः ।
ऋधग्देवाँ इह यजा चिकित्वः ॥
verses.rom:
agne divah sunurasi prachetastana prithivya uta vishvavedah |
ridhagdevan iha yaja chikitvah ||
verses.en:
THOU art the sapient Son of Dyaus, O Agni, yes and the Child of Earth, who knowest all things.
Bring the Gods specially, thou Sage, for worship.

verses.sa:
अग्निः सनोति वीर्याणि विद्वान्सनोति वाजममृताय भूषन् ।
स नो देवाँ एह वहा पुरुक्षो ॥
verses.rom:
agnih sanoti viryani vidvansanoti vajamamritaya bhushan |
sa no devan eha vaha puruksho ||
verses.en:
Agni the wise bestows the might of heroes grants strengthening food, preparing it for nectar.
Thou who art rich in food bring the Gods hither.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्द्यावापृथिवी विश्वजन्ये आ भाति देवी अमृते अमूरः ।
क्षयन्वाजैः पुरुश्चन्द्रो नमोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdyavaprithivi vishvajanye a bhati devi amrite amurah |
kshayanvajaih purushchandro namobhih ||
verses.en:
Agni, infallible, lights Earth and Heaven, immortal Goddesses gracious to all men,-
Lord through his strength, splendid through adorations.

verses.sa:
अग्न इन्द्रश्च दाशुषो दुरोणे सुतावतो यज्ञमिहोप यातम् ।
अमर्धन्ता सोमपेयाय देवा ॥
verses.rom:
agna indrashcha dashusho durone sutavato yajnamihopa yatam |
amardhanta somapeyaya deva ||
verses.en:
Come to the sacrifice, Agni and Indra come to the offerer's house who hath the Soma.
Come, friendly-minded, Gods, to drink the Soma.

verses.sa:
अग्ने अपां समिध्यसे दुरोणे नित्यः सूनो सहसो जातवेदः ।
सधस्थानि महयमान ऊती ॥
verses.rom:
agne apam samidhyase durone nityah suno sahaso jatavedah |
sadhasthani mahayamana uti ||
verses.en:
In the floods' home art thou enkindled, Agni, O Jatavedas, Son of Strength, eternal,
Exalting with thine help the gathering places.

verses.sa:
वैश्वानरं मनसाग्निं निचाय्या हविष्मन्तो अनुषत्यं स्वर्विदम् ।
सुदानुं देवं रथिरं वसूयवो गीर्भी रण्वं कुशिकासो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
vaishvanaram manasagnim nichayya havishmanto anushatyam svarvidam |
sudanum devam rathiram vasuyavo girbhi ranvam kushikaso havamahe ||
verses.en:
REVERING in our heart Agni Vaisvanara, the finder of the light, whose promises are true,
The liberal, gladsome, car-borne God we Kusikas invoke him with oblation, seeking wealth with songs.

verses.sa:
तं शुभ्रमग्निमवसे हवामहे वैश्वानरं मातरिश्वानमुक्थ्यम् ।
बृहस्पतिं मनुषो देवतातये विप्रं श्रोतारमतिथिं रघुष्यदम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam shubhramagnimavase havamahe vaishvanaram matarishvanamukthyam |
brihaspatim manusho devatataye vipram shrotaramatithim raghushyadam ||
verses.en:
That Agni, bright, Vaisvanara, we invoke for help, and Matarisvan worthy of the song of praise;
Brhaspati for man's observance of the Gods, the Singer prompt to hear, the swiftly-moving guest.

verses.sa:
अश्वो न क्रन्दञ्जनिभिः समिध्यते वैश्वानरः कुशिकेभिर्युगेयुगे ।
स नो अग्निः सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं दधातु रत्नममृतेषु जागृविः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvo na krandanjanibhih samidhyate vaishvanarah kushikebhiryugeyuge |
sa no agnih suviryam svashvyam dadhatu ratnamamriteshu jagrivih ||
verses.en:
Age after age Vaisvanara, neighing like a horse, is kindled with the women by the Kusikas.
May Agni, he who wakes among Immortal Gods, grant us heroic strength and wealth in noble steeds.

verses.sa:
प्र यन्तु वाजास्तविषीभिरग्नयः शुभे सम्मिश्लाः पृषतीरयुक्षत ।
बृहदुक्षो मरुतो विश्ववेदसः प्र वेपयन्ति पर्वताँ अदाभ्याः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yantu vajastavishibhiragnayah shubhe sammishlah prishatirayukshata |
brihaduksho maruto vishvavedasah pra vepayanti parvatan adabhyah ||
verses.en:
Let them go forth, the strong, as flames of fire with might. Gathered for victory they have yoked their spotted deer.
Pourers of floods, the Maruts, Masters of all wealth, they who can ne'er be conquered, make the mountains shake.

verses.sa:
अग्निश्रियो मरुतो विश्वकृष्टय आ त्वेषमुग्रमव ईमहे वयम् ।
ते स्वानिनो रुद्रिया वर्षनिर्णिजः सिंहा न हेषक्रतवः सुदानवः ॥
verses.rom:
agnishriyo maruto vishvakrishtaya a tveshamugramava imahe vayam |
te svanino rudriya varshanirnijah simha na heshakratavah sudanavah ||
verses.en:
The Maruts, Friends of men, are glorious as the fire: their mighty and resplendent succour we implore.
Those storming Sons of Rudra clothed in robes of rain, boon-givers of good gifts, roar as the lions roar.

verses.sa:
व्रातंव्रातं गणंगणं सुशस्तिभिरग्नेर्भामं मरुतामोज ईमहे ।
पृषदश्वासो अनवभ्रराधसो गन्तारो यज्ञं विदथेषु धीराः ॥
verses.rom:
vratamvratam ganamganam sushastibhiragnerbhamam marutamoja imahe |
prishadashvaso anavabhraradhaso gantaro yajnam vidatheshu dhirah ||
verses.en:
We, band on band and troop following troop, entreat with fair lauds Agni's splendour and the Maruts' might,
With spotted deer for steeds, with wealth that never fails, they, wise Ones, come to sacrifice at our gatherings.

verses.sa:
अग्निरस्मि जन्मना जातवेदा घृतं मे चक्षुरमृतं म आसन् ।
अर्कस्त्रिधातू रजसो विमानोऽजस्रो घर्मो हविरस्मि नाम ॥
verses.rom:
agnirasmi janmana jataveda ghritam me chakshuramritam ma asan |
arkastridhatu rajaso vimano'jasro gharmo havirasmi nama ||
verses.en:
Agni am I who know, by birth, all creatures. Mine eye is butter, in my mouth is nectar.
I am light threefold, measurer of the region exhaustless heat am I, named burnt-oblation.

verses.sa:
त्रिभिः पवित्रैरपुपोद्ध्यर्कं हृदा मतिं ज्योतिरनु प्रजानन् ।
वर्षिष्ठं रत्नमकृत स्वधाभिरादिद्द्यावापृथिवी पर्यपश्यत् ॥
verses.rom:
tribhih pavitrairapupoddhyarkam hrida matim jyotiranu prajanan |
varshishtham ratnamakrita svadhabhiradiddyavaprithivi paryapashyat ||
verses.en:
Bearing in mind a thought with light accordant, he purified the Sun with three refinings;
By his own nature gained the highest treasure, and looked abroad over the earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
शतधारमुत्समक्षीयमाणं विपश्चितं पितरं वक्त्वानाम् ।
मेळिं मदन्तं पित्रोरुपस्थे तं रोदसी पिपृतं सत्यवाचम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatadharamutsamakshiyamanam vipashchitam pitaram vaktvanam |
melim madantam pitrorupasthe tam rodasi pipritam satyavacham ||
verses.en:
The Spring that fails not with a hundred streamlets, Father inspired of' prayers that men should utter,
The Sparkler, joyous in his Parents' bosom, -him, the Truth-speaker, sate ye, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sa:
प्र वो वाजा अभिद्यवो हविष्मन्तो घृताच्या ।
देवाञ्जिगाति सुम्नयुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra vo vaja abhidyavo havishmanto ghritachya |
devanjigati sumnayuh ||
verses.en:
IN ladle dropping oil your food goes in oblation up to heaven,
Goes to the Gods in search of bliss.

verses.sa:
ईळे अग्निं विपश्चितं गिरा यज्ञस्य साधनम् ।
श्रुष्टीवानं धितावानम् ॥
verses.rom:
ile agnim vipashchitam gira yajnasya sadhanam |
shrushtivanam dhitavanam ||
verses.en:
Agni I laud, the Sage inspired, crowner of sacrifice through song,
Who listens and gives bounteous gifts.

verses.sa:
अग्ने शकेम ते वयं यमं देवस्य वाजिनः ।
अति द्वेषांसि तरेम ॥
verses.rom:
agne shakema te vayam yamam devasya vajinah |
ati dveshamsi tarema ||
verses.en:
O Agni, if we might obtain control of thee the potent God,
Then should we overcome our foes.

verses.sa:
समिध्यमानो अध्वरेऽग्निः पावक ईड्यः ।
शोचिष्केशस्तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
samidhyamano adhvare'gnih pavaka idyah |
shochishkeshastamimahe ||
verses.en:
Kindled at sacrifices he is Agni, hallower, meet for praise,
With flame for hair: to him we seek.

verses.sa:
पृथुपाजा अमर्त्यो घृतनिर्णिक्स्वाहुतः ।
अग्निर्यज्ञस्य हव्यवाट् ॥
verses.rom:
prithupaja amartyo ghritanirniksvahutah |
agniryajnasya havyavat ||
verses.en:
Immortal Agni, shining far, enrobed with oil, well worshipped, bears
The gifts of sacrifice away.

verses.sa:
तं सबाधो यतस्रुच इत्था धिया यज्ञवन्तः ।
आ चक्रुरग्निमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
tam sabadho yatasrucha ittha dhiya yajnavantah |
a chakruragnimutaye ||
verses.en:
The priests with ladles lifted up, worshipping here with holy thought,
Have brought this Agni for our aid.

verses.sa:
होता देवो अमर्त्यः पुरस्तादेति मायया ।
विदथानि प्रचोदयन् ॥
verses.rom:
hota devo amartyah purastadeti mayaya |
vidathani prachodayan ||
verses.en:
Immortal, Sacrificer, God, with wondrous power he leads the way,
Urging the great assembly on.

verses.sa:
वाजी वाजेषु धीयतेऽध्वरेषु प्र णीयते ।
विप्रो यज्ञस्य साधनः ॥
verses.rom:
vaji vajeshu dhiyate'dhvareshu pra niyate |
vipro yajnasya sadhanah ||
verses.en:
Strong, he is set on deeds of strength. In sacrifices led in front,
As Singer he completes the rite.

verses.sa:
धिया चक्रे वरेण्यो भूतानां गर्भमा दधे ।
दक्षस्य पितरं तना ॥
verses.rom:
dhiya chakre varenyo bhutanam garbhama dadhe |
dakshasya pitaram tana ||
verses.en:
Excellent, he was made by thought. The Germ of beings have I gained,
Yea, and die Sire of active strength.

verses.sa:
नि त्वा दधे वरेण्यं दक्षस्येळा सहस्कृत ।
अग्ने सुदीतिमुशिजम् ॥
verses.rom:
ni tva dadhe varenyam dakshasyela sahaskrita |
agne suditimushijam ||
verses.en:
Thee have I stablished, Excellent, O strengthened by the sage's prayer,
Thee, Agni, longing, nobly bright.

verses.sa:
अग्निं यन्तुरमप्तुरमृतस्य योगे वनुषः ।
विप्रा वाजैः समिन्धते ॥
verses.rom:
agnim yanturamapturamritasya yoge vanushah |
vipra vajaih samindhate ||
verses.en:
Agni, the swift and active One, singers, at time of sacrifice,
Eagerly kindle with their food.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपातमध्वरे दीदिवांसमुप द्यवि ।
अग्निमीळे कविक्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
urjo napatamadhvare didivamsamupa dyavi |
agnimile kavikratum ||
verses.en:
Agni the Son of Strength who shines up to the heaven in solemn rites,
The wise of heart, I glorify.

verses.sa:
ईळेन्यो नमस्यस्तिरस्तमांसि दर्शतः ।
समग्निरिध्यते वृषा ॥
verses.rom:
ilenyo namasyastirastamamsi darshatah |
samagniridhyate vrisha ||
verses.en:
Meet to be lauded and adored, showing in beauty through the dark,
Agni, the Strong, is kindled well.

verses.sa:
वृषो अग्निः समिध्यतेऽश्वो न देववाहनः ।
तं हविष्मन्त ईळते ॥
verses.rom:
vrisho agnih samidhyate'shvo na devavahanah |
tam havishmanta ilate ||
verses.en:
Agni is kindled as a bull, like a horse bearer of the Gods:
Men with oblations worship him.

verses.sa:
वृषणं त्वा वयं वृषन्वृषणः समिधीमहि ।
अग्ने दीद्यतं बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
vrishanam tva vayam vrishanvrishanah samidhimahi |
agne didyatam brihat ||
verses.en:
Thee will we kindle as a bull, we who are Bulls ourselves, O Bull.
Thee, Agni, shining mightily.

verses.sa:
अग्ने जुषस्व नो हविः पुरोळाशं जातवेदः ।
प्रातःसावे धियावसो ॥
verses.rom:
agne jushasva no havih purolasham jatavedah |
pratahsave dhiyavaso ||
verses.en:
AGNI who knowest all, accept our offering and the cake of meal,
At dawn's libation, rich in prayer!

verses.sa:
पुरोळा अग्ने पचतस्तुभ्यं वा घा परिष्कृतः ।
तं जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.rom:
purola agne pachatastubhyam va gha parishkritah |
tam jushasva yavishthya ||
verses.en:
Agni, the sacrificial cake hath been prepared and dressed for thee:
Accept it, O Most Youthful God.

verses.sa:
अग्ने वीहि पुरोळाशमाहुतं तिरोअह्न्यम् ।
सहसः सूनुरस्यध्वरे हितः ॥
verses.rom:
agne vihi purolashamahutam tiroahnyam |
sahasah sunurasyadhvare hitah ||
verses.en:
Agni, enjoy the cake of meal and our oblation three days old:
Thou, Son of Strength, art stablished at our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
माध्यंदिने सवने जातवेदः पुरोळाशमिह कवे जुषस्व ।
अग्ने यह्वस्य तव भागधेयं न प्र मिनन्ति विदथेषु धीराः ॥
verses.rom:
madhyamdine savane jatavedah purolashamiha kave jushasva |
agne yahvasya tava bhagadheyam na pra minanti vidatheshu dhirah ||
verses.en:
Here at the midday sacrifice enjoy thou the sacrificial cake, wise, Jatavedas!
Agni, the sages in assemblies never diminish the portion due to thee the Mighty.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तृतीये सवने हि कानिषः पुरोळाशं सहसः सूनवाहुतम् ।
अथा देवेष्वध्वरं विपन्यया धा रत्नवन्तममृतेषु जागृविम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne tritiye savane hi kanishah purolasham sahasah sunavahutam |
atha deveshvadhvaram vipanyaya dha ratnavantamamriteshu jagrivim ||
verses.en:
O Agni, at the third libation take with joy the offered cake of sacrifice, thou, Son of Strength.
Through skill in song bear to the Gods our sacrifice, watchful and fraught with riches, to Immortal God.

verses.sa:
अग्ने वृधान आहुतिं पुरोळाशं जातवेदः ।
जुषस्व तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne vridhana ahutim purolasham jatavedah |
jushasva tiroahnyam ||
verses.en:
O waxing Agni, knower, thou, of all, accept our gifts, the cake,
And that prepared ere yesterday.

verses.sa:
अस्तीदमधिमन्थनमस्ति प्रजननं कृतम् ।
एतां विश्पत्नीमा भराग्निं मन्थाम पूर्वथा ॥
verses.rom:
astidamadhimanthanamasti prajananam kritam |
etam vishpatnima bharagnim manthama purvatha ||
verses.en:
HERE is the gear for friction, here tinder made ready for the spark.
Bring thou the Matron: we will rub Agni in ancient fashion forth.

verses.sa:
अरण्योर्निहितो जातवेदा गर्भ इव सुधितो गर्भिणीषु ।
दिवेदिव ईड्यो जागृवद्भिर्हविष्मद्भिर्मनुष्येभिरग्निः ॥
verses.rom:
aranyornihito jataveda garbha iva sudhito garbhinishu |
divediva idyo jagrivadbhirhavishmadbhirmanushyebhiragnih ||
verses.en:
1n the two fire-sticks Jatavedas lieth, even as the well-set germ in pregnant women,
Agni who day by day must be exalted by men who watch and worship with oblations.

verses.sa:
उत्तानायामव भरा चिकित्वान्सद्यः प्रवीता वृषणं जजान ।
अरुषस्तूपो रुशदस्य पाज इळायास्पुत्रो वयुनेऽजनिष्ट ॥
verses.rom:
uttanayamava bhara chikitvansadyah pravita vrishanam jajana |
arushastupo rushadasya paja ilayasputro vayune'janishta ||
verses.en:
Lay this with care on that which lies extended: straight hath she borne the Steerwhen made prolific.
With his red pillar-radiant is his splendour -in our skilled task is born the Son of Ila.

verses.sa:
इळायास्त्वा पदे वयं नाभा पृथिव्या अधि ।
जातवेदो नि धीमह्यग्ने हव्याय वोळ्हवे ॥
verses.rom:
ilayastva pade vayam nabha prithivya adhi |
jatavedo ni dhimahyagne havyaya volhave ||
verses.en:
In Ila's place we set thee down, upon the central point of earth,
That, Agni Jatavedas, thou mayst bear our offerings to the Gods.

verses.sa:
मन्थता नरः कविमद्वयन्तं प्रचेतसममृतं सुप्रतीकम् ।
यज्ञस्य केतुं प्रथमं पुरस्तादग्निं नरो जनयता सुशेवम् ॥
verses.rom:
manthata narah kavimadvayantam prachetasamamritam supratikam |
yajnasya ketum prathamam purastadagnim naro janayata sushevam ||
verses.en:
Rub into life, ye men, the Sage, the guileless, Immortal, very wise and fair to look on.
O men, bring forth the most propitious Agni, first ensign of the sacrifice to eastward.

verses.sa:
यदी मन्थन्ति बाहुभिर्वि रोचतेऽश्वो न वाज्यरुषो वनेष्वा ।
चित्रो न यामन्नश्विनोरनिवृतः परि वृणक्त्यश्मनस्तृणा दहन् ॥
verses.rom:
yadi manthanti bahubhirvi rochate'shvo na vajyarusho vaneshva |
chitro na yamannashvinoranivritah pari vrinaktyashmanastrina dahan ||
verses.en:
When with their arms they rub him straight he shineth forth like a strong courser, red in colour, in the wood.
Bright, checkless, as it were upon the Atvins' path, lie passeth by the stones and burneth up the grass.

verses.sa:
जातो अग्नी रोचते चेकितानो वाजी विप्रः कविशस्तः सुदानुः ।
यं देवास ईड्यं विश्वविदं हव्यवाहमदधुरध्वरेषु ॥
verses.rom:
jato agni rochate chekitano vaji viprah kavishastah sudanuh |
yam devasa idyam vishvavidam havyavahamadadhuradhvareshu ||
verses.en:
Agni shines forth when born, observant, mighty, the bountiful, the Singar praised by sages;
Whom, as adorable and knowing all things, Gods set at solemn rites as offering bearer.

verses.sa:
सीद होतः स्व उ लोके चिकित्वान्सादया यज्ञं सुकृतस्य योनौ ।
देवावीर्देवान्हविषा यजास्यग्ने बृहद्यजमाने वयो धाः ॥
verses.rom:
sida hotah sva u loke chikitvansadaya yajnam sukritasya yonau |
devavirdevanhavisha yajasyagne brihadyajamane vayo dhah ||
verses.en:
Set thee, O Priest, in, thine own place, observant: lay down the sacrifice in the home of worship.
Thou, dear to Gods, shalt serve them with oblation: Agni, give long life to the sacrificer.

verses.sa:
कृणोत धूमं वृषणं सखायोऽस्रेधन्त इतन वाजमच्छ ।
अयमग्निः पृतनाषाट् सुवीरो येन देवासो असहन्त दस्यून् ॥
verses.rom:
krinota dhumam vrishanam sakhayo'sredhanta itana vajamachchha |
ayamagnih pritanashat suviro yena devaso asahanta dasyun ||
verses.en:
Raise ye a mighty smoke, my fellow-workers! Ye shall attain to wealth without obstruction.
This Agni is the battle-winning Hero by whom the Gods have overcome the Dasyus.

verses.sa:
अयं ते योनिरृत्वियो यतो जातो अरोचथाः ।
तं जानन्नग्न आ सीदाथा नो वर्धया गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam te yonirritviyo yato jato arochathah |
tam janannagna a sidatha no vardhaya girah ||
verses.en:
This is thine ordered place of birth whence sprung to life thou shonest forth.
Knowing this, Agni, sit thee down, and prosper thou the songs we sing.

verses.sa:
तनूनपादुच्यते गर्भ आसुरो नराशंसो भवति यद्विजायते ।
मातरिश्वा यदमिमीत मातरि वातस्य सर्गो अभवत्सरीमणि ॥
verses.rom:
tanunapaduchyate garbha asuro narashamso bhavati yadvijayate |
matarishva yadamimita matari vatasya sargo abhavatsarimani ||
verses.en:
As Germ Celestial he is called Tanunapat, and Narasamsa born diffused in varied shape.
Formed in his Mother he is Matarisvan; he hath, in his course, become the rapid flight of wind.

verses.sa:
सुनिर्मथा निर्मथितः सुनिधा निहितः कविः ।
अग्ने स्वध्वरा कृणु देवान्देवयते यज ॥
verses.rom:
sunirmatha nirmathitah sunidha nihitah kavih |
agne svadhvara krinu devandevayate yaja ||
verses.en:
With strong attrition rubbed to life, laid down with careful hand, a Sage,
Agni, make sacrifices good, and for the pious bring the Gods.

verses.sa:
अजीजनन्नमृतं मर्त्यासोऽस्रेमाणं तरणिं वीळुजम्भम् ।
दश स्वसारो अग्रुवः समीचीः पुमांसं जातमभि सं रभन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
ajijanannamritam martyaso'sremanam taranim vilujambham |
dasha svasaro agruvah samichih pumamsam jatamabhi sam rabhante ||
verses.en:
Mortals have brought to life the God Immortal, the Conqueror with mighty jaws, unfailing.
The sisters ten, unwedded and united, together grasp the Babe, the new-born Infant.

verses.sa:
प्र सप्तहोता सनकादरोचत मातुरुपस्थे यदशोचदूधनि ।
न नि मिषति सुरणो दिवेदिवे यदसुरस्य जठरादजायत ॥
verses.rom:
pra saptahota sanakadarochata maturupasthe yadashochadudhani |
na ni mishati surano divedive yadasurasya jatharadajayata ||
verses.en:
Served by the seven priests, he shone forth from ancient time, when in his Mother's bosom, in her lap, he glowed.
Giving delight each day he closeth not his eye, since from the Asura's body hewas brought to life.

verses.sa:
अमित्रायुधो मरुतामिव प्रयाः प्रथमजा ब्रह्मणो विश्वमिद्विदुः ।
द्युम्नवद्ब्रह्म कुशिकास एरिर एकएको दमे अग्निं समीधिरे ॥
verses.rom:
amitrayudho marutamiva prayah prathamaja brahmano vishvamidviduh |
dyumnavadbrahma kushikasa erira ekaeko dame agnim samidhire ||
verses.en:
Even as the Maruts, onslaughts who attack the foe, those born the first of all knew the full power of prayer.
The Kusikas have made the glorious hymn ascend, and, each one singly in his home, have kindled fire.

verses.sa:
यदद्य त्वा प्रयति यज्ञे अस्मिन्होतश्चिकित्वोऽवृणीमहीह ।
ध्रुवमया ध्रुवमुताशमिष्ठाः प्रजानन्विद्वाँ उप याहि सोमम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya tva prayati yajne asminhotashchikitvo'vrinimahiha |
dhruvamaya dhruvamutashamishthah prajananvidvan upa yahi somam ||
verses.en:
As we, O Priest observant, have elected thee this day, what time the solemn sacrifice began,
So surely hast thou worshipped, surely hast thou toiled: come thou unto the Soma, wise and knowing all.

verses.sa:
इच्छन्ति त्वा सोम्यासः सखायः सुन्वन्ति सोमं दधति प्रयांसि ।
तितिक्षन्ते अभिशस्तिं जनानामिन्द्र त्वदा कश्चन हि प्रकेतः ॥
verses.rom:
ichchhanti tva somyasah sakhayah sunvanti somam dadhati prayamsi |
titikshante abhishastim jananamindra tvada kashchana hi praketah ||
verses.en:
THE friends who offer Soma long to find thee: they pour forth Soma and present their viands.
They bear unmoved the cursing of the people, for all our wisdom comes from thee, O Indra.

verses.sa:
न ते दूरे परमा चिद्रजांस्या तु प्र याहि हरिवो हरिभ्याम् ।
स्थिराय वृष्णे सवना कृतेमा युक्ता ग्रावाणः समिधाने अग्नौ ॥
verses.rom:
na te dure parama chidrajamsya tu pra yahi harivo haribhyam |
sthiraya vrishne savana kritema yukta gravanah samidhane agnau ||
verses.en:
Not far for thee are mid-air's loftiest regions: start hither, Lord of Bays, with thy Bay Horses.
Made for the Firm and Strong are these libations. The pressing-stones are set and fire is kindled.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सुशिप्रो मघवा तरुत्रो महाव्रातस्तुविकूर्मिरृघावान् ।
यदुग्रो धा बाधितो मर्त्येषु क्व त्या ते वृषभ वीर्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
indrah sushipro maghava tarutro mahavratastuvikurmirrighavan |
yadugro dha badhito martyeshu kva tya te vrishabha viryani ||
verses.en:
Fair cheeks hath Indra, Maghavan, the Victor, Lord of a great host, Stormer, strong in action.
What once thou didst in might when mortals vexed thee,-where now, O Bull, are those thy hero exploits?

verses.sa:
त्वं हि ष्मा च्यावयन्नच्युतान्येको वृत्रा चरसि जिघ्नमानः ।
तव द्यावापृथिवी पर्वतासोऽनु व्रताय निमितेव तस्थुः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi shma chyavayannachyutanyeko vritra charasi jighnamanah |
tava dyavaprithivi parvataso'nu vrataya nimiteva tasthuh ||
verses.en:
For, overthrowing what hath ne'er been shaken, thou goest forth alone destroying Vrtras.
For him who followeth thy Law the mountains and heaven and earth stand as if firmly stablished.

verses.sa:
उताभये पुरुहूत श्रवोभिरेको दृळ्हमवदो वृत्रहा सन् ।
इमे चिदिन्द्र रोदसी अपारे यत्संगृभ्णा मघवन्काशिरित्ते ॥
verses.rom:
utabhaye puruhuta shravobhireko drilhamavado vritraha san |
ime chidindra rodasi apare yatsamgribhna maghavankashiritte ||
verses.en:
Yea, Much-invoked! in safety through thy glories alone thou speakest truth as Vrtra's slayer.
E'en these two boundless worlds to thee, O Indra, what time thou graspest them, are but a handful.

verses.sa:
प्र सू त इन्द्र प्रवता हरिभ्यां प्र ते वज्रः प्रमृणन्नेतु शत्रून् ।
जहि प्रतीचो अनूचः पराचो विश्वं सत्यं कृणुहि विष्टमस्तु ॥
verses.rom:
pra su ta indra pravata haribhyam pra te vajrah pramrinannetu shatrun |
jahi praticho anuchah paracho vishvam satyam krinuhi vishtamastu ||
verses.en:
Forthwith thy Bay steeds down the steep, O Indra, forth, crushing foemen, go thy bolt of thunder!
Slay those who meet thee, those who flee, who follow: make all thy promise true; be all completed.

verses.sa:
यस्मै धायुरदधा मर्त्यायाभक्तं चिद्भजते गेह्यं सः ।
भद्रा त इन्द्र सुमतिर्घृताची सहस्रदाना पुरुहूत रातिः ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai dhayuradadha martyayabhaktam chidbhajate gehyam sah |
bhadra ta indra sumatirghritachi sahasradana puruhuta ratih ||
verses.en:
The man to whom thou givest as Provider enjoys domestic plenty undivided.
Blest, Indra, is thy favour dropping fatness: thy worship, Much-invoked! brings gifts in thousands.

verses.sa:
सहदानुं पुरुहूत क्षियन्तमहस्तमिन्द्र सं पिणक्कुणारुम् ।
अभि वृत्रं वर्धमानं पियारुमपादमिन्द्र तवसा जघन्थ ॥
verses.rom:
sahadanum puruhuta kshiyantamahastamindra sam pinakkunarum |
abhi vritram vardhamanam piyarumapadamindra tavasa jaghantha ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, Much-invoked! didst crush to pieces Kunaru handless fiend who dwelt with Danu.
Thou with might, Indra, smotest dead the scorner, the footless Vrtra as he waxed in vigour.

verses.sa:
नि सामनामिषिरामिन्द्र भूमिं महीमपारां सदने ससत्थ ।
अस्तभ्नाद्द्यां वृषभो अन्तरिक्षमर्षन्त्वापस्त्वयेह प्रसूताः ॥
verses.rom:
ni samanamishiramindra bhumim mahimaparam sadane sasattha |
astabhnaddyam vrishabho antarikshamarshantvapastvayeha prasutah ||
verses.en:
Thou hast established in her seat, O Indra, the level earth, vast, vigorous, unbounded.
The Bull hath propped the heaven and air's mid-region. By thee sent onward let the floods flow hither.

verses.sa:
अलातृणो वल इन्द्र व्रजो गोः पुरा हन्तोर्भयमानो व्यार ।
सुगान्पथो अकृणोन्निरजे गाः प्रावन्वाणीः पुरुहूतं धमन्तीः ॥
verses.rom:
alatrino vala indra vrajo goh pura hantorbhayamano vyara |
suganpatho akrinonniraje gah pravanvanih puruhutam dhamantih ||
verses.en:
He who withheld the kine, in silence I yielded in fear before thy blow, O Indra.
He made paths easy to drive forth the cattle. Loud-breathing praises helped the Much-invoked One.

verses.sa:
एको द्वे वसुमती समीची इन्द्र आ पप्रौ पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
उतान्तरिक्षादभि नः समीक इषो रथीः सयुजः शूर वाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
eko dve vasumati samichi indra a paprau prithivimuta dyam |
utantarikshadabhi nah samika isho rathih sayujah shura vajan ||
verses.en:
Indra alone filled full the earth and heaven, the Pair who meet together, rich in treasures.
Yea, bring thou near us from the air's mid-region strength, on thy car, and wholesome food, O Hero.

verses.sa:
दिशः सूर्यो न मिनाति प्रदिष्टा दिवेदिवे हर्यश्वप्रसूताः ।
सं यदानळध्वन आदिदश्वैर्विमोचनं कृणुते तत्त्वस्य ॥
verses.rom:
dishah suryo na minati pradishta divedive haryashvaprasutah |
sam yadanaladhvana adidashvairvimochanam krinute tattvasya ||
verses.en:
Surya transgresses not the ordered limits set daily by the Lord of Tawny Coursers.
When to the goal he comes, his journey ended, his Steeds he looses: this is Indra's doing.

verses.sa:
दिदृक्षन्त उषसो यामन्नक्तोर्विवस्वत्या महि चित्रमनीकम् ।
विश्वे जानन्ति महिना यदागादिन्द्रस्य कर्म सुकृता पुरूणि ॥
verses.rom:
didrikshanta ushaso yamannaktorvivasvatya mahi chitramanikam |
vishve jananti mahina yadagadindrasya karma sukrita puruni ||
verses.en:
Men gladly in the course of night would look on the broad bright front of the refulgent Morning;
And all acknowledge, when she comes in glory, the manifold and goodly works of Indra.

verses.sa:
महि ज्योतिर्निहितं वक्षणास्वामा पक्वं चरति बिभ्रती गौः ।
विश्वं स्वाद्म सम्भृतमुस्रियायां यत्सीमिन्द्रो अदधाद्भोजनाय ॥
verses.rom:
mahi jyotirnihitam vakshanasvama pakvam charati bibhrati gauh |
vishvam svadma sambhritamusriyayam yatsimindro adadhadbhojanaya ||
verses.en:
A mighty splendour rests upon her bosom: bearing ripe milk the Cow, unripe, advances.
All sweetness is collected in the Heifer, sweetness which Indra made for our enjoyment.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र दृह्य यामकोशा अभूवन्यज्ञाय शिक्ष गृणते सखिभ्यः ।
दुर्मायवो दुरेवा मर्त्यासो निषङ्गिणो रिपवो हन्त्वासः ॥
verses.rom:
indra drihya yamakosha abhuvanyajnaya shiksha grinate sakhibhyah |
durmayavo dureva martyaso nishangino ripavo hantvasah ||
verses.en:
Barring the way they come. Be firm, O Indra; aid friends to sacrifice and him who singeth.
These must be slain by thee, malignant mortals, armed with ill arts, our quiver bearing foemen.

verses.sa:
सं घोषः शृण्वेऽवमैरमित्रैर्जही न्येष्वशनिं तपिष्ठाम् ।
वृश्चेमधस्ताद्वि रुजा सहस्व जहि रक्षो मघवन्रन्धयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
sam ghoshah shrinve'vamairamitrairjahi nyeshvashanim tapishtham |
vrishchemadhastadvi ruja sahasva jahi raksho maghavanrandhayasva ||
verses.en:
A cry is beard from enemies most near us: against them send thy fiercest-flaming weapon.
Rend them from under, crush them and subdue them. Slay, Maghavan, and make the fiends our booty.

verses.sa:
उद्वृह रक्षः सहमूलमिन्द्र वृश्चा मध्यं प्रत्यग्रं शृणीहि ।
आ कीवतः सललूकं चकर्थ ब्रह्मद्विषे तपुषिं हेतिमस्य ॥
verses.rom:
udvriha rakshah sahamulamindra vrishcha madhyam pratyagram shrinihi |
a kivatah salalukam chakartha brahmadvishe tapushim hetimasya ||
verses.en:
Root up the race of Raksasas, O Indra rend it in front and crush it in the middle.
How long hast thou bebaved as one who wavers? Cast thy hot dart at him who hates devotion:

verses.sa:
स्वस्तये वाजिभिश्च प्रणेतः सं यन्महीरिष आसत्सि पूर्वीः ।
रायो वन्तारो बृहतः स्यामास्मे अस्तु भग इन्द्र प्रजावान् ॥
verses.rom:
svastaye vajibhishcha pranetah sam yanmahirisha asatsi purvih |
rayo vantaro brihatah syamasme astu bhaga indra prajavan ||
verses.en:
When borne by strong Steeds for our weal, O Leader, thou seatest thee at many noble viands.
May we be winners of abundant riches. May Indra be our wealth with store of children.

verses.sa:
आ नो भर भगमिन्द्र द्युमन्तं नि ते देष्णस्य धीमहि प्ररेके ।
ऊर्व इव पप्रथे कामो अस्मे तमा पृण वसुपते वसूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no bhara bhagamindra dyumantam ni te deshnasya dhimahi prareke |
urva iva paprathe kamo asme tama prina vasupate vasunam ||
verses.en:
Bestow on us resplendent wealth. O Indra let us enjoy thine overflow of bounty.
Wide as a sea our longing hath expanded, fulfil it, O thou Treasure-Lord of treasures.

verses.sa:
इमं कामं मन्दया गोभिरश्वैश्चन्द्रवता राधसा पप्रथश्च ।
स्वर्यवो मतिभिस्तुभ्यं विप्रा इन्द्राय वाहः कुशिकासो अक्रन् ॥
verses.rom:
imam kamam mandaya gobhirashvaishchandravata radhasa paprathashcha |
svaryavo matibhistubhyam vipra indraya vahah kushikaso akran ||
verses.en:
With kine and horses satisfy this longing with very splendid bounty skill extend it.
Seeking the light, with hymns to thee, O Indra, Kusikas have brought their gift, the singers.

verses.sa:
आ नो गोत्रा दर्दृहि गोपते गाः समस्मभ्यं सनयो यन्तु वाजाः ।
दिवक्षा असि वृषभ सत्यशुष्मोऽस्मभ्यं सु मघवन्बोधि गोदाः ॥
verses.rom:
a no gotra dardrihi gopate gah samasmabhyam sanayo yantu vajah |
divaksha asi vrishabha satyashushmo'smabhyam su maghavanbodhi godah ||
verses.en:
Lord of the kine, burst the kine's stable open: cows shall be ours, and strength that wins the booty.
Hero, whose might is true, thy home is heaven: to us, O Maghavan, grant gifts of cattle.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu ghnantam vritrani samjitam dhananam ||
verses.en:
Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in this fight where spoil is gathered,
The Strong who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
शासद्वह्निर्दुहितुर्नप्त्यं गाद्विद्वाँ ऋतस्य दीधितिं सपर्यन् ।
पिता यत्र दुहितुः सेकमृञ्जन्सं शग्म्येन मनसा दधन्वे ॥
verses.rom:
shasadvahnirduhiturnaptyam gadvidvan ritasya didhitim saparyan |
pita yatra duhituh sekamrinjansam shagmyena manasa dadhanve ||
verses.en:
WISE, teaching, following the thought of Order, the sonless gained a grandson from his daughter.
Fain, as a sire, to see his child prolific, he sped to meet her with an eager spirit.

verses.sa:
न जामये तान्वो रिक्थमारैक्चकार गर्भं सनितुर्निधानम् ।
यदी मातरो जनयन्त वह्निमन्यः कर्ता सुकृतोरन्य ऋन्धन् ॥
verses.rom:
na jamaye tanvo rikthamaraikchakara garbham saniturnidhanam |
yadi mataro janayanta vahnimanyah karta sukritoranya rindhan ||
verses.en:
The Son left not his portion to the brother, he made a home to hold him who should gain, it.
What time his Parents gave the Priest his being, of the good pair one acted, one promoted.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जज्ञे जुह्वा रेजमानो महस्पुत्राँ अरुषस्य प्रयक्षे ।
महान्गर्भो मह्या जातमेषां मही प्रवृद्धर्यश्वस्य यज्ञैः ॥
verses.rom:
agnirjajne juhva rejamano mahasputran arushasya prayakshe |
mahangarbho mahya jatamesham mahi pravriddharyashvasya yajnaih ||
verses.en:
Agni was born trembling with tongue that flickered, so that the Red's great children should be honoured.
Great is their germ, that born of them is mighty, great the Bays' Lord's approach through sacrifices.

verses.sa:
अभि जैत्रीरसचन्त स्पृधानं महि ज्योतिस्तमसो निरजानन् ।
तं जानतीः प्रत्युदायन्नुषासः पतिर्गवामभवदेक इन्द्रः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi jaitrirasachanta spridhanam mahi jyotistamaso nirajanan |
tam janatih pratyudayannushasah patirgavamabhavadeka indrah ||
verses.en:
Conquering bands upon the Warrior waited: they recognized great light from out the darkness.
The conscious Dawns went forth to meet his coming, and the sole Master of the kine was Indra.

verses.sa:
वीळौ सतीरभि धीरा अतृन्दन्प्राचाहिन्वन्मनसा सप्त विप्राः ।
विश्वामविन्दन्पथ्यामृतस्य प्रजानन्नित्ता नमसा विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
vilau satirabhi dhira atrindanprachahinvanmanasa sapta viprah |
vishvamavindanpathyamritasya prajanannitta namasa vivesha ||
verses.en:
The sages freed them from their firm built prison: the seven priests drove them forward with their spirit.
All holy Order's pathway they discovered he, full of knowledge, shared these deeds through worship.

verses.sa:
विदद्यदी सरमा रुग्णमद्रेर्महि पाथः पूर्व्यं सध्र्यक्कः ।
अग्रं नयत्सुपद्यक्षराणामच्छा रवं प्रथमा जानती गात् ॥
verses.rom:
vidadyadi sarama rugnamadrermahi pathah purvyam sadhryakkah |
agram nayatsupadyaksharanamachchha ravam prathama janati gat ||
verses.en:
When Sarama had found the mountain's fissure, that vast and ancient place she plundered thoroughly.
In the floods' van she led them forth, light-footed: she who well knew came first unto their lowing.

verses.sa:
अगच्छदु विप्रतमः सखीयन्नसूदयत्सुकृते गर्भमद्रिः ।
ससान मर्यो युवभिर्मखस्यन्नथाभवदङ्गिराः सद्यो अर्चन् ॥
verses.rom:
agachchhadu vipratamah sakhiyannasudayatsukrite garbhamadrih |
sasana maryo yuvabhirmakhasyannathabhavadangirah sadyo archan ||
verses.en:
Longing for friendship came the noblest singer: the hill poured forth its treasure for the pious.
The Hero with young followers fought and conquered, and straightway Angiras was singing praises,

verses.sa:
सतःसतः प्रतिमानं पुरोभूर्विश्वा वेद जनिमा हन्ति शुष्णम् ।
प्र णो दिवः पदवीर्गव्युरर्चन्सखा सखीँरमुञ्चन्निरवद्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
satahsatah pratimanam purobhurvishva veda janima hanti shushnam |
pra no divah padavirgavyurarchansakha sakhinramunchanniravadyat ||
verses.en:
Peer of each noble thing, yea, all excelling, all creatures doth he know, he slayeth Susna.
Our leader, fain for war, singing from heaven, as Friend he saved his lovers from dishonour.

verses.sa:
नि गव्यता मनसा सेदुरर्कैः कृण्वानासो अमृतत्वाय गातुम् ।
इदं चिन्नु सदनं भूर्येषां येन मासाँ असिषासन्नृतेन ॥
verses.rom:
ni gavyata manasa sedurarkaih krinvanaso amritatvaya gatum |
idam chinnu sadanam bhuryesham yena masan asishasannritena ||
verses.en:
They sate them down with spirit fain for booty, making with hymns a way to life eternal.
And this is still their place of frequent session, whereby they sought to gain the months through Order.

verses.sa:
सम्पश्यमाना अमदन्नभि स्वं पयः प्रत्नस्य रेतसो दुघानाः ।
वि रोदसी अतपद्घोष एषां जाते निष्ठामदधुर्गोषु वीरान् ॥
verses.rom:
sampashyamana amadannabhi svam payah pratnasya retaso dughanah |
vi rodasi atapadghosha esham jate nishthamadadhurgoshu viran ||
verses.en:
Drawing the milk of ancient seed prolific, they joyed as they beheld their own possession.
Their shout of triumph heated earth and heaven. When the kine showed, they bade the heroes rouse them.

verses.sa:
स जातेभिर्वृत्रहा सेदु हव्यैरुदुस्रिया असृजदिन्द्रो अर्कैः ।
उरूच्यस्मै घृतवद्भरन्ती मधु स्वाद्म दुदुहे जेन्या गौः ॥
verses.rom:
sa jatebhirvritraha sedu havyairudusriya asrijadindro arkaih |
uruchyasmai ghritavadbharanti madhu svadma duduhe jenya gauh ||
verses.en:
Indra drove forth the kine, that Vrtra-slayer, while hymns of praise rose up and gifts were offered.
For him the Cow, noble and far-extending, poured pleasant juices, bringing oil and sweetness.

verses.sa:
पित्रे चिच्चक्रुः सदनं समस्मै महि त्विषीमत्सुकृतो वि हि ख्यन् ।
विष्कभ्नन्त स्कम्भनेना जनित्री आसीना ऊर्ध्वं रभसं वि मिन्वन् ॥
verses.rom:
pitre chichchakruh sadanam samasmai mahi tvishimatsukrito vi hi khyan |
vishkabhnanta skambhanena janitri asina urdhvam rabhasam vi minvan ||
verses.en:
They made a mansion for their Father, deftly provided him a great and glorious dwelling;
With firm support parted and stayed the Parents, and, sitting, fixed him there erected, mighty.

verses.sa:
मही यदि धिषणा शिश्नथे धात्सद्योवृधं विभ्वं रोदस्योः ।
गिरो यस्मिन्ननवद्याः समीचीर्विश्वा इन्द्राय तविषीरनुत्ताः ॥
verses.rom:
mahi yadi dhishana shishnathe dhatsadyovridham vibhvam rodasyoh |
giro yasminnanavadyah samichirvishva indraya tavishiranuttah ||
verses.en:
What time the ample chalice had impelled him, swift waxing, vast, to pierce the earth and heaven,-
Him in whom blameless songs are all united: all powers invincible belong to Indra.

verses.sa:
मह्या ते सख्यं वश्मि शक्तीरा वृत्रघ्ने नियुतो यन्ति पूर्वीः ।
महि स्तोत्रमव आगन्म सूरेरस्माकं सु मघवन्बोधि गोपाः ॥
verses.rom:
mahya te sakhyam vashmi shaktira vritraghne niyuto yanti purvih |
mahi stotramava aganma surerasmakam su maghavanbodhi gopah ||
verses.en:
I crave thy powers, I crave thy mighty friendship: full many a team goes to the Vrtra-slayer.
Great is the laud, we seek the Princes' favour. Be thou, O Maghavan, our guard and keeper.

verses.sa:
महि क्षेत्रं पुरु श्चन्द्रं विविद्वानादित्सखिभ्यश्चरथं समैरत् ।
इन्द्रो नृभिरजनद्दीद्यानः साकं सूर्यमुषसं गातुमग्निम् ॥
verses.rom:
mahi kshetram puru shchandram vividvanaditsakhibhyashcharatham samairat |
indro nribhirajanaddidyanah sakam suryamushasam gatumagnim ||
verses.en:
He, having found great, splendid, rich dominion, sent life and motion to his friends and lovers.
Indra who shone together with the Heroes begot the song, the fire, and Sun and Morning.

verses.sa:
अपश्चिदेष विभ्वो दमूनाः प्र सध्रीचीरसृजद्विश्वश्चन्द्राः ।
मध्वः पुनानाः कविभिः पवित्रैर्द्युभिर्हिन्वन्त्यक्तुभिर्धनुत्रीः ॥
verses.rom:
apashchidesha vibhvo damunah pra sadhrichirasrijadvishvashchandrah |
madhvah punanah kavibhih pavitrairdyubhirhinvantyaktubhirdhanutrih ||
verses.en:
Vast, the House-Friend, he set the waters flowing, all-lucid, widely spread, that move together.
By the wise cleansings of the meath made holy, through days, and nights they speed the swift streams onward.

verses.sa:
अनु कृष्णे वसुधिती जिहाते उभे सूर्यस्य मंहना यजत्रे ।
परि यत्ते महिमानं वृजध्यै सखाय इन्द्र काम्या ऋजिप्याः ॥
verses.rom:
anu krishne vasudhiti jihate ubhe suryasya mamhana yajatre |
pari yatte mahimanam vrijadhyai sakhaya indra kamya rijipyah ||
verses.en:
To thee proceed the dark, the treasure-holders, both of them sanctified by Surya's bounty.
The while thy overly storming Friends, O Indra, fail to attain the measure of thy greatness.

verses.sa:
पतिर्भव वृत्रहन्सूनृतानां गिरां विश्वायुर्वृषभो वयोधाः ।
आ नो गहि सख्येभिः शिवेभिर्महान्महीभिरूतिभिः सरण्यन् ॥
verses.rom:
patirbhava vritrahansunritanam giram vishvayurvrishabho vayodhah |
a no gahi sakhyebhih shivebhirmahanmahibhirutibhih saranyan ||
verses.en:
Be Lord of joyous songs, O Vrtra-slayer, Bull dear to all, who gives the power of living.
Come unto us with thine auspicious friendship, hastening, Mighty One, with mighty succours.

verses.sa:
तमङ्गिरस्वन्नमसा सपर्यन्नव्यं कृणोमि सन्यसे पुराजाम् ।
द्रुहो वि याहि बहुला अदेवीः स्वश्च नो मघवन्सातये धाः ॥
verses.rom:
tamangirasvannamasa saparyannavyam krinomi sanyase purajam |
druho vi yahi bahula adevih svashcha no maghavansataye dhah ||
verses.en:
Like Angiras I honour him with worship, and renovate old song for him the Ancient.
Chase thou the many godless evil creatures, and give us, Maghavan, heaven's light to help m.

verses.sa:
मिहः पावकाः प्रतता अभूवन्स्वस्ति नः पिपृहि पारमासाम् ।
इन्द्र त्वं रथिरः पाहि नो रिषो मक्षूमक्षू कृणुहि गोजितो नः ॥
verses.rom:
mihah pavakah pratata abhuvansvasti nah piprihi paramasam |
indra tvam rathirah pahi no risho makshumakshu krinuhi gojito nah ||
verses.en:
Far forth are spread the purifying waters convey thou us across them unto safety.
Save us, our Charioteer, from harm, O Indra, soon, very soon, make us win spoil of cattle.

verses.sa:
अदेदिष्ट वृत्रहा गोपतिर्गा अन्तः कृष्णाँ अरुषैर्धामभिर्गात् ।
प्र सूनृता दिशमान ऋतेन दुरश्च विश्वा अवृणोदप स्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
adedishta vritraha gopatirga antah krishnan arushairdhamabhirgat |
pra sunrita dishamana ritena durashcha vishva avrinodapa svah ||
verses.en:
His kine their Lord hath shown, e'en Vrtra's slayer, through the black hosts he passed with red attendants.
Teaching us pleasant things by holy Order, to, us hath he thrown open all his portals.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu ghnantam vritrani samjitam dhananam ||
verses.en:
Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in this fight where spoil is gathered.
The Strong who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र सोमं सोमपते पिबेमं माध्यंदिनं सवनं चारु यत्ते ।
प्रप्रुथ्या शिप्रे मघवन्नृजीषिन्विमुच्या हरी इह मादयस्व ॥
verses.rom:
indra somam somapate pibemam madhyamdinam savanam charu yatte |
prapruthya shipre maghavannrijishinvimuchya hari iha madayasva ||
verses.en:
DRINK thou this Soma, Indra, Lord of Soma; drink thou the draught of noonday which thou Iovest.
Puffing thy cheeks, impetuous, liberal Giver, here loose thy two Bay Horses and rejoice thee.

verses.sa:
गवाशिरं मन्थिनमिन्द्र शुक्रं पिबा सोमं ररिमा ते मदाय ।
ब्रह्मकृता मारुतेना गणेन सजोषा रुद्रैस्तृपदा वृषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
gavashiram manthinamindra shukram piba somam rarima te madaya |
brahmakrita marutena ganena sajosha rudraistripada vrishasva ||
verses.en:
Quaff it pure, meal-blent, mixt with milk, O Indra; we have poured forth the Soma for thy rapture.
Knit with the prayer-fulfilling band of Maruts, yea, with the Rudras, drink till thou art sated;

verses.sa:
ये ते शुष्मं ये तविषीमवर्धन्नर्चन्त इन्द्र मरुतस्त ओजः ।
माध्यंदिने सवने वज्रहस्त पिबा रुद्रेभिः सगणः सुशिप्र ॥
verses.rom:
ye te shushmam ye tavishimavardhannarchanta indra marutasta ojah |
madhyamdine savane vajrahasta piba rudrebhih saganah sushipra ||
verses.en:
Those who gave increase to thy strength and vigour; the Maruts singing forth thy might, O Indra.
Drink thou, O fair of cheek, whose hand wields thunder, with Rudras banded, at our noon libation.

verses.sa:
त इन्न्वस्य मधुमद्विविप्र इन्द्रस्य शर्धो मरुतो य आसन् ।
येभिर्वृत्रस्येषितो विवेदामर्मणो मन्यमानस्य मर्म ॥
verses.rom:
ta innvasya madhumadvivipra indrasya shardho maruto ya asan |
yebhirvritrasyeshito vivedamarmano manyamanasya marma ||
verses.en:
They, even the Maruts who were there, excited with song the meath-created strength of Indra.
By them impelled to act he reached the vitals Of Vrtra, though he deemed that none might wound him.

verses.sa:
मनुष्वदिन्द्र सवनं जुषाणः पिबा सोमं शश्वते वीर्याय ।
स आ ववृत्स्व हर्यश्व यज्ञैः सरण्युभिरपो अर्णा सिसर्षि ॥
verses.rom:
manushvadindra savanam jushanah piba somam shashvate viryaya |
sa a vavritsva haryashva yajnaih saranyubhirapo arna sisarshi ||
verses.en:
Pleased, like a man, with our libation, Indra, drink, for enduring hero might, the Soma.
Lord of Bays, moved by sacrifice come hither: thou with the Swift Ones stirrest floods and waters.

verses.sa:
त्वमपो यद्ध वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अत्याँ इव प्रासृजः सर्तवाजौ ।
शयानमिन्द्र चरता वधेन वव्रिवांसं परि देवीरदेवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamapo yaddha vritram jaghanvan atyan iva prasrijah sartavajau |
shayanamindra charata vadhena vavrivamsam pari deviradevam ||
verses.en:
When thou didst loose the streams to run like racers in the swift contest, having smitten Vrtra
With flying weapon where he lay, O Indra, and, godless, kept the Goddesses encompassed.

verses.sa:
यजाम इन्नमसा वृद्धमिन्द्रं बृहन्तमृष्वमजरं युवानम् ।
यस्य प्रिये ममतुर्यज्ञियस्य न रोदसी महिमानं ममाते ॥
verses.rom:
yajama innamasa vriddhamindram brihantamrishvamajaram yuvanam |
yasya priye mamaturyajniyasya na rodasi mahimanam mamate ||
verses.en:
With reverence let us worship mighty Indra, great and sublime, eternal, ever youthful,
Whose greatness the dear world-halves have not measured, no, nor conceived the might of him the Holy.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य कर्म सुकृता पुरूणि व्रतानि देवा न मिनन्ति विश्वे ।
दाधार यः पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमां जजान सूर्यमुषसं सुदंसाः ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya karma sukrita puruni vratani deva na minanti vishve |
dadhara yah prithivim dyamutemam jajana suryamushasam sudamsah ||
verses.en:
Many are Indra's nobly wrought achievements, and none of all the Gods transgress his statutes.
He beareth up this earth and heaven, and, doer of marvels, he begot the Sun and Morning.

verses.sa:
अद्रोघ सत्यं तव तन्महित्वं सद्यो यज्जातो अपिबो ह सोमम् ।
न द्याव इन्द्र तवसस्त ओजो नाहा न मासाः शरदो वरन्त ॥
verses.rom:
adrogha satyam tava tanmahitvam sadyo yajjato apibo ha somam |
na dyava indra tavasasta ojo naha na masah sharado varanta ||
verses.en:
Herein, O Guileless One, is thy true greatness, that soon as born thou drankest up the Soma.
Days may not check the power of thee the Mighty, nor the nights, Indra, nor the months, nor autumns.

verses.sa:
त्वं सद्यो अपिबो जात इन्द्र मदाय सोमं परमे व्योमन् ।
यद्ध द्यावापृथिवी आविवेशीरथाभवः पूर्व्यः कारुधायाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam sadyo apibo jata indra madaya somam parame vyoman |
yaddha dyavaprithivi aviveshirathabhavah purvyah karudhayah ||
verses.en:
As soon as thou wast born in highest heaven thou drankest Soma to delight thee, Indra;
And when thou hadst pervaded earth and heaven thou wast the first supporter of the singer.

verses.sa:
अहन्नहिं परिशयानमर्ण ओजायमानं तुविजात तव्यान् ।
न ते महित्वमनु भूदध द्यौर्यदन्यया स्फिग्या क्षामवस्थाः ॥
verses.rom:
ahannahim parishayanamarna ojayamanam tuvijata tavyan |
na te mahitvamanu bhudadha dyauryadanyaya sphigya kshamavasthah ||
verses.en:
Thou, puissant God, more mighty, slewest. Ahi showing his strength when couched around the waters.
The heaven itself attained not to thy greatness when with one hip of thine the earth was shadowed.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो हि त इन्द्र वर्धनो भूदुत प्रियः सुतसोमो मियेधः ।
यज्ञेन यज्ञमव यज्ञियः सन्यज्ञस्ते वज्रमहिहत्य आवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yajno hi ta indra vardhano bhuduta priyah sutasomo miyedhah |
yajnena yajnamava yajniyah sanyajnaste vajramahihatya avat ||
verses.en:
Sacrifice, Indra, made thee wax so mighty, the dear oblation with the flowing Soma.
O Worshipful, with worship help our worship, for worship helped thy bolt when slaying Ahi.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेनेन्द्रमवसा चक्रे अर्वागैनं सुम्नाय नव्यसे ववृत्याम् ।
य स्तोमेभिर्वावृधे पूर्व्येभिर्यो मध्यमेभिरुत नूतनेभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnenendramavasa chakre arvagainam sumnaya navyase vavrityam |
ya stomebhirvavridhe purvyebhiryo madhyamebhiruta nutanebhih ||
verses.en:
With sacrifice and wish have I brought Indra; still for new blessings may I turn him hither,
Him magnified by ancient songs and praises, by lauds of later time and days yet recent.

verses.sa:
विवेष यन्मा धिषणा जजान स्तवै पुरा पार्यादिन्द्रमह्नः ।
अंहसो यत्र पीपरद्यथा नो नावेव यान्तमुभये हवन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
vivesha yanma dhishana jajana stavai pura paryadindramahnah |
amhaso yatra piparadyatha no naveva yantamubhaye havante ||
verses.en:
I have brought forth a song when longing seized me: ere the decisive day will I laud Indra;
Then may lie safely bear us over trouble, as in a ship, when both sides invocate him.

verses.sa:
आपूर्णो अस्य कलशः स्वाहा सेक्तेव कोशं सिसिचे पिबध्यै ।
समु प्रिया आववृत्रन्मदाय प्रदक्षिणिदभि सोमास इन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
apurno asya kalashah svaha sekteva kosham sisiche pibadhyai |
samu priya avavritranmadaya pradakshinidabhi somasa indram ||
verses.en:
Full is his chalice: Glory! Like a pourer I have filled up the vessel for his drinking.
Presented on the right, dear Soma juices have brought us Indra, to rejoice him, hither.

verses.sa:
न त्वा गभीरः पुरुहूत सिन्धुर्नाद्रयः परि षन्तो वरन्त ।
इत्था सखिभ्य इषितो यदिन्द्रा दृळ्हं चिदरुजो गव्यमूर्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
na tva gabhirah puruhuta sindhurnadrayah pari shanto varanta |
ittha sakhibhya ishito yadindra drilham chidarujo gavyamurvam ||
verses.en:
Not the deep-flowing flood, O Much-invoked One! not hills that compass thee about restrain thee,
Since here incited, for thy friends, O Indra, thou breakest e'en the firm built stall of cattle.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu ghnantam vritrani samjitam dhananam ||
verses.en:
Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in this fight where spoil is gathered,
The Strong who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
प्र पर्वतानामुशती उपस्थादश्वे इव विषिते हासमाने ।
गावेव शुभ्रे मातरा रिहाणे विपाट् छुतुद्री पयसा जवेते ॥
verses.rom:
pra parvatanamushati upasthadashve iva vishite hasamane |
gaveva shubhre matara rihane vipat chhutudri payasa javete ||
verses.en:
FORTH from the bosom of the mountains, eager as two swift mares with loosened rein contending,
Like two bright mother cows who lick their youngling, Vipas and Sutudri speed down their waters.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेषिते प्रसवं भिक्षमाणे अच्छा समुद्रं रथ्येव याथः ।
समाराणे ऊर्मिभिः पिन्वमाने अन्या वामन्यामप्येति शुभ्रे ॥
verses.rom:
indreshite prasavam bhikshamane achchha samudram rathyeva yathah |
samarane urmibhih pinvamane anya vamanyamapyeti shubhre ||
verses.en:
Impelled by Indra whom ye pray to urge you, ye move as 'twere on chariots to the ocean.
Flowing together, swelling with your billows, O lucid Streams, each of you seeks the other.

verses.sa:
अच्छा सिन्धुं मातृतमामयासं विपाशमुर्वीं सुभगामगन्म ।
वत्समिव मातरा संरिहाणे समानं योनिमनु संचरन्ती ॥
verses.rom:
achchha sindhum matritamamayasam vipashamurvim subhagamaganma |
vatsamiva matara samrihane samanam yonimanu samcharanti ||
verses.en:
I have attained the most maternal River, we have approached Vipas, the broad, the blessed.
Licking as 'twere their calf the pair of Mothers flow onward to their common home together.

verses.sa:
एना वयं पयसा पिन्वमाना अनु योनिं देवकृतं चरन्तीः ।
न वर्तवे प्रसवः सर्गतक्तः किंयुर्विप्रो नद्यो जोहवीति ॥
verses.rom:
ena vayam payasa pinvamana anu yonim devakritam charantih |
na vartave prasavah sargataktah kimyurvipro nadyo johaviti ||
verses.en:
We two who rise and swell with billowy waters move forward to the home which Gods have made us.
Our flood may not be stayed when urged to motion. What would the singer, calling to the Rivers?

verses.sa:
रमध्वं मे वचसे सोम्याय ऋतावरीरुप मुहूर्तमेवैः ।
प्र सिन्धुमच्छा बृहती मनीषावस्युरह्वे कुशिकस्य सूनुः ॥
verses.rom:
ramadhvam me vachase somyaya ritavarirupa muhurtamevaih |
pra sindhumachchha brihati manishavasyurahve kushikasya sunuh ||
verses.en:
Linger a little at my friendly bidding rest, Holy Ones, a moment in your journey.
With hymn sublime soliciting your favour Kusika's son hath called unto the River.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो अस्माँ अरदद्वज्रबाहुरपाहन्वृत्रं परिधिं नदीनाम् ।
देवोऽनयत्सविता सुपाणिस्तस्य वयं प्रसवे याम उर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
indro asman aradadvajrabahurapahanvritram paridhim nadinam |
devo'nayatsavita supanistasya vayam prasave yama urvih ||
verses.en:
Indra who wields the thunder dug our channels: he smote down Vrtra, him who stayed our currents.
Savitar, God, the lovely-handed, led us, and at his sending forth we flow expanded.

verses.sa:
प्रवाच्यं शश्वधा वीर्यं तदिन्द्रस्य कर्म यदहिं विवृश्चत् ।
वि वज्रेण परिषदो जघानायन्नापोऽयनमिच्छमानाः ॥
verses.rom:
pravachyam shashvadha viryam tadindrasya karma yadahim vivrishchat |
vi vajrena parishado jaghanayannapo'yanamichchhamanah ||
verses.en:
That hero deed of Indra must be lauded for ever that he rent Ahi in pieces.
He smote away the obstructers with his thunder, and eager for their course forth flowed the waters.

verses.sa:
एतद्वचो जरितर्मापि मृष्ठा आ यत्ते घोषानुत्तरा युगानि ।
उक्थेषु कारो प्रति नो जुषस्व मा नो नि कः पुरुषत्रा नमस्ते ॥
verses.rom:
etadvacho jaritarmapi mrishtha a yatte ghoshanuttara yugani |
uktheshu karo prati no jushasva ma no ni kah purushatra namaste ||
verses.en:
Never forget this word of thine, O singer, which future generations shall reecho.
In hymns, O bard, show us thy loving kindness. Humble us not mid men. To thee be honour!

verses.sa:
ओ षु स्वसारः कारवे शृणोत ययौ वो दूरादनसा रथेन ।
नि षू नमध्वं भवता सुपारा अधोअक्षाः सिन्धवः स्रोत्याभिः ॥
verses.rom:
o shu svasarah karave shrinota yayau vo duradanasa rathena |
ni shu namadhvam bhavata supara adhoakshah sindhavah srotyabhih ||
verses.en:
List quickly, Sisters, to the bard who cometh to you from far away with car and wagon.
Bow lowly down; be easy to be traversed stay, Rivers, with your floods below our axles.

verses.sa:
आ ते कारो शृणवामा वचांसि ययाथ दूरादनसा रथेन ।
नि ते नंसै पीप्यानेव योषा मर्यायेव कन्या शश्वचै ते ॥
verses.rom:
a te karo shrinavama vachamsi yayatha duradanasa rathena |
ni te namsai pipyaneva yosha maryayeva kanya shashvachai te ||
verses.en:
Yea, we will listen to thy words, O singer. With wain and car from far away thou comest.
Low, like a nursing mother, will I bend me, and yield me as a maiden to her lover.

verses.sa:
यदङ्ग त्वा भरताः संतरेयुर्गव्यन्ग्राम इषित इन्द्रजूतः ।
अर्षादह प्रसवः सर्गतक्त आ वो वृणे सुमतिं यज्ञियानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadanga tva bharatah samtareyurgavyangrama ishita indrajutah |
arshadaha prasavah sargatakta a vo vrine sumatim yajniyanam ||
verses.en:
Soon as the Bharatas have fared across thee, the warrior band, urged on and sped by Indra,
Then let your streams flow on in rapid motion. I crave your favour who deserve our worship.

verses.sa:
अतारिषुर्भरता गव्यवः समभक्त विप्रः सुमतिं नदीनाम् ।
प्र पिन्वध्वमिषयन्तीः सुराधा आ वक्षणाः पृणध्वं यात शीभम् ॥
verses.rom:
atarishurbharata gavyavah samabhakta viprah sumatim nadinam |
pra pinvadhvamishayantih suradha a vakshanah prinadhvam yata shibham ||
verses.en:
The warrior host, the Bharatas, fared over the singer won the favour of the Rivers.
Swell with your billows, hasting, pouring riches. Fill full your channels, and roll swiftly onward.

verses.sa:
उद्व ऊर्मिः शम्या हन्त्वापो योक्त्राणि मुञ्चत ।
मादुष्कृतौ व्येनसाघ्न्यौ शूनमारताम् ॥
verses.rom:
udva urmih shamya hantvapo yoktrani munchata |
madushkritau vyenasaghnyau shunamaratam ||
verses.en:
So let your wave bear up the pins, and ye, O Waters, spare the thongs;
And never may the pair of Bulls, harmless and sinless, waste away.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः पूर्भिदातिरद्दासमर्कैर्विदद्वसुर्दयमानो वि शत्रून् ।
ब्रह्मजूतस्तन्वा वावृधानो भूरिदात्र आपृणद्रोदसी उभे ॥
verses.rom:
indrah purbhidatiraddasamarkairvidadvasurdayamano vi shatrun |
brahmajutastanva vavridhano bhuridatra aprinadrodasi ubhe ||
verses.en:
FORT-RENDER, Lord of Wealth, dispelling foemen, Indra with lightnings hath o'ercome the Dasa.
Impelled by prayer and waxen great in body, he hath filled earth and heaven, the Bounteous Giver.

verses.sa:
मखस्य ते तविषस्य प्र जूतिमियर्मि वाचममृताय भूषन् ।
इन्द्र क्षितीनामसि मानुषीणां विशां दैवीनामुत पूर्वयावा ॥
verses.rom:
makhasya te tavishasya pra jutimiyarmi vachamamritaya bhushan |
indra kshitinamasi manushinam visham daivinamuta purvayava ||
verses.en:
I stimulate thy zeal, the Strong, the Hero decking my song of praise forth; Immortal.
O Indra, thou art equally the Leader of heavenly hosts and human generations.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वृत्रमवृणोच्छर्धनीतिः प्र मायिनाममिनाद्वर्पणीतिः ।
अहन्व्यंसमुशधग्वनेष्वाविर्धेना अकृणोद्राम्याणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
indro vritramavrinochchhardhanitih pra mayinamaminadvarpanitih |
ahanvyamsamushadhagvaneshvavirdhena akrinodramyanam ||
verses.en:
Leading, his band Indra encompassed Vrtra; weak grew the wily leader of enchanters.
He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyamsa, and made the Milch-kine of the nights apparent.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः स्वर्षा जनयन्नहानि जिगायोशिग्भिः पृतना अभिष्टिः ।
प्रारोचयन्मनवे केतुमह्नामविन्दज्ज्योतिर्बृहते रणाय ॥
verses.rom:
indrah svarsha janayannahani jigayoshigbhih pritana abhishtih |
prarochayanmanave ketumahnamavindajjyotirbrihate ranaya ||
verses.en:
Indra, light-winner, days' Creator, conquered, victorious, hostile bands with those who loved him.
For man the days' bright ensign he illumined, and found the light for his joy and gladness.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्तुजो बर्हणा आ विवेश नृवद्दधानो नर्या पुरूणि ।
अचेतयद्धिय इमा जरित्रे प्रेमं वर्णमतिरच्छुक्रमासाम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrastujo barhana a vivesha nrivaddadhano narya puruni |
achetayaddhiya ima jaritre premam varnamatirachchhukramasam ||
verses.en:
Forward to fiercely falling blows pressed Indra, hero like doing many hero exploits.
These holy songs he taught the bard who praised him, and widely spread these Dawns' resplendent colour.

verses.sa:
महो महानि पनयन्त्यस्येन्द्रस्य कर्म सुकृता पुरूणि ।
वृजनेन वृजिनान्सं पिपेष मायाभिर्दस्यूँरभिभूत्योजाः ॥
verses.rom:
maho mahani panayantyasyendrasya karma sukrita puruni |
vrijanena vrijinansam pipesha mayabhirdasyunrabhibhutyojah ||
verses.en:
They laud the mighty acts of him the Mighty, the many glorious deeds performed by Indra.
He in his strength, with all-surpassing prowess, through wondrous arts crushed the malignant Dasyus.

verses.sa:
युधेन्द्रो मह्ना वरिवश्चकार देवेभ्यः सत्पतिश्चर्षणिप्राः ।
विवस्वतः सदने अस्य तानि विप्रा उक्थेभिः कवयो गृणन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
yudhendro mahna varivashchakara devebhyah satpatishcharshaniprah |
vivasvatah sadane asya tani vipra ukthebhih kavayo grinanti ||
verses.en:
Lord of the brave, Indra who rules the people gave freedom to the Gods by might and battle.
Wise singers glorify with chanted praises these his achievements in Vivasvan's dwelling.

verses.sa:
सत्रासाहं वरेण्यं सहोदां ससवांसं स्वरपश्च देवीः ।
ससान यः पृथिवीं द्यामुतेमामिन्द्रं मदन्त्यनु धीरणासः ॥
verses.rom:
satrasaham varenyam sahodam sasavamsam svarapashcha devih |
sasana yah prithivim dyamutemamindram madantyanu dhiranasah ||
verses.en:
Excellent, Conqueror, the victory-giver, the winner of the light and Godlike Waters,
He who hath won this broad earth and this heaven, -in Indra they rejoice who love devotions.

verses.sa:
ससानात्याँ उत सूर्यं ससानेन्द्रः ससान पुरुभोजसं गाम् ।
हिरण्ययमुत भोगं ससान हत्वी दस्यून्प्रार्यं वर्णमावत् ॥
verses.rom:
sasanatyan uta suryam sasanendrah sasana purubhojasam gam |
hiranyayamuta bhogam sasana hatvi dasyunpraryam varnamavat ||
verses.en:
He gained possession of the Sun and Horses, Indra obtained the Cow who feedeth many.
Treasure of gold he won; he smote the Dasyus, and gave protection to the Aryan colour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ओषधीरसनोदहानि वनस्पतीँरसनोदन्तरिक्षम् ।
बिभेद वलं नुनुदे विवाचोऽथाभवद्दमिताभिक्रतूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra oshadhirasanodahani vanaspatinrasanodantariksham |
bibheda valam nunude vivacho'thabhavaddamitabhikratunam ||
verses.en:
He took the plants and days for his possession; he gained the forest trees and air's mid-region.
Vala he cleft, and chased away opponents: thus was he tamer of the overweening.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu ghnantam vritrani samjitam dhananam ||
verses.en:
Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,
The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers treasures.

verses.sa:
तिष्ठा हरी रथ आ युज्यमाना याहि वायुर्न नियुतो नो अच्छ ।
पिबास्यन्धो अभिसृष्टो अस्मे इन्द्र स्वाहा ररिमा ते मदाय ॥
verses.rom:
tishtha hari ratha a yujyamana yahi vayurna niyuto no achchha |
pibasyandho abhisrishto asme indra svaha rarima te madaya ||
verses.en:
MOUNT the Bay Horses to thy chariot harnessed, and come to us like Vayu with his coursers.
Thou, hastening to us, shalt drink the Soma. Hail, Indra. We have poured it for thy rapture.

verses.sa:
उपाजिरा पुरुहूताय सप्ती हरी रथस्य धूर्ष्वा युनज्मि ।
द्रवद्यथा सम्भृतं विश्वतश्चिदुपेमं यज्ञमा वहात इन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
upajira puruhutaya sapti hari rathasya dhurshva yunajmi |
dravadyatha sambhritam vishvatashchidupemam yajnama vahata indram ||
verses.en:
For him, the God who is invoked by many, the two swift Bay Steeds to the pole I harness,
That they in fleet course may bring Indra hither, e'en to this sacrifice arranged completely.

verses.sa:
उपो नयस्व वृषणा तपुष्पोतेमव त्वं वृषभ स्वधावः ।
ग्रसेतामश्वा वि मुचेह शोणा दिवेदिवे सदृशीरद्धि धानाः ॥
verses.rom:
upo nayasva vrishana tapushpotemava tvam vrishabha svadhavah |
grasetamashva vi mucheha shona divedive sadrishiraddhi dhanah ||
verses.en:
Bring the strong Steeds who drink the warm libation, and, Bull of Godlike nature, be thou gracious.
Let thy Steeds eat; set free thy Tawny Horses, and roasted grain like this consume thou daily.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मणा ते ब्रह्मयुजा युनज्मि हरी सखाया सधमाद आशू ।
स्थिरं रथं सुखमिन्द्राधितिष्ठन्प्रजानन्विद्वाँ उप याहि सोमम् ॥
verses.rom:
brahmana te brahmayuja yunajmi hari sakhaya sadhamada ashu |
sthiram ratham sukhamindradhitishthanprajananvidvan upa yahi somam ||
verses.en:
Those who are yoked by prayer I harness, fleet friendly Bays who take their joy together.
Mounting thy firm and easy car, O Indra, wise and all-knowing come thou to the Soma.

verses.sa:
मा ते हरी वृषणा वीतपृष्ठा नि रीरमन्यजमानासो अन्ये ।
अत्यायाहि शश्वतो वयं तेऽरं सुतेभिः कृणवाम सोमैः ॥
verses.rom:
ma te hari vrishana vitaprishtha ni riramanyajamanaso anye |
atyayahi shashvato vayam te'ram sutebhih krinavama somaih ||
verses.en:
No other worshippers must stay beside them thy Bays, thy vigorous and smooth-backed Coursers.
Pass by them all and hasten onward hither: with Soma pressed we will prepare to feast thee.

verses.sa:
तवायं सोमस्त्वमेह्यर्वाङ्छश्वत्तमं सुमना अस्य पाहि ।
अस्मिन्यज्ञे बर्हिष्या निषद्या दधिष्वेमं जठर इन्दुमिन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
tavayam somastvamehyarvanchhashvattamam sumana asya pahi |
asminyajne barhishya nishadya dadhishvemam jathara indumindra ||
verses.en:
Thine is this Sorna: hasten to approach it. Drink thou thereof, benevolent, and cease not.
Sit on the sacred grass at this our worship, and take these drops into thy belly, Indra.

verses.sa:
स्तीर्णं ते बर्हिः सुत इन्द्र सोमः कृता धाना अत्तवे ते हरिभ्याम् ।
तदोकसे पुरुशाकाय वृष्णे मरुत्वते तुभ्यं राता हवींषि ॥
verses.rom:
stirnam te barhih suta indra somah krita dhana attave te haribhyam |
tadokase purushakaya vrishne marutvate tubhyam rata havimshi ||
verses.en:
The grass is strewn for thee, pressed is the Soma; the grain is ready for thy Bays to feed on.
To thee who lovest them, the very mighty, strong, girt by Maruts, are these gifts presented.

verses.sa:
इमं नरः पर्वतास्तुभ्यमापः समिन्द्र गोभिर्मधुमन्तमक्रन् ।
तस्यागत्या सुमना ऋष्व पाहि प्रजानन्विद्वान्पथ्या अनु स्वाः ॥
verses.rom:
imam narah parvatastubhyamapah samindra gobhirmadhumantamakran |
tasyagatya sumana rishva pahi prajananvidvanpathya anu svah ||
verses.en:
This the sweet draught, with cows, the men, the mountains, the waters, Indra, have for thee made ready.
Come, drink thereof, Sublime One, friendly-minded, foreseeing, knowing well the ways thou goest.

verses.sa:
याँ आभजो मरुत इन्द्र सोमे ये त्वामवर्धन्नभवन्गणस्ते ।
तेभिरेतं सजोषा वावशानोऽग्नेः पिब जिह्वया सोममिन्द्र ॥
verses.rom:
yan abhajo maruta indra some ye tvamavardhannabhavanganaste |
tebhiretam sajosha vavashano'gneh piba jihvaya somamindra ||
verses.en:
The Maruts, they with whom thou sharedst Soma, Indra, who made thee strong and were thine army,-
With these accordant, eagerly desirous drink thou this Soma with the tongue of Agni.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र पिब स्वधया चित्सुतस्याग्नेर्वा पाहि जिह्वया यजत्र ।
अध्वर्योर्वा प्रयतं शक्र हस्ताद्धोतुर्वा यज्ञं हविषो जुषस्व ॥
verses.rom:
indra piba svadhaya chitsutasyagnerva pahi jihvaya yajatra |
adhvaryorva prayatam shakra hastaddhoturva yajnam havisho jushasva ||
verses.en:
Drink, Indra, of the juice by thine own nature, or by the tongue of Agni, O thou Holy.
Accept the sacrificial gift, O Sakra, from the Adhvaryu's hand or from the Hotar's.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu ghnantam vritrani samjitam dhananam ||
verses.en:
Call we on Maghavan, auspicious Indra, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,
The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
इमामू षु प्रभृतिं सातये धाः शश्वच्छश्वदूतिभिर्यादमानः ।
सुतेसुते वावृधे वर्धनेभिर्यः कर्मभिर्महद्भिः सुश्रुतो भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
imamu shu prabhritim sataye dhah shashvachchhashvadutibhiryadamanah |
sutesute vavridhe vardhanebhiryah karmabhirmahadbhih sushruto bhut ||
verses.en:
WITH constant succours, fain thyself to share it, make this oblation which we bring effective.
Grown great through strengthening gifts at each libation, he hath become renowned by mighty exploits.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सोमाः प्रदिवो विदाना ऋभुर्येभिर्वृषपर्वा विहायाः ।
प्रयम्यमानान्प्रति षू गृभायेन्द्र पिब वृषधूतस्य वृष्णः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya somah pradivo vidana ribhuryebhirvrishaparva vihayah |
prayamyamananprati shu gribhayendra piba vrishadhutasya vrishnah ||
verses.en:
For Indra were the Somas erst- discovered, whereby he grew strong-jointed, vast, and skilful.
Indra , take quickly these presented juices: drink of the strong, that which the strong have shaken.

verses.sa:
पिबा वर्धस्व तव घा सुतास इन्द्र सोमासः प्रथमा उतेमे ।
यथापिबः पूर्व्याँ इन्द्र सोमाँ एवा पाहि पन्यो अद्या नवीयान् ॥
verses.rom:
piba vardhasva tava gha sutasa indra somasah prathama uteme |
yathapibah purvyan indra soman eva pahi panyo adya naviyan ||
verses.en:
Drink and wax great. Thine are the juices, Indra, both Somas of old time and these we bring thee.
Even as thou drankest, Indra, earlier Somas, so drink to-day, a new guest, meet for praises.

verses.sa:
महाँ अमत्रो वृजने विरप्श्युग्रं शवः पत्यते धृष्ण्वोजः ।
नाह विव्याच पृथिवी चनैनं यत्सोमासो हर्यश्वममन्दन् ॥
verses.rom:
mahan amatro vrijane virapshyugram shavah patyate dhrishnvojah |
naha vivyacha prithivi chanainam yatsomaso haryashvamamandan ||
verses.en:
Great and impetuous, mighty-voiced in battle, surpassing power is his, and strength resistless.
Him the broad earth hath never comprehended when Somas cheered the Lord of Tawny Coursers.

verses.sa:
महाँ उग्रो वावृधे वीर्याय समाचक्रे वृषभः काव्येन ।
इन्द्रो भगो वाजदा अस्य गावः प्र जायन्ते दक्षिणा अस्य पूर्वीः ॥
verses.rom:
mahan ugro vavridhe viryaya samachakre vrishabhah kavyena |
indro bhago vajada asya gavah pra jayante dakshina asya purvih ||
verses.en:
Mighty and strong he waxed for hero exploit: the Bull was furnished a Sage's wisdom.
Indra is our kind Lord; his steers have vigour; his cows are many with abundant offspring.

verses.sa:
प्र यत्सिन्धवः प्रसवं यथायन्नापः समुद्रं रथ्येव जग्मुः ।
अतश्चिदिन्द्रः सदसो वरीयान्यदीं सोमः पृणति दुग्धो अंशुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yatsindhavah prasavam yathayannapah samudram rathyeva jagmuh |
atashchidindrah sadaso variyanyadim somah prinati dugdho amshuh ||
verses.en:
As floods according to their stream flow onward, so to the sea, as borne on cars, the waters.
Vaster is Indra even than his dwelling, what time the stalk milked out, the Soma, fills him.

verses.sa:
समुद्रेण सिन्धवो यादमाना इन्द्राय सोमं सुषुतं भरन्तः ।
अंशुं दुहन्ति हस्तिनो भरित्रैर्मध्वः पुनन्ति धारया पवित्रैः ॥
verses.rom:
samudrena sindhavo yadamana indraya somam sushutam bharantah |
amshum duhanti hastino bharitrairmadhvah punanti dharaya pavitraih ||
verses.en:
Eager to mingle with the sea, the rivers carry the well-pressed Soma juice to Indra.
They drain the stalk out with their arms, quick-banded, and cleanse it with a stream of mead and filters.

verses.sa:
ह्रदा इव कुक्षयः सोमधानाः समी विव्याच सवना पुरूणि ।
अन्ना यदिन्द्रः प्रथमा व्याश वृत्रं जघन्वाँ अवृणीत सोमम् ॥
verses.rom:
hrada iva kukshayah somadhanah sami vivyacha savana puruni |
anna yadindrah prathama vyasha vritram jaghanvan avrinita somam ||
verses.en:
Like lakes appear his flanks filled full with Soma: yea, he contains libations in abundance.
When Indra had consumed the first sweet viands, he, after slaying Vrtra, claimed the Soma.

verses.sa:
आ तू भर माकिरेतत्परि ष्ठाद्विद्मा हि त्वा वसुपतिं वसूनाम् ।
इन्द्र यत्ते माहिनं दत्रमस्त्यस्मभ्यं तद्धर्यश्व प्र यन्धि ॥
verses.rom:
a tu bhara makiretatpari shthadvidma hi tva vasupatim vasunam |
indra yatte mahinam datramastyasmabhyam taddharyashva pra yandhi ||
verses.en:
Then bring thou hither, and let none prevent it: we know thee well, the Lord of wealth and treasure.
That splendid gift which is thine own, O Indra, vouchsafe to us, Lord of the Tawny Coursers.

verses.sa:
अस्मे प्र यन्धि मघवन्नृजीषिन्निन्द्र रायो विश्ववारस्य भूरेः ।
अस्मे शतं शरदो जीवसे धा अस्मे वीराञ्छश्वत इन्द्र शिप्रिन् ॥
verses.rom:
asme pra yandhi maghavannrijishinnindra rayo vishvavarasya bhureh |
asme shatam sharado jivase dha asme viranchhashvata indra shiprin ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Maghavan, impetuous mover, grant us abundant wealth that brings all blessings.
Give us a hundred autumns for our lifetime: give us, O fair-checked Indra, store of heroes.

verses.sa:
शुनं हुवेम मघवानमिन्द्रमस्मिन्भरे नृतमं वाजसातौ ।
शृण्वन्तमुग्रमूतये समत्सु घ्नन्तं वृत्राणि संजितं धनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shunam huvema maghavanamindramasminbhare nritamam vajasatau |
shrinvantamugramutaye samatsu ghnantam vritrani samjitam dhananam ||
verses.en:
Call we on Indra, Maghavan, auspicious, best Hero in the fight where spoil is gathered,
The Strong, who listens, who gives aid in battles, who slays the Vrtras, wins and gathers riches.

verses.sa:
वार्त्रहत्याय शवसे पृतनाषाह्याय च ।
इन्द्र त्वा वर्तयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
vartrahatyaya shavase pritanashahyaya cha |
indra tva vartayamasi ||
verses.en:
O INDRA, for the strength that slays Vrtra and conquers in the fight,
We turn thee hitherward to us.

verses.sa:
अर्वाचीनं सु ते मन उत चक्षुः शतक्रतो ।
इन्द्र कृण्वन्तु वाघतः ॥
verses.rom:
arvachinam su te mana uta chakshuh shatakrato |
indra krinvantu vaghatah ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, may those who praise thee hitherward.
Direct thy spirit and thine eye.

verses.sa:
नामानि ते शतक्रतो विश्वाभिर्गीर्भिरीमहे ।
इन्द्राभिमातिषाह्ये ॥
verses.rom:
namani te shatakrato vishvabhirgirbhirimahe |
indrabhimatishahye ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers, with all our songs we invocate
Thy names for triumph over foes.

verses.sa:
पुरुष्टुतस्य धामभिः शतेन महयामसि ।
इन्द्रस्य चर्षणीधृतः ॥
verses.rom:
purushtutasya dhamabhih shatena mahayamasi |
indrasya charshanidhritah ||
verses.en:
We strive for glory through the powers immense of him whom many praise,
Of Indra who supports mankind.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे पुरुहूतमुप ब्रुवे ।
भरेषु वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
indram vritraya hantave puruhutamupa bruve |
bhareshu vajasataye ||
verses.en:
For Vrtra's slaughter I address Indra whom many invocate,
To win us booty in the wars.

verses.sa:
वाजेषु सासहिर्भव त्वामीमहे शतक्रतो ।
इन्द्र वृत्राय हन्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
vajeshu sasahirbhava tvamimahe shatakrato |
indra vritraya hantave ||
verses.en:
In battles be victorious. We seek thee, Lord of Hundred Powers,
Indra, that Vrtra may be slain.

verses.sa:
द्युम्नेषु पृतनाज्ये पृत्सुतूर्षु श्रवस्सु च ।
इन्द्र साक्ष्वाभिमातिषु ॥
verses.rom:
dyumneshu pritanajye pritsuturshu shravassu cha |
indra sakshvabhimatishu ||
verses.en:
In splendid combats of the hosts, in glories where the fight is won.
Indra, be victor over foes.

verses.sa:
शुष्मिन्तमं न ऊतये द्युम्निनं पाहि जागृविम् ।
इन्द्र सोमं शतक्रतो ॥
verses.rom:
shushmintamam na utaye dyumninam pahi jagrivim |
indra somam shatakrato ||
verses.en:
Drink thou the Soma for our help, bright, vigilant, exceeding strong,
O Indra, Lord of Hundred Powers.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रियाणि शतक्रतो या ते जनेषु पञ्चसु ।
इन्द्र तानि त आ वृणे ॥
verses.rom:
indriyani shatakrato ya te janeshu panchasu |
indra tani ta a vrine ||
verses.en:
O Satakratu, powers which thou mid the Five Races hast displayed-
These, Indra, do I claim of thee.

verses.sa:
अगन्निन्द्र श्रवो बृहद्द्युम्नं दधिष्व दुष्टरम् ।
उत्ते शुष्मं तिरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
agannindra shravo brihaddyumnam dadhishva dushtaram |
utte shushmam tiramasi ||
verses.en:
Indra, great glory hast thou gained. Win splendid fame which none may mar
We make thy might perpetual.

verses.sa:
अर्वावतो न आ गह्यथो शक्र परावतः ।
उ लोको यस्ते अद्रिव इन्द्रेह तत आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
arvavato na a gahyatho shakra paravatah |
u loko yaste adriva indreha tata a gahi ||
verses.en:
Come to us either from anear, Or, Sakra, come from far away.
Indra, wherever be thy home, come to us thence, O Thunder-armed.

verses.sa:
अभि तष्टेव दीधया मनीषामत्यो न वाजी सुधुरो जिहानः ।
अभि प्रियाणि मर्मृशत्पराणि कवीँरिच्छामि संदृशे सुमेधाः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tashteva didhaya manishamatyo na vaji sudhuro jihanah |
abhi priyani marmrishatparani kavinrichchhami samdrishe sumedhah ||
verses.en:
HASTING like some strong courser good at drawing, a thought have I imagined like a workman.
Pondering what is dearest and most noble, I long to see the sages full of wisdom.

verses.sa:
इनोत पृच्छ जनिमा कवीनां मनोधृतः सुकृतस्तक्षत द्याम् ।
इमा उ ते प्रण्यो वर्धमाना मनोवाता अध नु धर्मणि ग्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
inota prichchha janima kavinam manodhritah sukritastakshata dyam |
ima u te pranyo vardhamana manovata adha nu dharmani gman ||
verses.en:
Ask of the sages' mighty generations firm-minded and devout they framed the heaven.
These are thy heart-sought strengthening directions, and they have come to be sky's upholders.

verses.sa:
नि षीमिदत्र गुह्या दधाना उत क्षत्राय रोदसी समञ्जन् ।
सं मात्राभिर्ममिरे येमुरुर्वी अन्तर्मही समृते धायसे धुः ॥
verses.rom:
ni shimidatra guhya dadhana uta kshatraya rodasi samanjan |
sam matrabhirmamire yemururvi antarmahi samrite dhayase dhuh ||
verses.en:
Assuming in this world mysterious natures, they decked the heaven and earth for high dominion,
Measured with measures, fixed their broad expanses, set the great worlds apart held firm for safety.

verses.sa:
आतिष्ठन्तं परि विश्वे अभूषञ्छ्रियो वसानश्चरति स्वरोचिः ।
महत्तद्वृष्णो असुरस्य नामा विश्वरूपो अमृतानि तस्थौ ॥
verses.rom:
atishthantam pari vishve abhushanchhriyo vasanashcharati svarochih |
mahattadvrishno asurasya nama vishvarupo amritani tasthau ||
verses.en:
Even as he mounted up they all adorned him: self-luminous he travels clothed in splendour.
That is the Bull's, the Asura's mighty figure: he, omniform, hath reached the eternal waters.

verses.sa:
