tirah puru chidashvina rajamsyangusho vam maghavana janeshu |
eha yatam pathibhirdevayanairdasravime vam nidhayo madhunam ||
verses.en:
Even through many regions, O ye Asvins high praise is yours among mankind, ye Mighty-
Come, helpers, on the paths which Gods have travelled: here your libations of sweet meath are ready.

verses.sa:
पुराणमोकः सख्यं शिवं वां युवोर्नरा द्रविणं जह्नाव्याम् ।
पुनः कृण्वानाः सख्या शिवानि मध्वा मदेम सह नू समानाः ॥
verses.rom:
puranamokah sakhyam shivam vam yuvornara dravinam jahnavyam |
punah krinvanah sakhya shivani madhva madema saha nu samanah ||
verses.en:
Ancient your home, auspicious is your friendship: Heroes, your wealth is with the house of Jahnu.
Forming again with you auspicious friendship, let us rejoice with draughts of meath together.

verses.sa:
अश्विना वायुना युवं सुदक्षा नियुद्भिश्च सजोषसा युवाना ।
नासत्या तिरोअह्न्यं जुषाणा सोमं पिबतमस्रिधा सुदानू ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina vayuna yuvam sudaksha niyudbhishcha sajoshasa yuvana |
nasatya tiroahnyam jushana somam pibatamasridha sudanu ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, Very Mighty ones, with Vayu and with his steeds, one-minded, ever-youthful,
Nasatyas, joying in the third day's Soma, drink it, not hostile, Very Bounteous Givers.

verses.sa:
अश्विना परि वामिषः पुरूचीरीयुर्गीर्भिर्यतमाना अमृध्राः ।
रथो ह वामृतजा अद्रिजूतः परि द्यावापृथिवी याति सद्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina pari vamishah puruchiriyurgirbhiryatamana amridhrah |
ratho ha vamritaja adrijutah pari dyavaprithivi yati sadyah ||
verses.en:
Asvins, to you are brought abundant viands in rivalry with sacred songs, unceasing.
Sprung from high Law your car, urged on by press-stones, goes round the earth and heaven in one brief moment.

verses.sa:
अश्विना मधुषुत्तमो युवाकुः सोमस्तं पातमा गतं दुरोणे ।
रथो ह वां भूरि वर्पः करिक्रत्सुतावतो निष्कृतमागमिष्ठः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina madhushuttamo yuvakuh somastam patama gatam durone |
ratho ha vam bhuri varpah karikratsutavato nishkritamagamishthah ||
verses.en:
Asvins, your Soma sheds delicious sweetness: drink ye thereof and come unto our dwelling.
Your car, assuming many a shape, most often goes to the Soma-presser's place of meeting.

verses.sa:
मित्रो जनान्यातयति ब्रुवाणो मित्रो दाधार पृथिवीमुत द्याम् ।
मित्रः कृष्टीरनिमिषाभि चष्टे मित्राय हव्यं घृतवज्जुहोत ॥
verses.rom:
mitro jananyatayati bruvano mitro dadhara prithivimuta dyam |
mitrah krishtiranimishabhi chashte mitraya havyam ghritavajjuhota ||
verses.en:
MITRA, when speaking, stirreth men to labour: Mitra sustaineth both the earth and heaven.
Mitra beholdeth men with eyes that close not. To Mitra bring, with holy oil, oblation.

verses.sa:
प्र स मित्र मर्तो अस्तु प्रयस्वान्यस्त आदित्य शिक्षति व्रतेन ।
न हन्यते न जीयते त्वोतो नैनमंहो अश्नोत्यन्तितो न दूरात् ॥
verses.rom:
pra sa mitra marto astu prayasvanyasta aditya shikshati vratena |
na hanyate na jiyate tvoto nainamamho ashnotyantito na durat ||
verses.en:
Foremost be he who brings thee food, O Mitra, who strives to keep thy sacred Law, Aditya.
He whom thou helpest ne'er is slain or conquered, on him, from near or far, falls no affliction.

verses.sa:
अनमीवास इळया मदन्तो मितज्ञवो वरिमन्ना पृथिव्याः ।
आदित्यस्य व्रतमुपक्षियन्तो वयं मित्रस्य सुमतौ स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
anamivasa ilaya madanto mitajnavo varimanna prithivyah |
adityasya vratamupakshiyanto vayam mitrasya sumatau syama ||
verses.en:
joying in sacred food and free from sickness, with knees bent lowly on the earth's broad surface,
Following closely the Aditya's statute, may we remain in Mitra's gracious favour.

verses.sa:
अयं मित्रो नमस्यः सुशेवो राजा सुक्षत्रो अजनिष्ट वेधाः ।
तस्य वयं सुमतौ यज्ञियस्यापि भद्रे सौमनसे स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
ayam mitro namasyah sushevo raja sukshatro ajanishta vedhah |
tasya vayam sumatau yajniyasyapi bhadre saumanase syama ||
verses.en:
Auspicious and adorable, this Mitra was born with fair dominion, King, Disposer.
May we enjoy the grace of him the Holy, yea, rest in his propitious loving-kindness.

verses.sa:
महाँ आदित्यो नमसोपसद्यो यातयज्जनो गृणते सुशेवः ।
तस्मा एतत्पन्यतमाय जुष्टमग्नौ मित्राय हविरा जुहोत ॥
verses.rom:
mahan adityo namasopasadyo yatayajjano grinate sushevah |
tasma etatpanyatamaya jushtamagnau mitraya havira juhota ||
verses.en:
The great Aditya, to be served with worship, who stirreth men, is gracious to the singer.
To Mitra, him most highly to be lauded, offer in fire oblation that he loveth.

verses.sa:
मित्रस्य चर्षणीधृतोऽवो देवस्य सानसि ।
द्युम्नं चित्रश्रवस्तमम् ॥
verses.rom:
mitrasya charshanidhrito'vo devasya sanasi |
dyumnam chitrashravastamam ||
verses.en:
The gainful grace of Mitra, God, supporter of the race of man,
Gives splendour of most glorious fame.

verses.sa:
अभि यो महिना दिवं मित्रो बभूव सप्रथाः ।
अभि श्रवोभिः पृथिवीम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi yo mahina divam mitro babhuva saprathah |
abhi shravobhih prithivim ||
verses.en:
Mitra whose glory spreads afar, he who in might surpasses heaven,
Surpasses earth in his renown.

verses.sa:
मित्राय पञ्च येमिरे जना अभिष्टिशवसे ।
स देवान्विश्वान्बिभर्ति ॥
verses.rom:
mitraya pancha yemire jana abhishtishavase |
sa devanvishvanbibharti ||
verses.en:
All the Five Races have repaired to Mitra, ever strong to aid,
For he sustaineth all the Gods.

verses.sa:
मित्रो देवेष्वायुषु जनाय वृक्तबर्हिषे ।
इष इष्टव्रता अकः ॥
verses.rom:
mitro deveshvayushu janaya vriktabarhishe |
isha ishtavrata akah ||
verses.en:
Mitra to Gods, to living men, to him who strews the holy grass,
Gives food fulfilling sacred Law.

verses.sa:
इहेह वो मनसा बन्धुता नर उशिजो जग्मुरभि तानि वेदसा ।
याभिर्मायाभिः प्रतिजूतिवर्पसः सौधन्वना यज्ञियं भागमानश ॥
verses.rom:
iheha vo manasa bandhuta nara ushijo jagmurabhi tani vedasa |
yabhirmayabhih pratijutivarpasah saudhanvana yajniyam bhagamanasha ||
verses.en:
HERE is your ghostly kinship, here, O Men: they came desirous to these holy rites with store of wealth,
With wondrous arts, whereby, with schemes to meet each need, Ye gained, Sudhanvan's Sons! your share in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
याभिः शचीभिश्चमसाँ अपिंशत यया धिया गामरिणीत चर्मणः ।
येन हरी मनसा निरतक्षत तेन देवत्वमृभवः समानश ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih shachibhishchamasan apimshata yaya dhiya gamarinita charmanah |
yena hari manasa niratakshata tena devatvamribhavah samanasha ||
verses.en:
The mighty powers wherewith. ye formed the chalices, the thought by which ye drew the cow from out the hide,
The intellect wherewith ye wrought the two Bay Steeds,-through these, O Rbhus, ye attained divinity.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य सख्यमृभवः समानशुर्मनोर्नपातो अपसो दधन्विरे ।
सौधन्वनासो अमृतत्वमेरिरे विष्ट्वी शमीभिः सुकृतः सुकृत्यया ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya sakhyamribhavah samanashurmanornapato apaso dadhanvire |
saudhanvanaso amritatvamerire vishtvi shamibhih sukritah sukrityaya ||
verses.en:
Friendship with Indra have the Rbhus, fully gained: grandsons of Manu, they skilfully urged the work.
Sudhanvan's Children won them everlasting life, serving with holy rites, pious with noble acts.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण याथ सरथं सुते सचाँ अथो वशानां भवथा सह श्रिया ।
न वः प्रतिमै सुकृतानि वाघतः सौधन्वना ऋभवो वीर्याणि च ॥
verses.rom:
indrena yatha saratham sute sachan atho vashanam bhavatha saha shriya |
na vah pratimai sukritani vaghatah saudhanvana ribhavo viryani cha ||
verses.en:
In company with Indra come ye to the juice, then gloriously shall your wishes be fulfilled.
Not to be paragoned, ye Priests, are your good deeds, nor your heroic acts, Rbhus, Sudhanvan's Sons.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ऋभुभिर्वाजवद्भिः समुक्षितं सुतं सोममा वृषस्वा गभस्त्योः ।
धियेषितो मघवन्दाशुषो गृहे सौधन्वनेभिः सह मत्स्वा नृभिः ॥
verses.rom:
indra ribhubhirvajavadbhih samukshitam sutam somama vrishasva gabhastyoh |
dhiyeshito maghavandashusho grihe saudhanvanebhih saha matsva nribhih ||
verses.en:
O Indra, with the Rbhus, Mighty Ones, pour down the Soma juice effused, well-blent, from both thy hands.
Maghavan, urged by song, in the drink-offerer's house rejoice thee with the Heroes, with Sudhanvan's Sons.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ऋभुमान्वाजवान्मत्स्वेह नोऽस्मिन्सवने शच्या पुरुष्टुत ।
इमानि तुभ्यं स्वसराणि येमिरे व्रता देवानां मनुषश्च धर्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
indra ribhumanvajavanmatsveha no'sminsavane shachya purushtuta |
imani tubhyam svasarani yemire vrata devanam manushashcha dharmabhih ||
verses.en:
With Rbhu near, and Vaja, Indra, here exult, with Saci, praised of many, in the juice we pour.
These homes wherein we dwell have turned themselves to thee, devotions to the Gods, as laws of men ordain.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र ऋभुभिर्वाजिभिर्वाजयन्निह स्तोमं जरितुरुप याहि यज्ञियम् ।
शतं केतेभिरिषिरेभिरायवे सहस्रणीथो अध्वरस्य होमनि ॥
verses.rom:
indra ribhubhirvajibhirvajayanniha stomam jariturupa yahi yajniyam |
shatam ketebhirishirebhirayave sahasranitho adhvarasya homani ||
verses.en:
Come with the mighty Rbhus, Indra, come to us, strengthening with thy help the singer's holy praise;
At hundred eager calls come to the living man, with thousand arts attend the act of sacrifice.

verses.sa:
उषो वाजेन वाजिनि प्रचेता स्तोमं जुषस्व गृणतो मघोनि ।
पुराणी देवि युवतिः पुरंधिरनु व्रतं चरसि विश्ववारे ॥
verses.rom:
usho vajena vajini pracheta stomam jushasva grinato maghoni |
purani devi yuvatih puramdhiranu vratam charasi vishvavare ||
verses.en:
O Usas, strong with strength, endowed with knowledge, accept the singer's praise, O wealthy Lady.
Thou, Goddess, ancient, young, and full of wisdom, movest, all-bounteous! as the Law ordaineth.

verses.sa:
उषो देव्यमर्त्या वि भाहि चन्द्ररथा सूनृता ईरयन्ती ।
आ त्वा वहन्तु सुयमासो अश्वा हिरण्यवर्णां पृथुपाजसो ये ॥
verses.rom:
usho devyamartya vi bhahi chandraratha sunrita irayanti |
a tva vahantu suyamaso ashva hiranyavarnam prithupajaso ye ||
verses.en:
Shine forth, O Morning, thou auspicious Goddess, on thy bright car awaking pleasant voices.
Let docile horses of far-reaching splendour convey thee hitherward, the golden coloured.

verses.sa:
उषः प्रतीची भुवनानि विश्वोर्ध्वा तिष्ठस्यमृतस्य केतुः ।
समानमर्थं चरणीयमाना चक्रमिव नव्यस्या ववृत्स्व ॥
verses.rom:
ushah pratichi bhuvanani vishvordhva tishthasyamritasya ketuh |
samanamartham charaniyamana chakramiva navyasya vavritsva ||
verses.en:
Thou, Morning, turning thee to every creature, standest on high as ensign of the Immortal,
To one same goal ever and ever wending now, like a wheel, O newly-born, roll hither.

verses.sa:
अव स्यूमेव चिन्वती मघोन्युषा याति स्वसरस्य पत्नी ।
स्वर्जनन्ती सुभगा सुदंसा आन्ताद्दिवः पप्रथ आ पृथिव्याः ॥
verses.rom:
ava syumeva chinvati maghonyusha yati svasarasya patni |
svarjananti subhaga sudamsa antaddivah papratha a prithivyah ||
verses.en:
Letting her reins drop downward, Morning cometh, the wealthy Dame, the Lady of the dwelling;
Bringing forth light, the Wonderful, the Blessed hath spread her from the bounds of earth and heaven.

verses.sa:
अच्छा वो देवीमुषसं विभातीं प्र वो भरध्वं नमसा सुवृक्तिम् ।
ऊर्ध्वं मधुधा दिवि पाजो अश्रेत्प्र रोचना रुरुचे रण्वसंदृक् ॥
verses.rom:
achchha vo devimushasam vibhatim pra vo bharadhvam namasa suvriktim |
urdhvam madhudha divi pajo ashretpra rochana ruruche ranvasamdrik ||
verses.en:
Hither invoke the radiant Goddess Morning, and bring with reverence your hymn to praise her.
She, dropping sweets, hath set in heaven her brightness, and, fair to look on, hath beamed forth her splendour.

verses.sa:
ऋतावरी दिवो अर्कैरबोध्या रेवती रोदसी चित्रमस्थात् ।
आयतीमग्न उषसं विभातीं वाममेषि द्रविणं भिक्षमाणः ॥
verses.rom:
ritavari divo arkairabodhya revati rodasi chitramasthat |
ayatimagna ushasam vibhatim vamameshi dravinam bhikshamanah ||
verses.en:
From heaven, with hymns, the Holy One was wakened: brightly to both worlds came the wealthy Lady.
To Morning, Agni, when she comes refulgent, thou goest forth soliciting fair riches.

verses.sa:
ऋतस्य बुध्न उषसामिषण्यन्वृषा मही रोदसी आ विवेश ।
मही मित्रस्य वरुणस्य माया चन्द्रेव भानुं वि दधे पुरुत्रा ॥
verses.rom:
ritasya budhna ushasamishanyanvrisha mahi rodasi a vivesha |
mahi mitrasya varunasya maya chandreva bhanum vi dadhe purutra ||
verses.en:
On Law's firm base the speeder of the Mornings, the Bull, hath entered mighty earth and heaven.
Great is the power of Varuna and Mitra, which, bright, hath spread in every place its splendour.

verses.sa:
इमा उ वां भृमयो मन्यमाना युवावते न तुज्या अभूवन् ।
क्व त्यदिन्द्रावरुणा यशो वां येन स्मा सिनं भरथः सखिभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ima u vam bhrimayo manyamana yuvavate na tujya abhuvan |
kva tyadindravaruna yasho vam yena sma sinam bharathah sakhibhyah ||
verses.en:
YOUR well-known prompt activities aforetime needed no impulse from your faithful servant.
Where, Indra-Varuna, is now that glory wherewith ye brought support to those who loved you?

verses.sa:
अयमु वां पुरुतमो रयीयञ्छश्वत्तममवसे जोहवीति ।
सजोषाविन्द्रावरुणा मरुद्भिर्दिवा पृथिव्या शृणुतं हवं मे ॥
verses.rom:
ayamu vam purutamo rayiyanchhashvattamamavase johaviti |
sajoshavindravaruna marudbhirdiva prithivya shrinutam havam me ||
verses.en:
This man, most diligent, seeking after riches, incessantly invokes you for your favour.
Accordant, Indra-Varuna, with Maruts, with Heaven and Earth, hear ye mine invocation.

verses.sa:
अस्मे तदिन्द्रावरुणा वसु ष्यादस्मे रयिर्मरुतः सर्ववीरः ।
अस्मान्वरूत्रीः शरणैरवन्त्वस्मान्होत्रा भारती दक्षिणाभिः ॥
verses.rom:
asme tadindravaruna vasu shyadasme rayirmarutah sarvavirah |
asmanvarutrih sharanairavantvasmanhotra bharati dakshinabhih ||
verses.en:
O Indra-Varuna, ours be this treasure ours be wealth, Maruts, with full store of heroes.
.May the Varutris with their shelter aid us, and Bharati and Hotri with the Mornings.

verses.sa:
बृहस्पते जुषस्व नो हव्यानि विश्वदेव्य ।
रास्व रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
brihaspate jushasva no havyani vishvadevya |
rasva ratnani dashushe ||
verses.en:
Be pleased! with our oblations, thou loved of all Gods, Brhaspati:
Give wealth to him who brings thee gifts.

verses.sa:
शुचिमर्कैर्बृहस्पतिमध्वरेषु नमस्यत ।
अनाम्योज आ चके ॥
verses.rom:
shuchimarkairbrihaspatimadhvareshu namasyata |
anamyoja a chake ||
verses.en:
At sacrifices, with your hymns worship the pure Brhaspati-
I pray for power which none may bend-

verses.sa:
वृषभं चर्षणीनां विश्वरूपमदाभ्यम् ।
बृहस्पतिं वरेण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrishabham charshaninam vishvarupamadabhyam |
brihaspatim varenyam ||
verses.en:
The Bull of men, whom none deceive, the wearer of each shape at will,
Brhaspati Most Excellent.

verses.sa:
इयं ते पूषन्नाघृणे सुष्टुतिर्देव नव्यसी ।
अस्माभिस्तुभ्यं शस्यते ॥
verses.rom:
iyam te pushannaghrine sushtutirdeva navyasi |
asmabhistubhyam shasyate ||
verses.en:
Divine, resplendent Pusan, this our newest hymn of eulogy,
By us is chanted forth to thee.

verses.sa:
तां जुषस्व गिरं मम वाजयन्तीमवा धियम् ।
वधूयुरिव योषणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam jushasva giram mama vajayantimava dhiyam |
vadhuyuriva yoshanam ||
verses.en:
Accept with favour this my song, be gracious to the earnest thought,
Even as a bridegroom to his bride.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वाभि विपश्यति भुवना सं च पश्यति ।
स नः पूषाविता भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yo vishvabhi vipashyati bhuvana sam cha pashyati |
sa nah pushavita bhuvat ||
verses.en:
May he who sees all living things, see, them together at a glancc,-
May lie, may Pusan be our help.

verses.sa:
तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि ।
धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात् ॥
verses.rom:
tatsaviturvarenyam bhargo devasya dhimahi |
dhiyo yo nah prachodayat ||
verses.en:
May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God:
So May he stimulate our prayers.

verses.sa:
देवस्य सवितुर्वयं वाजयन्तः पुरंध्या ।
भगस्य रातिमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
devasya saviturvayam vajayantah puramdhya |
bhagasya ratimimahe ||
verses.en:
With understanding, earnestly, of Savitar the God we crave
Our portion of prosperity.

verses.sa:
देवं नरः सवितारं विप्रा यज्ञैः सुवृक्तिभिः ।
नमस्यन्ति धियेषिताः ॥
verses.rom:
devam narah savitaram vipra yajnaih suvriktibhih |
namasyanti dhiyeshitah ||
verses.en:
Men, singers worship Savitar the God with hymn and holy rites,
Urged by the impulse of their thoughts.

verses.sa:
सोमो जिगाति गातुविद्देवानामेति निष्कृतम् ।
ऋतस्य योनिमासदम् ॥
verses.rom:
somo jigati gatuviddevanameti nishkritam |
ritasya yonimasadam ||
verses.en:
Soma who gives success goes forth, goes to the gathering place of Gods,
To seat him at the seat of Law.

verses.sa:
सोमो अस्मभ्यं द्विपदे चतुष्पदे च पशवे ।
अनमीवा इषस्करत् ॥
verses.rom:
somo asmabhyam dvipade chatushpade cha pashave |
anamiva ishaskarat ||
verses.en:
To us and to our cattle may Soma give salutary food,
To biped and to quadruped.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमायुर्वर्धयन्नभिमातीः सहमानः ।
सोमः सधस्थमासदत् ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamayurvardhayannabhimatih sahamanah |
somah sadhasthamasadat ||
verses.en:
May Soma, strengthening our power of life, and conquering our foes,
In our assembly take his seat.

verses.sa:
आ नो मित्रावरुणा घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् ।
मध्वा रजांसि सुक्रतू ॥
verses.rom:
a no mitravaruna ghritairgavyutimukshatam |
madhva rajamsi sukratu ||
verses.en:
May Mitra-Varuna, sapient Pair, bedew our pasturage with oil,
With meath the regions of the air.

verses.sa:
उरुशंसा नमोवृधा मह्ना दक्षस्य राजथः ।
द्राघिष्ठाभिः शुचिव्रता ॥
verses.rom:
urushamsa namovridha mahna dakshasya rajathah |
draghishthabhih shuchivrata ||
verses.en:
Far-ruling, joyful when adored, ye reign through majesty of might,
With pure laws everlastingly.

verses.sa:
गृणाना जमदग्निना योनावृतस्य सीदतम् ।
पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
verses.rom:
grinana jamadagnina yonavritasya sidatam |
patam somamritavridha ||
verses.en:
Lauded by Jamadagni's song, sit in the place of holy Law:
Drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.
